Petals is a free and open source cannabis tracker that helps you understand your habit — and change it at your own pace.
 Whether you want to quit weed, take a tolerance break, cut down gradually, or simply know how much you actually use, Petals gives you the numbers. No account, no sign-up, and your data never leaves your phone.
 TRACK YOUR USE
 Log every session: amount in grams, cost per gram, date and time
 Record the consumption method: smoked, vaporized, edible or other
 See the time since your last use, down to the second
 Track how much you spend on weed, today, this week and overall
 Add a use in one tap from the home screen widget
 UNDERSTAND YOUR PATTERNS
 Statistics and graphs of your cannabis usage over time
 Usage by hour of day and by day of week, so you can see when the urge really hits
 Filter your history and spot the trends you would never notice from memory
 Watch the real cost of the habit add up
 CUT DOWN AT YOUR OWN PACE
 Time-gate your sessions: set a minimum interval between uses and let the timer hold you to it
 Register pause periods for a tolerance break or a full stop
 No streak shaming, no pressure: the app shows you the data, you set the pace
 WITHDRAWAL AND DRUG TESTS
 Track withdrawal symptoms over time: irritability, anger, restlessness, sleep difficulty, anxiety, decreased appetite and discomfort
 Estimated THC concentration after your last use

 PRIVACY BY DESIGN
 All of your data stays on your device
 No account, no cloud, no analytics
 Lock the app behind a personal PIN
 Export and import everything as plain CSV files — your data belongs to you
 HARM REDUCTION
 Built-in harm reduction information, because using less safely beats using blindly
 FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
 Petals is free and licensed under the AGPL-3.0. The full source code is public, contributions are welcome, and the app is translated by its own community of users.

izzyondroid:ch.pocketpc.nearbyglasses.name: Nearby Glasses
izzyondroid:ch.pocketpc.nearbyglasses.summary: Smart Glasses are often hard to spot. This app scans for their Bluetooth ID.
izzyondroid:ch.pocketpc.nearbyglasses.description:
This app attempts to detect smart glasses nearby and warn you.
 ⚠WARNING!⚠
HARASSING someone because you think they are wearing a covert surveillance device can be a criminal offence. It may even be a more serious offence than using such a device. Please seek legal advise regarding your local laws on this matter.
⚠DO NOT HARASS ANYONE AT ALL⚠
 This app has one sole purpose: Look for smart glasses nearby and warn you.
 This app notifies you when smart glasses are nearby. It uses company identificators in the Bluetooth LE data sent out by these. Therefore, there likely are false positives (e.g. from VR headsets). Hence, please proceed with caution when approaching a person nearby wearing glasses. They might just be regular glasses, despite this app’s warning.
 The app’s author takes no liability whatsoever for this app nor it’s functionality. Use at your own risk. By technical design, detecting Bluetooth LE devices might sometimes just not work as expected.
False positives are likely. This means, the app Nearby Glasses may notify you of smart glasses nearby when there might be in fact a VR headset of the same manufacturer or another product of that company’s breed. It may also miss smart glasses nearby.
 However, this app is free and open source, you may review the code, change it and reuse it (under the AGPL3 license).
 Nearby Glasses does not store any details about you or collects any information about you or your phone. There are no telemetry, no ads, and no other nuisance.
 If you choose to store (export) the logfile, that is completely up to you and your liability where this data go to. The logs are recorded only locally and not automatically shared with anyone. They do contain little sensitive data; in fact, only the manufacturer ID codes of BLE devices encountered.
 Use with extreme caution! As stated before: There is no guarantee that detected smart glasses are really nearby. It might be another device looking technically (on the BLE adv level) similar to smart glasses.
 Please do not act rashly. Think before you act upon any messages (not only from this app).
 Why? 
 I consider smart glasses an intolerable intrusion, consent neglecting, horrible piece of tech that is already used for making various and tons of equally truely disgusting 'content'.
 Some smart glasses feature small LED signifying a recording is going on. But this is easily disabled, whilst manufacturers claim to prevent that and take no responsibility at all (tech tends to do that for decades now).
 Smart glasses have been used for instant facial recognition before and reportedly will be out of the box. This puts a lot of people in danger.
 How? 
 It's a simple rather heuristic approach. Our approach comes from the Bluetooth SIG assigned numbers repo. Following this, the manufacturer company's name shows up as number codes in the packet advertising header (ADV) of BLE beacons. They are immutable and mandatory. Of course, manufacturers also have other products that come with Bluetooth and therefore their ID, e.g. VR Headsets. Therefore, using these company ID codes for the app's scanning process is prone to false positives. But if you can't see someone wearing an Occulus Rift around you and there are no buildings where they could hide, chances are good that it's smart glasses instead.
 According to the Bluetooth SIG assigned numbers repo, we may use these company IDs.
 I hope this is useful for someone.
 <
 p>for more, see https://github.com/yjeanrenaud/yj_nearbyglasses/

izzyondroid:eu.chainfire.holeylight.name: Holey Light
izzyondroid:eu.chainfire.holeylight.summary: Emulates notification LED on Samsungs/Pixels around the in-screen camera
izzyondroid:eu.chainfire.holeylight.description:
100% Free - 100% GPLv3 Open Source - No ads - No tracking - No nags - Optional donation 
 Holey Light is a LED emulation app. It animates the edges of the camera cut-out (AKA punch-hole) as replacement for the sadly missing LED on many modern devices.
 Additionally, it provides a notification display for when the screen is "off", replacing - or working in conjunction with - the Always-On Display feature. As this display is not around the camera hole, it is aptly named the Un holey Light .
 Supports all Samsung devices with in-screen camera hole, and several Google Pixels.
 Features 
 Emulates notification LED
 Four different display modes: Swirl, Blink, Pie, Unholey Light 
 Configurable animation size, position, and speed
 Customizable color for each notification channel
 Selects initial notification color by analyzing dominant color of app icon
 Displays during screen "off", sub-1% battery use per hour in Unholey Light mode
 Separate configuration modes for different power and screen states
 Ability to mark notifications as seen based on various triggers
 Respects Do-Not-Disturb and AOD schedules
 Can hide AOD completely, partially, and/or keep the clock visible
 Setup 
 Initial setup can be a bit tricky for a first-time user, but a setup wizard is included that guides you through the process.
 Permissions This app absolutely requires several permissions to be able to function. If you are concerned about that, you can always check out the source code (or not use the app).
 Accessibility: the app needs an accessibility service to render the emulated LED on-screen, and track the correct position to display in screen "off" mode.
 Notifications: a notification service is needed to be able to know about the notifications before we can show them
 Companion device: in a weird quirk of Android, this permission is required to be able to read the wanted LED color of notifications
 Battery optimization exemption: without this, Android would randomly disappear our emulated LED
 Foreground service: both an accessibility and notification service are used as described above
 Wake lock: you decide when and how the app draws on the screen, sometimes this requires making sure the CPU isn’t sleeping
 All package access: we render other app’s icons and access some of their base information to be able to differentiate different notifications from each-other

fdroid:com.thothterm.ubuntu.name: ThothTerm Resolute
fdroid:com.thothterm.ubuntu.summary: A real Ubuntu 26.04 LTS terminal on Android, no root required.
fdroid:com.thothterm.ubuntu.description:
ThothTerm Resolute runs a genuine Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (ARM64) userland on your phone
and gives you a proper terminal into it. No root, no VM, no remote server.
It is a terminal first. The Ubuntu side is real Ubuntu: apt works, dpkg works,
sudo is the distribution's own sudo rather than a wrapper, and anything you
install stays installed. Your home directory and everything in it survive app
updates.
Features
* Ubuntu 26.04 LTS ARM64, downloaded with your consent and set up on first launch
* Real sudo and a working apt/dpkg package manager
* Persistent home directory and root filesystem across app upgrades
* Multiple terminal sessions with a window list
* Pinch-to-zoom, plus Zoom in / Zoom out / Reset font size
* An extra keys row for Esc, Ctrl, Alt, Tab and arrows
* Portrait and landscape, with the layout adapting to each
* Copy and paste, text selection and scrollback
* Tools you install under your home directory stay on PATH between sessions
* LAN Mode: open this Ubuntu in a web browser on another computer on the
 same Wi-Fi, each browser with a terminal of its own
LAN Mode
LAN Mode is off by default and listens only while you have it on. It is in
the menu, above Windows. When it is on, the app shows an address to open in
a browser on the same Wi-Fi or Ethernet network and a short one-time PIN.
The browser must pair with that PIN before it gets anything. Each browser
gets its own terminal; the windows on your phone are never shared. It never
listens on mobile data or the Internet, and turning it off disconnects
every browser and invalidates their access. The connection is plain HTTP:
traffic on your network is not encrypted, so use it only on networks you
trust.
First run
This build does not include the Ubuntu userland. The first launch explains
what will be downloaded and downloads nothing unless you agree. Then:
1. The Ubuntu 26.04 base system (about 33 MB) is downloaded from Canonical's
 cdimage.ubuntu.com and checked against a SHA-256 built into the app; it is
 refused if it does not match.
2. Right after, in the background, the app installs Ubuntu's own sudo with
 apt from Ubuntu's package archive (archive.ubuntu.com and
 security.ubuntu.com): the package lists and sudo, about 30 MB, verified by
 apt against Ubuntu's archive signing keys. The terminal opens without
 waiting for this; if it fails, the terminal still works and the menu
 offers to retry it.
Later, the app contacts the package archive only when sudo is missing (a
setup that failed, or you removed it). Any other download is apt run by you.
Requirements
* A 64-bit ARM device (arm64-v8a). Other ABIs are not supported.
* About 1.5 GB of free space for the Ubuntu environment.
This is an early release. It concentrates on being a solid, honest terminal and
a correct Ubuntu environment; more features are planned for later updates.
ThothTerm Resolute is an independent application and is not affiliated with
or endorsed by Canonical. Ubuntu is a registered trademark of Canonical Ltd.
ThothTerm is free software under the Apache License 2.0. It is a fork of
TermOne Plus, which derives from Terminal Emulator for Android and the Android
Open Source Project. The PRoot runtime is built from source as part of the
build; it and the Ubuntu userland carry their own licenses, recorded in
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

fdroid:dev.bikram.filepipe.gh.name: FilePipe: Auto Files Organizer
fdroid:dev.bikram.filepipe.gh.summary: Your files, your rules. Automatically sort and move media with smart rules.
fdroid:dev.bikram.filepipe.gh.description:
FilePipe is a powerful file management tool that turns your chaotic Download and other messy folders into a perfectly organized library — automatically. 🚀
Ever wanted all your videos in one folder, regardless of which app downloaded them? Or wished your Downloads folder would just sort itself into Documents, Music, Images, and everything else?
That's exactly what FilePipe does. Set a rule, pick a schedule, and let the pipes do the work. Move or copy any media to its rightful place.
 ━━ 📋 RULES ━━ 
Use templates to start fast, or build your own. Create a rule by choosing source folders, file extensions, and a destination. Each rule can move, copy or delete files, and you control what happens when a filename collision occurs — skip, overwrite, or rename automatically. Rules can scan subfolders recursively and each one gets its own schedule.
Moved files keep their original date and time (copies too, with All files access), so they stay in the right order in your gallery and file manager instead of showing up as brand new.
 ━━ 🎛️ ADVANCED FILTERS ━━ 
Not every file in a folder should match. Narrow things down with:
• Filename patterns (wildcards or RegEx)
• Minimum and maximum file size
• Minimum and maximum file age
• Exclude patterns (wildcards or RegEx)
• Media orientation (portrait or landscape)
All optional, all collapsed by default so simple rules stay simple.
 ━━ 👁️ PREVIEW BEFORE YOU RUN ━━ 
Not sure a rule will pick up the right files? Preview it first. FilePipe shows exactly which files would be moved — without touching anything on disk.
 ━━ ⏰ FLEXIBLE SCHEDULES ━━ 
Run rules on demand, or schedule them to run:
• Every few hours
• Daily at a specific time
• Weekly on a specific day and time
 ━━ 📜 HISTORY ━━ 
Every run is logged with a full per-file breakdown — moved, skipped, or failed. You can:
• Filter by outcome (including runs that matched nothing)
• Sort by date or rule name
• Switch between date view, rule view, or status view
• Tap a moved file to open it directly
• Undo a run to restore files when possible
 ━━ ⚡ APP SHORTCUTS ━━ 
Long-press the app icon to run any of your top four enabled rules immediately, without opening the app.
 ━━ 🔔 NOTIFICATIONS ━━ 
Scheduled runs post a summary notification showing the files that were moved. Tap Undo directly from the notification to reverse the last batch.
 ━━ 💾 BACKUP AND RESTORE ━━ 
Export your rules, run history, and settings to a JSON file and restore them at any time. Auto-export on rule change and scheduled exports are available in Settings.
 ━━ 🎨 LOOK AND FEEL ━━ 
• Light, dark, black (OLED), or system-default theme
• Material You (wallpaper colors on Android 12+)
• 8 fixed accent presets and option to set your own color
• 9 palette algorithms: Tonal Spot, Vibrant, Expressive, Rainbow, Monochrome, and more
• Optional gradient background
• Optional progressive blur behind the nav bar (Android 12+)
• Use your own custom font
• UI scale from 75% to 125% to make text, icons, and spacing smaller or larger
 ━━ 🛡️ PRIVACY ━━ 
Works entirely on-device. No accounts, no cloud sync, no data collection. You control how folders are accessed - either one at a time or grant once & access everything.

fdroid:org.y20k.stayput.description:
Stay Put is an app that helps prevent casual theft of your device while charging in public spaces. The app was created to solve a common problem: charging your phone in public spaces while traveling or camping. When you need to leave your phone unattended at a public charging spot, Stay Put acts as your guard. It sounds a loud alarm if someone unplugs your device, deterring potential theft.
Stay Put is free software. It is published under the MIT open-source license.
VERIFY APK
----------
APKs published on Codeberg Releases are signed with the following certificate.
SHA-256: 61:05:14:5F:84:E5:CB:D6:97:F0:F6:E1:2C:97:77:04:2E:9B:2D:B6:67:A7:FF:0D:A4:12:F6:74:35:31:6D:D8
CORE FEATURES
-------------
- Loud alarm when device is unplugged
- Secure disarm with biometric authentication or device credentials
- Option to allow disarm by plugging the device back to power
- No tracking, no data collection
FAQ
---
WHEN SHOULD I USE STAY PUT?
Stay Put is ideal when charging your phone in public spaces like:
- Public libraries
- Hostels
- Campground bathrooms
- Airport charging stations
- Any shared charging area
HOW DOES STAY PUT PREVENT THEFT?
Stay Put doesn't physically prevent theft, but it acts as a deterrent. The moment someone unplugs your phone, a loud alarm sounds. The alarm can only be disabled using your biometric data or device credentials – or by plugging the device back to power (if this option is enabled).
CAN I STILL USE MY PHONE WHILE STAY PUT IS ACTIVE?
Yes, Stay Put runs in the background and doesn't interfere with normal phone usage. Just remember to disarm it before unplugging your phone.

fdroid:si.jakobkreft.exifremove.name: EXIF Remove - Strip, Randomize & View Metadata
fdroid:si.jakobkreft.exifremove.summary: Remove or scramble photo metadata before sharing, with configurable templates
fdroid:si.jakobkreft.exifremove.description:
EXIF Remove strips metadata from photos and videos before you share them, so you don't hand over your location, the time a photo was taken, or the device that took it.
Share files to EXIF Remove from any app, pick a template, and pass the cleaned copies on. Or open the app and pick files directly.
 Templates control what happens to each category:
* Location (GPS): keep, remove or randomize
* Date and time: keep, remove or randomize
* Camera, software and author info: keep or remove
* Other metadata: keep or remove
Three built-in templates come ready to edit: Remove everything, Remove location only, and Scramble location and date. Add your own, set a default, and skip the picker to clean in one tap.
 What gets cleaned 
JPEG, PNG and WebP are cleaned without re-encoding, so the pixels are untouched. HEIC and AVIF are converted to clean JPEGs. Videos (MP4, MOV and 3GP) are cleaned in place, also without re-encoding, so even large recordings finish instantly.
XMP, IPTC, comments and embedded thumbnails are always removed. ICC color profiles are kept, so colors never change. Cleaned files can be given random names, because file names leak information too.
Phones also hide whole files after the end of an image: a motion photo's video, an Ultra HDR gain map, a second copy of the picture. Each carries its own record of where you were and what device you own. EXIF Remove drops those as well.
 See what was removed 
After each clean you get a report for every file: what was removed, what was kept, and what was hidden inside. Each cleaned image is then re-parsed from scratch and withheld if it cannot be proven free of metadata.
The built-in metadata viewer lets you inspect any photo or video yourself and preview exactly what a template would do to it.
No network access: the app does not request the internet permission, so Android blocks it at the system level. No tracking, no ads. Free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later.

gnome-extensions:git@eexpss.gmail.com.summary:
## monitor git directory for changes.
> Working with a lot of git directories, I always forgot commit.
### Panel Icon
- Mouse 2, force refresh (re-read config file, check git dirs, refresh menu).
- Mouse 3, open configfile. config file is `~/.config/git-monitor.json`.
### Menu Item
- Directory and Files: Mouse 1, opened with `git difftool`, eg `meld`. Mouse 3, system open.

fedora-packages:golang-github-bugsnag-pa.summary: Go library for catching and handling panics in Go applications
fedora-packages:golang-github-bugsnag-pa.description: Panicwrap is a Go library that re-executes a Go binary and monitors stderr output from the binary for a panic. When it find a panic, it executes a user-defined handler function. Stdout, stderr, stdin, signals, and exit codes continue to work as normal, making the existence of panicwrap mostly invisble to the end user until a panic actually occurs. Since a panic is truly a bug in the program meant to crash the runtime, globally catching panics within Go applications is not supposed to be possible. Despite this, it is often useful to have a way to know when panics occur. panicwrap allows you to do something with these panics, such as writing them to a file, so that you can track when panics occur. Panicwrap is not a panic recovery system. Panics indicate serious problems with your application and should crash the runtime. panicwrap is just meant as a way to monitor for panics. If you still think this is the worst idea ever, read the section below on why. This package contains the source code needed for building packages that reference the following Go import paths: – github.com/bugsnag/panicwrap

firefox-addons:3051873.name: Video Translator
firefox-addons:3051873.summary: Translates burned-in subtitles on YouTube in real time and overlays the result on the video. OCR and translation both run on your device — no cloud service, no account, no API key.
firefox-addons:3051873.description:
Video Translator reads subtitles that are burned into the picture of a YouTube video — the kind that are part of the image itself, not YouTube's own closed captions — and paints a translation over the video as it plays.
Everything happens on your device. Frames never leave your computer, the recognized text never leaves your computer, and there is no cloud translation service, no account, and no API key.
HOW IT WORKS
Video Translator samples the video's subtitle band, recognizes the text with an on-device OCR engine, translates it locally with the Bergamot neural translation engine (the same engine family Firefox uses for its own built-in page translation), and overlays the result in sync with playback.
FEATURES
• Real-time translation of hardcoded subtitles on YouTube
• Fully on-device — nothing you watch or read is transmitted anywhere
• 18 translation target languages: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Arabic, Hindi, Turkish, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian
• Automatic detection of the subtitle's language, or pick the source language yourself for the most reliable recognition
• Adjustable overlay size, opacity and position
• Adjustable capture region, so OCR reads exactly the band your subtitles sit in
• A diagnostics panel showing recognition latency, cache hit-rate and sampling rate
SUBTITLE LANGUAGES THAT CAN BE READ
The OCR models are bundled with the add-on rather than downloaded, so the set of subtitle languages that can be read is fixed: English, Chinese (Simplified) and Chinese (Traditional), plus Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and Dutch on the higher-quality OCR setting. Languages that cannot be read are shown but disabled in the picker rather than silently failing.
Translation targets are separate and cover all 18 languages listed above.
Auto-detect works best on the default OCR setting. On the lightest OCR setting the
reader falls back to the English model, so set the subtitle language explicitly if
you are watching Chinese subtitles there.
FIRST RUN
The first time you translate into a given language, the add-on downloads that language pair's translation model (roughly 15–20 MB) from Mozilla's translation model storage and caches it. Progress is shown in the popup. After that the pair works offline.
REQUIREMENTS
Firefox 140 or newer, on desktop. Works on youtube.com only.
WHAT IT CANNOT DO
DRM-protected videos cannot be captured — their frames are unreadable to any extension, and the add-on says so rather than failing silently. Videos with no burned-in subtitles produce no overlay; YouTube's own closed captions are DOM text and are not what this add-on reads.

bluejetty:00075223:android.description:
Islamic Call Screen is a comprehensive app that offers various Islamic features all in one place 🌙📱. Customize your phone with Islamic Caller Themes, track Prayer Times, access Duas, manage Fasting Qaza, find the Qibla direction, and more! Enhance your phone's appearance and functionality while staying true to your Islamic values. Manage your calls, track prayers, and fulfill your spiritual needs—all with one beautiful app 💫.
Features:
📞 Islamic Call Screen:
Customize your phone with beautiful Islamic caller themes and wallpapers 🌺. Choose different themes for family, friends, or colleagues, and make your phone calls more meaningful and enjoyable 🌿.
🕌 Prayer Times:
Never miss a prayer with accurate azan times based on your location 🌅. Track Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and special times like Iftar and Sahur (Sehri Time/Suhoor) during Ramadan 2024 🍽️. Set reminders and notifications for each prayer 🕋, and plan ahead with next-day prayer times 📅.
🌟 Islamic Wallpapers:
Decorate your phone with stunning Islamic wallpapers, including beautiful mosques, Quranic verses, and calligraphy 🖼️. Browse, download, and share these wallpapers with friends and family 📲.
📿 Duas:
Access powerful duas for every occasion 🌸. Recite or listen to audio recitations 🎧 by renowned reciters, learn their meanings, and bookmark your favorites. Connect with Allah through these beautiful supplications 🤲.
🍽️ Fasting Qaza:
Keep track of your missed fasts from Ramadan and other days 🕰️. Enter the number of missed fasts, mark completed days, and monitor your progress 📊. This feature helps you stay on top of your religious obligations 🙌.
🧭 Qibla Finder:
Find the direction of the Qibla from anywhere in the world 🌍. Use the Qibla compass or map 🗺️ to locate the Kaaba and align your prayers correctly 🕋.
🌙 Ramadan Mode:
Celebrate Ramadan 2024 with devotion using reminders for Iftar, Sahur (Sehri/Suhoor), and Tarawih prayers 🍽️📿. Make the most of this spiritual month with easy tracking and notifications 🕯️.
📜 New Hadith Module:
Explore a collection of authentic Hadiths 📖. Learn, reflect, and apply the teachings of the Prophet (PBUH) in your daily life 🌱.
🧮 Tasbeeh Module:
Keep count of your dhikr (remembrance of Allah) with the new Tasbeeh mod

bluejetty:00129356:ios.description:
Too busy to read? Sit back, relax, and let Speaky read documents and news from any website aloud with natural voices and adjustable speeds.
Simply import a document or provide a link to your web article, and Speaky will extract the main content, detect the language, and read it to you. You can retrieve content from any website, import files from the cloud, or scan documents with your camera.
Key Features:
- Listen to documents and web articles
- Extract text from images and have it read aloud
- Choose from multiple voices across 40+ languages
- Customize playback with adjustable speed and accent
- Create lists and queue content for continuous listening
- Clean and format text automatically with Smart Cleanup
- Full support for all document types (pdf, doc, docx, txt, rtf, odt, epub)
- Full support for all image types (jpg, png, gif, tiff, bmp, heic)
- Enjoy Speaky in the background with complete offline access
"Articles in your Speaky queue play without an internet connection, so you can breeze through a New Yorker treatise as you ride the subway or catch up on world news on your next international flight." - New York Magazine
"Speaky is a handy tool that helps you multitask by listening instead of reading. Whether it’s an entertaining article on the Web or an important PDF for work, you can give your eyes a rest or just get more done with this intuitive voice reader." - AppAdvice

bluejetty:00115809:ios.description:
Welcome to Hole Swallow All - Eat All! This is a fun and relaxing swallowing puzzle game.
Here, you will control a mysterious black hole with gravity, go through colorful levels, and solve puzzles by "eating, eating, eating"!
Black hole, a magical existence, can swallow everything in front of it. Now, it's your turn to control it, use it to put all the food in your pocket, classify, swallow, and remove obstacles according to needs, and smoothly advance to the next stage of leisure challenges.
If you like exciting gameplay, you can also challenge players from all over the world to compete in the hot-blooded black hole challenge! The leaderboard is waiting for you to conquer, let global players see your powerful black hole control energy!
Preview of the highlights of the gameplay:
Drag the black hole to travel through the colorful food puzzle world and enjoy the dual pleasure of vision and operation.
Compete with global masters in real-time competitions, use black holes to complete the "eating + puzzle" tasks, and compete for the glory of the winner.
Climb the leaderboards by scoring points and show your unique skills to the world.
Collect special props, unlock new recipes, and create your own cake decorating experience. This is an adventure of deliciousness and creativity!
Complete various fun goals, use black holes to solve problems, and become the "foodie champion" in the puzzle world.
Each successful level will earn you rewards, time acceleration, and energy bonuses to power up your next round of challenges.
Make full use of the swallowing, sorting, and clearing mechanisms to solve difficult problems and experience the joyful combination of brain power and operation!
The game content is constantly updated, and you will find new levels and novel gameplay every time you enter, which will never make you feel repetitive and boring. All you need to do is - control the black hole, eat what you need to eat, and move forward!
It's not just a simple "swallowing" operation, it's also a full-scale test of rhythm, reaction, and strategy. Only the smartest and most flexible players can rule this black hole universe!
Lots of rewards and levels, the more you play, the more fun you will have! The more you collect, the more energy and time bonuses you will win. Relax and immerse yourself in this fun-filled puzzle world!
Every operation will bring a new sense of accomplishment, and every move of the black hole will bring you one step closer to victory. 
Try it now! Control the black hole, eat cleverly, solve puzzles one by one, and embark on this relaxing and healing game journey! 
What are you waiting for? Click to start, and your black hole adventure will start immediately!
Welcome to try our game. Do you have suggestions for our game? Need a little help? You can give feedback in the game, or communicate with us at fspacegame@hotmail.com for help.

bluejetty:00142896:ios.description:
Prix Essence Québec: The Tool to Save on Gas and Fuel.
Prix Essence Québec | Gas Prices is the ultimate local tool to compare, track, and anticipate regular, premium, and diesel fuel prices across Quebec.
Our edge: station prices synchronized with the official open data published by the Régie de l'énergie du Québec, validated by contributions from our active community of local drivers. 
Find the cheapest gas station near you and pay less at the pump in Montreal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke, Saguenay, Trois-Rivières, and across all administrative regions.
Key Features for Maximum Savings:
-Live prices by region and sub-region: Check regular and diesel fuel rates anywhere in the province.
-Favorite stations & personalized alerts: Save your go-to stations and receive tailored notifications the moment their price changes. Never miss a great deal at the pump again.
-Short-term forecasts: Get ahead of price hikes before they happen with our smart predictions. Fill up at the right time and avoid unpleasant surprises.
-Daily price changes: Track increases and drops to choose the best time to fill up.
-14-day charts: Visualize recent market trends and strategically plan your fuel budget. (source: Régie de l'énergie du Québec)
-Regional comparison: Compare Montreal, Montérégie, Laurentians, Lanaudière, Eastern Townships, Outaouais, Mauricie, Chaudière-Appalaches, Centre-du-Québec, Bas-Saint-Laurent, and more.
-Interactive station map: See prices around you. Compare rates from major brands (e.g. Costco, Shell, Ultramar, Petro-Canada, Couche-Tard).
-Trip cost calculator: Estimate your total fuel cost based on your vehicle's consumption (L/100 km) and distance.
-Price alerts: Get notified the moment gas prices move so you never miss a chance to save.
Why Choose This Quebec App?
100% local and relevant: Built for Quebec's realities, with region and city breakdowns that actually make sense (unlike generic apps).
Verified data: Greater reliability through direct synchronization with the official open data from the Régie de l'énergie du Québec, backed by real reports from local drivers.
Real savings: The fastest way to fill up at the right place and the right time. Every cent saved on gas adds up!
Clean interface: Clear map, essential info front and center. Find cheap gas fast.
Use Cases
Daily commute: Monitor today's gas prices near home or work to optimize your fill-up stops.
Long drive / Road trip: Plan your total fuel cost and target the regions with the cheapest gas.
Market tracking: Follow gas price trends to lower your annual fuel bill.
A local, high-performance alternative to GasBuddy and generic apps. Laser-focused on Quebec for more accurate prices and better regional coverage.
Pay less at the pump with prices synced to the official source, personalized alerts, and regional comparisons built for Quebec.
Download Prix Essence Québec | Gas Prices and start saving on every fill-up. No membership required, no time wasted!

bluejetty:00179389:ios.description:
هذه أول خطوة لكِ في عالم الشهرة والموضة!
حلمكِ بأن تصبحي نجمة مشهورة أصبح أقرب من أي وقت مضى! في ملكة الموضة ستبدئين رحلتكِ نحو عالم الأزياء، والأناقة، والشهرة. اختاري إطلالتكِ، ارتدي أجمل الفساتين، وعيشي مغامرات مليئة بالرومانسية والتحديات
يمكنكِ تصوير الأفلام، والمشاركة في البرامج التلفزيونية، وإجراء المقابلات، وبناء مسيرتكِ كممثلة أو عارضة أزياء مشهورة. مع ملكة الموضة ستعيشين حياة المشاهير بكل تفاصيلها
خصصي شخصيتكِ بالطريقة التي تعجبكِ، جرّبي أحدث صيحات الموضة، وتألقي بأجمل المكياج وتسريحات الشعر. زيّني منزل أحلامكِ، واستمتعي بقصص ومغامرات ممتعة مع شخصيات اللعبة
اصنعي طريقكِ إلى الشهرة و ابدئي من الصفر، اجتازي تجارب الأداء، وصوري الأفلام حتى تصبحي من أشهر نجوم هوليوود وتكسبي ملايين المعجبين
- تألقي بأجمل الإطلالات
اختاري من بين مئات الفساتين، والأحذية، والحقائب، والمجوهرات، ونسقيها مع تسريحات الشعر والمكياج لتحصلي على إطلالة مثالية
- شاركي في مسابقات الأزياء 
تحديات الموضة، نافسي أفضل اللاعبات، واثبتي ذوقكِ في تنسيق الملابس لتتصدرّي قائمة ملكات الموضة
- ابنِي قاعدة جماهيرية
ازدادي شهرة، التقي بالمعجبين، وظهري على أغلفة أشهر المجلات، وكوني حديث الجميع في عالم الموضة
- تعرّفي على المشاهير
احضري الحفلات الفاخرة، تعرفي على نجوم العالم، وعيشي أجواء الشهرة كما حلمتِ دائمًا
- سافري حول العالم
 افتحي مدنًا جديدة مثل هوليوود، بيفرلي هيلز، ودبي، واكتشفي أماكن مميزة مليئة بالمغامرات والفعاليات
- صممي منزل أحلامكِ
زيّني منزلكِ بالأثاث والديكورات التي تناسب ذوقكِ، واجعليه المكان المثالي لحياة المشاهير
- كوّني صداقات جديدة
تواصلي مع لاعبات من مختلف أنحاء العالم، زوري منازلهن، واستمتعي باللعب مع صديقاتكِ
فعاليات و مهمات يومية شاركي في الأحداث اليومية، أنجزي المهام، واحصلي على العملات، والمجوهرات
إذا كنتِ تحبين ألعاب البنات، والموضة، والتلبيس، والمكياج، وتصميم الشخصيات، فستجدين كل ما تبحثين عنه في ملكة الموضة

bluejetty:00126239:ios.name: Sitemate
bluejetty:00126239:ios.summary:
The Sitemate App is the workforce app for the built world. One app for every site, every form, and every sign-on you need.
Each worker gets a free digital ID and a Wallet that travels with you between sites: a secure, contactless passport
bluejetty:00126239:ios.description:
The Sitemate App is the workforce app for the built world. One app for every site, every form, and every sign-on you need.
Each worker gets a free digital ID and a Wallet that travels with you between sites: a secure, contactless passport for inductions, visitor sign-ins, pre-starts, toolbox talks, timesheets, daywork sheets and permits, plus the licences and records that prove you can do the work.
It is built for everyone on site: employees and operators, contractors and subcontractors, and site visitors and external workers.
Your free digital ID, on every site
- Free for every worker. No paid subscription, no shared devices.
- A dynamic QR code that's yours across every site you work on.
- Get signed on in seconds: show your digital ID and a supervisor scans it to sign you onto site and documents.
- Scan a site poster to fill out and submit forms like timesheets and inductions.
- No email and no password. Get your ID by verifying your phone number.
- Your activity log keeps every submission and sign-on in one place.
Your Wallet: licences, cards and records in one place
- Store your credential cards: driver licences, passports, tickets and other ID, using standard templates for your region.
- Save completed forms like inductions and Verification of Competency (VOC) records, so you can produce them on the spot.
- Your Sitemate ID sits in your Wallet alongside everything else.
- Search your cards and saved forms by name.
- Fill a Dashpivot credential field straight from your Wallet, with your consent.
- Snap a photo of a new credential and the details fill in for you.
- Call it your Wallet or your Purse, your choice.
Submit forms in your own language, with Storm AI
For workers completing a Dashpivot form, Storm fills it in for you:
- Speak in your own language. Storm produces the form in the workspace's working language.
- Snap a photo of the work. Storm reads conditions, equipment and defects directly from the image.
- Weather, location, time, and crew context are pulled in automatically.
- You review and submit. Every record is a draft until you confirm.
Works offline, syncs automatically
- Submit forms even without internet access
- Cards and records sync once you are back online
- No lost paperwork, no rework
Part of the Sitemate platform
Sitemate is the front line AI company for the built world. The Sitemate suite of products includes Dashpivot, Gearbelt, the Sitemate App, and Flowsite.
Works with Dashpivot and Gearbelt
You do not need a Dashpivot or Gearbelt account of your own. When your company runs them, the Sitemate App is how you take part:
- Complete and sign Dashpivot forms: inductions, pre-starts, toolbox talks, permits and method statements (SWMS/RAMS)
- Produce a licence or ticket from your Wallet straight into a Dashpivot form
- Scan a Gearbelt-registered asset to run a pre-start or inspection, or raise an issue
Get started today
Download the Sitemate App to get your free digital ID and Wallet to simplify site sign-ons, form submissions, and asset inspections. New to Sitemate? Visit sitemate.com to learn more about us.

bluejetty:00157310:ios.description:
LottoRead scans your lottery tickets, keeps them in one place and checks them against the official results.
SCAN AND SAVE YOUR TICKETS
Point the camera at your ticket. LottoRead reads the numbers and saves the ticket, and you can check any saved ticket against the latest draw for free. With Pro, every saved ticket is checked automatically once the official results are published, and you get a notification with the result for that ticket.
SUPPORTED DRAW GAMES
Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, Lotto Texas, New York Lotto, Florida Lotto, Lotto America, Lotto 6/49 (Canada), Lotto 6 aus 45 (Austria), Lotto 6 aus 49 (Germany), Millionaire for Life. More games are added regularly.
SCRATCH TICKETS
The AI reads the card's printed rules and tells you what it found. Use it as a second pair of eyes: double-check before you throw a card away, and confirm any prize at an authorised retailer.
RESULTS AND STATISTICS
Latest winning numbers and prize breakdowns for every supported game, with draw history, number frequency and how long since each number was last drawn.
NUMBER GENERATOR
Create lines at random, from delta gaps, from combinatorial patterns, with a wheeling system, or with AI assistance. Every draw is random, and no method can predict or influence the result. The generator simply helps you organise your picks; a wheel spreads the numbers you choose across several lines.
LOTTOREAD PRO
Pro keeps track of your tickets for you: automatic checking of every scanned ticket, a push notification for each result, claim-deadline reminders where the rules are known, scratch-card analysis and unlimited number generation. Try it free, cancel any time. Price and trial terms are shown in the app before you subscribe.
Play responsibly. Always confirm prizes with the official lottery.
Privacy policy: https://www.lottoread.com/privacy-policy
Terms: https://www.lottoread.com/terms

bluejetty:00046308:ios.description:
Nascemos com uma filosofia única e abrimos as portas para quem desejar entrar. Uma moda que nasceu nas ruas e trouxe um estilo único: básico, acessível e democrático. A nossa paixão é levar moda para todos. Em qualquer hora e em qualquer lugar, a TACO é a companhia ideal. 
Somos feitos para TODO MUNDO, TODO DIA.
Mais do que uma nova moda, somos uma nova atitude. Vivemos em constante movimento, nas veias trazemos a influência do urbano e na alma, a vibração do som. Nossa identidade se encontra em todas as idades e gêneros – você encontra roupas para homens, mulheres, adolescentes e crianças. Somos TACO!
Já fomos uniforme oficial da torcida no país inteiro, sabia? Mais de mil anúncios foram divulgados em diferentes formatos e assuntos. Famosos e também anônimos já representaram nossa marca. Nossa trilha sonora já tocou desde rock ao reggae, do samba ao axé.
Aqui, todo dia é diferente. Somos o perfeito exemplo de metamorfose, que vem inovando há quase 30 anos. Chegamos ao varejo em 1938, junto com as organizações ‘Tavares’ no Rio de Janeiro. Em 1985, nascemos como uma linha ‘sportswear’ disponibilizada nas lojas ‘Tavares’. Com o encerramento das operações das organizações em 1990, a TACO ganhou lojas próprias e muita atitude no mercado.
Entre 1994 e 1995, as primeiras franquias da TACO foram surgindo em São Paulo e no Rio de Janeiro. Atualmente, temos 64 lojas próprias em todo o Brasil, sendo a maior concentração delas na região metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro. Além disso, contamos com 65 franqueadas em todas as regiões do país.
As roupas da TACO são vendidas exclusivamente em nossas lojas, e agora elas chegam até você através da nossa loja online. Escolha seu look novo e seja bem-vindo ao Mundo TACO!
Tudo isso com muita praticidade, na palma da sua mão, a qualquer momento e em todo lugar. Aqui você pode conferir nossas novidades e promoções.
A entrega é rápida e segura em diferentes formatos de frete, de acordo com sua necessidade. Receba em casa com toda a comodidade ou encontre a loja TACO mais próxima através do nosso localizador de lojas.
Baixe agora mesmo e fique por dentro de tudo!
Precisa de ajuda? Nosso atendimento é funciona de segunda à sexta (exceto feriados) das 09h às 17h pelo email atendimento@taco.com.br ou telefone (21) 2585-8678.

Landscape Sudoku offers you a classic Sudoku experience with a modern twist. This is the be
bluejetty:00078027:ios.description:
Are you ready to challenge your mind and sharpen your logic skills? Dive into the world of Landscape Sudoku, the ultimate brain-teasing puzzle game!
Landscape Sudoku offers you a classic Sudoku experience with a modern twist. This is the best logic-based board game that is suitable for everyone, whether you are a Sudoku Beginner or an Advanced player. The horizontal version of Sudoku with large characters is more friendly to the elderly. Tons of hard Sudoku puzzles await you to explore. Download and enjoy the challenging journey! 
How to play?
The player needs to fill a 9*9 square grid by deduction according to the given number(clue).
*The goal is to complete a grid in which each row, each column, and each of the nine 3*3 areas contains all the numbers from 1 to 9.
The numbers 1-9 should appear exactly once in each row, column, and block.
Each Sudoku has only one true solution.
Highlights&Features:
- Horizontal Version: The landscape version of Sudoku with big numbers. 
- Multiple Levels: Sudoku comes in 4 perfectly balanced difficultly levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert
- Over thousands of Sudoku number puzzles offered, strive to conquer the most challenging Sudoku grids.
- Daily Challenges: Complete Daily Challenges and collect trophies.
- Intelligent Hints: guide you through the numbers when you get stuck.
- Unlimited Undos and Erasers. Get rid of the mistakes in free sudoku solver.
- Pencil marks and Auto Notes option.
- Clean and simple interface with easy controls to play.
Landscape Sudoku is a brand-new sudoku number puzzle game as good as with a real pencil and paper. It not only makes you feel relax and fun but also sharpens your mind, exercises both your logical thinking and memory with number strategies. Sudoku is not just a game, it's a mental workout! Enhance your concentration, and experience the satisfaction of solving each puzzle. 
Download Sudoku for FREE and start playing right now and become a professional sudoku player+slover. Beginners can follow the tutorial to learn how to play. The further you go, the higher difficulty you can try. Finally, you will find yourself being a sudoku master. As for sudoku veterans, you guys can go straight to higher levels to start this amazing quest! 
What is Sudoku? It is a Game for RALAXING and SELF-IMPROMENT
Sudoku is a classic free logic game, a fun math number puzzle, of Japanese origin and created by the best minds, that consists of filling a board of 81 squares with numbers from 1 to 9. The name of this blocks thing comes from joining the words Su (number in Japanese), doku (unique in Japanese). Hence, the correct spelling is sudoku, rather than suduku, sodoku, soduko, soduku or sedoku. Although they were created in the mid 80's, it was not until 2005 when they started to become fashionable after appearing daily in several international newspapers. Nowadays, it is very rare not to find a newspaper that contains a sudoku among its pages. To solve this math game usually takes between 10 and 30 minutes depending on the difficulty and agility of the player.

bluejetty:00078616:ios.description:
Guardio protects every part of your digital life: your devices, identity, accounts, and activity, so you can browse, shop, text, and bank online with confidence.
But it’s more than just alerts. Guardio gives you a clear picture of your online security, showing where your personal information is exposed, what’s already protected, and what steps you can take to stay safer.
Whether it’s a scam link, leaked password, or a suspicious message, Guardio detects threats early and helps you stop them before they cause harm.
What Guardio Protects You From
Phishing in emails, texts, fake websites and social media
Scam links, AI-generated traps, and personalized attacks
Leaked personal information and account monitoring
Identity theft, fraud, and financial scams
Weak spots like missing 2FA or unmonitored accounts
Guardio Features Included in the App
Real-time alerts when your personal info is exposed
Email protection to scan for phishing and scam attempts
Message filtering to catch scammy texts (iOS only)
Identity monitoring for up to 5 email addresses
An easy-to-understand overview of your security status
Guidance to fix issues and stay protected
Critical Security Alerts when severe threats are detected
Sync across mobile and desktop for full coverage
24/7 customer support via email
VIP security specialist support available on select plans
Why Guardio
Guardio is built for real life, covering the way you actually live and browse. It’s protection that works quietly in the background, keeps you informed, and helps you take control of your digital safety.
Guardio doesn’t just block threats, it helps you avoid them.
Plans
Individual: Protection for 1 person
Duo: Full protection for you + 1 other
Family: Covers up to 5 people, each with their own device protection
VIP: Premium support and one-on-one security guidance
All Guardio plans include proactive protection, identity monitoring, scam detection, and full cross-device coverage.
You can cancel anytime. Your protection stays active until the end of your billing cycle.
Part of Guardio’s Complete Protection Suite
This mobile app is part of Guardio’s full security platform.
Pair it with the Guardio browser extension on Chrome or Edge for continuous protection across desktop and mobile.
Need Help?
Email us at support@guard.io
Privacy Policy: https://guard.io/privacy
Terms of Use: https://guard.io/terms

Inspired by the classics, Idle Acorns is a fun mobile clicker game that features no advertisements, no in-app purchases, and no data-mining.
Inspired by the clicker games of the old internet, Idle Acorns brings a fun narrative to the mobile clicker arena but without getting weighed down by advertisements, in-app purchases or data mining. Explore the forest and ocean with Benny the squirrel and enjoy everything from fishing, to gardening. Unlock the campfire to invite new characters, collect resources, and craft items. Featuring 4 mini-games, iCloud backup support, Game Center support, iMessage sticker pack, and more!
Like classic Idle games, Idle Acorns respects time travel. Please note that time travel will disable Game Center features.
Shake the tree to gather acorns. Purchase upgrades and enlist scavengers to collect acorns while you are away!
Sell your acorns, and unlock new areas in the shop. Speak with Benny the squirrel to navigate your adventure.
Cast your line, and catch fish in the ocean. Open the map to visit your acres of land, or upgrade your offline collection. 
Unlock the campfire and invite all new characters. Trade resources and buy recipes to craft over 24 new items.

- Go fishing and cook fish
- Buy land and grow trees
- Unlock the campfire and trade resources
- Buy recipes and craft items
- 4 Mini-Games
- Share resources with friends
- Lots of character dialogue
- Seasonal events
- iCloud backup support
- Game Center leaderboards and achievements
- iMessage sticker pack
IMPORTANT: iPhone SE (2016 First Generation) and iPod touch are not supported.

bluejetty:00174835:ios.description:
Your private journal, with a companion who listens. Write about your day, capture meaningful moments, or talk to Barry or Sherry, your journaling Pal. Make space to reflect, find calm, and appreciate the little things in life.
# Meet Your Journaling Pal
Meet Barry or Sherry, your companion who listens and remembers things about you. Chat by text or voice, reflect on your day, and find ideas when you’re not sure what to write. Your Pal can help you add to your journal and revisit memories.
# Capture Beautiful Memories
Capture both moments & memories with photos, videos or audios that you can look back on in the future and remember the events that happened that day.
# Create Stunning Journal Entries
Explore a variety of journaling & note-taking tools in Journey's editor. Change the paragraph style, stylize your text with bold, italics and strikethrough, organize your writing with bullets, tables, and checklists, and play around with text color.
# Throwback to Your Happiest Moments
Get notified and look back at your best memories and your journal entries from a week, a month, or even a year or two ago.
# Tend To Your Emotions With Mood-Tracking
Take note of your feelings while journaling, and keep track of how your mood fluctuates across your journal entries. View how your mood shifts across 30 days in your stories.
# Shared Journal^
Collaborate and create cherished memories with your loved ones, family members, or even friends on an unforgettable journey together.
# End-to-End Encryption^
Enjoy unparalleled peace of mind with end-to-end encryption†. Safeguard your personal moments & memories and ensure your privacy remains intact throughout its journey to the cloud.
# Private & Secure Space
Set up a passcode and Touch ID/Face ID to keep your journaling notes private and secure. 
# Power Up Your Journal With Plugins
Power up your journaling routine with an extensive range of journal plugins. Explore functions such as exporting to DOCX & PDF, adding images & media, and blog publishing on Journey.
# Create Custom Templates 
Take charge of your journaling by creating custom templates that suit your needs. Create, duplicate, and delete custom templates at your convenience. 
# Other Features:
- Cloud sync 
- View entries in the calendar, photos, videos, and on a map
- Passcode & biometric lock 
- Available on mobile, desktop, and web 
- 14 Color themes
- Add weather & location to entry 
- View entries in timeline, calendar, or map 
- Advanced search: Activity, mood, favorites

bluejetty:00128873:ios.description:
Do you like cute little babies? Do you think you can handle the adorable toddlers? Then this app is perfect to test your baby caring skills. Take care of kinder and preschool-aged kids in the Tizi Town - Daycare. Feed them, play with them, give them baths, and more, in this fun kids game!
Playroom!
There are loads of toys from which your baby can play. Discover all the different rooms, full of surprises and hidden treasures. Remember, there are no rules so don't be afraid to interact with anything!
Feed Me!
The cute little baby is hungry! Feed the babies before they cry & get upset. Host a party for all the babies in the daycare where there play and eat good food. 
Bath Time!
We should keep the babies & toddlers away from all the dirt. Give a bath to the babies and keep them clean so that they don't fall sick. 
Doctor's Clinic!
Oh no! Your baby is not feeling so good. Get your little one checked in the doctor's clinic & take care of your baby girl/baby boy. Don't forget to give them an appreciation toy after the check-up!
Time for Bed!
After all the fun your baby is getting sleepy. Read a bedtime story to the toddlers so that they sleep quickly. All tucked in and ready for bed. Nightie night.
Features of My Tizi Town - Daycare is:
* Play with fun children characters.
* Touch, drag and explore every item and see what happens! Surprises are hidden everywhere!
* Kid-friendly content without violence or scary treatments. Completely safe to play.
* Made for kids of ages 6-8 but everyone will enjoy playing this game.
Download the app now to explore all the rooms. Don't forget to give us a 5-star rating, we would love to hear from you.

bluejetty:00107120:android.description:

Intertwining the art of word and the art of imagery has proven to be quite effective in making your works stand out. It’s not difficult with Add Text On Photo - Photo Text Editor.

● Quickly to add texts on photos, easy to create quotes, memes, photo captions or creative typography design. 
● More than 100+ fonts and font design, multiple text, font size, opacity, color, position, perspective (transform angles), rotation, bold, italic, capitalize, centrations, line spacing and letter spacing, wrap text, shadow, stroke (outline), glow (highlight), flip, mirror. Now you can create thousands of beautiful typography designs for yourself by inserting text on photos.

● Customize edit text: size, color, shadow, effect, decoration, stroke, border are available to edit text to photo.

● Variety background in many categories: cool photos, love images, photos of flowers and a lot of amazing photos for you to choose to add text on photos. 
● Save your text images in high resolution and easy to share it to friends or on social networks.

bluejetty:00095619:ios.description:
Survive 99 Nights in the Forest is an intense survival adventure game that challenges your instincts, strategy, and willpower. Trapped deep in the heart of a dark and dangerous forest, your mission is simple: survive for 99 nights — but nothing about it will be easy.
- Explore a Mysterious Open Forest
Wander through a vast, haunted wilderness filled with hidden secrets, hostile creatures, and limited resources. Daylight is your ally — but when night falls, the real struggle begins.
- Craft to Survive
Gather wood, stones, herbs, and other natural resources to craft weapons, build shelter, and cook food. Every item you collect could mean the difference between life and death.
- Hunt, Scavenge, and Defend
Hunt animals for food, but beware — you are not the only predator in the forest. Creatures lurk in the shadows. Build traps, light fires, and prepare your defenses each night.
- Build and Upgrade Your Shelter
Create your safe zone! Upgrade your base to withstand enemy attacks, harsh weather, and complete darkness.
- Survive the Unknown
The forest holds many secrets. Strange events and eerie encounters will test your courage and uncover the mystery behind your isolation.
Features:
- Dark survival gameplay with intense atmosphere
- Realistic day/night cycle
- Crafting, hunting, and base-building mechanics
- Dynamic AI and random encounters
- Offline play supported
Are you ready to test your survival skills in the most unforgiving forest?
Download now and try to survive all 99 nights... if you can.

The entire humankind has been infected by an unknown plague zombie virus that was created in a bio lab. Only a few people survive this unknown plague virus, including you. 
Play Zombie Games with Shooting War and see how long can you survive in the zombie apocalypse. Amid zombie rising where zombies can smell even tiny drops of human blood, pick up superior weapons & declare a zombie war against these dead infected unkilled zombies.
3X ARCADE ZOMBIE SHOOTING GAME MODES
Unlike most dead zombie war games offline, in Zombie Games with Shooting War, you can pick from 3 zombie fps shooting games offline modes including:
● Career zombie killing mode: Shoot zombies and complete missions.
● Story killing zombie game mode: Play in the middle of the deadly zombie apocalypse and try to survive the waves of zombie attacks. 
● Survival – zombie survival game mode: survive the zombie attacks for each level and prove that you are the ultimate zombie frontier.
ENJOYABLE CONTROLS
Combat zombie attacks from all sides with the intuitive 3D fps zombie shooting controls. Jump in place, or long jump ahead when there are too many zombies from the infected dead army on you. Game control has a new meaning in this zombie shooter. Not to mention that besides the easy controls, there are also awesome horror environments and scary sound effects to fully create a zombie survival ambiance. 
UNLOCK WEAPONS 
Start with the gun and riffle, then unlock more powerful weapons that make larger damage to these infected dead zombies. Unlock zombie snipers and have a mighty weapon that shoots zombies in one shot.
SHOOT & COLLECT LOOT BOXES WITH POWERUPS AND WEAPONS

‣ Stunning realistic graphics with zombie horror theme and soundtrack
‣ 3x zombie shooting game modes
‣ Each mode features exciting missions of apocalypse survival zombie action
‣ A Large number of weapons to choose from: guns, riffles, snipers, and more
‣ Shoot loot boxes with power-ups.
‣ Free to play (f2p), no pay-to-win or subscriptions.
‣ Play the zombie shooter offline without wifi or internet.
Now it’s time to survive and avoid all zombie attacks in one of the best zombie killing action game offline for 2022. Can you stay calm in the zombie battleground when you are the dead target of hundreds of zombies? 
Download Zombie Games with Shooting War Z for FREE and win the Z war against the zombies that are trying to destroy humankind forever. 
Play anytime, anywhere. Without internet, without paying. Reload your sniper rifle, practice your zombie shooter skills and start shooting zombies for survival.

bluejetty:00122428:ios.description:
New to our app?
The smile mobile banking app comes with features that makes it quick & easy to manage your money on the move.
Benefits
• Access & manage your finances anywhere, at any time
• Quick & secure money transfers between your accounts & other people
• Search your transactions & view your pending payments to find your incomings & outgoings
Key features
Download the app today & enjoy secure, convenient & efficient banking at your fingertips
• Quick & secure login with TouchID, FaceID or passnumber
• Browse & search over a year’s worth of transactions on your current, savings & loan accounts
• View your pending payments
• Create & pay new payees
• Pay, view & delete your saved payees
• Transfer money between your smile accounts (including to your credit card)
• View & delete your scheduled payments
• Freeze and unfreeze your card securely 24/7 for extra peace of mind or if you’ve temporarily misplaced your card
• View up to seven years of statements for current accounts, savings, ISAs & loans
• Use our easy to navigate account dashboard to help to you with your daily banking tasks
• Update your email address & phone number
• Share your account details with your contacts
• Switch your current account to us
• Apply for some products directly
• Find answers to your questions quickly on our help page
Fraud protection
The app also gives you additional protection from fraud. This is because we alert you of any account changes such as new device registration. 
We also have a fraud hub with a wide range of educational resources to help protect you from fraud.
Make sure you always install the latest update of the app to get the latest improvements & security measures.
Logging in
If you’re already registered for online banking, you will need your username, password & 6-digit security code to log in.
If you’re not registered for online banking yet, you can either do this by tapping 'Register for online banking' in the app, or register for online banking on our website.
Device compatibility
For security reasons, you’ll need to be using an Apple device on iOS 15 or above to use our mobile app. You also will not be able to use the app if your device is jailbroken.
If you are not able to update to this version, you can log into online banking to access your accounts instead.
Terms of use
We collect non-personal user data to monitor how well the app works. For example, measuring how long you spend on a particular screen. We collect a limited amount of personal data to allow you to use the app, for fraud prevention purposes & to help us to fix problems & improve the app for everyone. Everyone is opted in to this feature. If you do not want us to process your personal data in this way, please delete the app. If you download the app, you consent to sharing how you use it. Find out more about how we use this in our Privacy Policy, available within the app.
Important information
Please note: We will not charge you for downloading or using the app. However, your mobile network provider may charge you for data use, depending on your tariff or contract. Contact your operator for details. You may also use this service when connected to a Wi-Fi network.
Apple, Touch ID & FaceID are trademarks of Apple Inc. registered in the US & other countries.

Registered office: 1 Balloon Street, Manchester, M4 4BE. Registered in England and Wales (Company No: 990937).
Credit facilities are provided by The Co-operative Bank p.l.c. & are subject to status & our lending policy. The Bank reserves the right to decline any application for an account or credit facility.

bluejetty:00128044:ios.description:
The belief in the the awaited Mahdi is an Islamic belief firmly validated by consecutive & verifiable resources. But most of its related notions need further examination. including Imam Mahdi's age, his lengthy occultation, the reason behind his occultation, the blessings brought about by the awaited Mahdi when he is still in occultation, the responsibilities of the Muslim community at the time of his absence, the signs of his reappearance, his global revolution, how he shall combat and conquer, the weapons of Mahdi’s troops, and tens of other concepts. Due to the multiple criticisms that are issued by the opponents of this belief, and since their ideas are especially appealing to the young and educated generation, a dire need of providing contradicting arguments was felt. Despite the many books that have been authored on the awaited Mahdi, unfortunately, many authors did not take into account these opposing remarks and did nothing to challenge them. The late Ayatollah Amini was aware of this need for years and that is why he ventured to author a book that would deliver validated information on the awaited Mahdi to the reader hoping it would answer their questions in this regard. Thankfully, he was able to publish this book in 1967 in order to be presented to reading enthusiasts.
This book has now become available as an ebook & audiobook and offered in different languages, for smartphone and tablet users. Hopefully it will benefit them all.
----
بنام خدا
عقیده به وجود مهدی موعود و امام زندهی غایب، یک عقیدهی اسلامی است. عقیدهای است قطعی که به وسیله اخبار متواتر به اثبات رسیده. لیکن بسیاری از مسائل مربوط به آن، نیاز به تحقیق و بررسی دارد. از قبیل: طول عمر امام، غیبت طولانی، علت غیبت، فواید امام زمان در زمان غیبت، وظیفهی مسلمین در زمان غیبت، علائم ظهور، انقلاب جهانی مهدی، و چگونگی پیروزی آن جناب، سلاح سپاهیان مهدی، و دهها مسألهی دیگر. دراینباره اشکالات زیادی از جانب مخالفین، در بین قشر جوان و تحصیل کرده القا میشد، که نیاز به پاسخگویی داشت. با اینکه درباره امام زمان کتابهای فراوانی تألیف شده، لیکن متأسفانه اکثر نویسندگان، توجهی به این اشکالات نداشته و درصدد پاسخگویی نبودهاند. مرحوم آيت الله امينى از سالهای قبل به این نیاز توجه داشت و لذا درصدد تألیف کتابی برآمد که مطالب صحیح مربوط به امام زمان را به خوانندگان عرضه دارد و پاسخگوی مشکلاتشان باشد. بحمدالله ايشان توفیق یافت چنین کتابی را در سال ۱۳۴۶ هجری شمسی چاپ و در اختیار علاقهمندان قرار دهد.
اكنون اين اثر به صورت نسخه الكترونيكى (ebook) و به زبانهاى مختلف، در اختيار كاربران گوشيهاى هوشمند و تبلتها قرار مى گيرد، ان شاء الله كه مفيد واقع بشود.
----
وعدہ شدہ حضرت مہدی اورغیرحاضرامام کے وجود پر یقین رکھنا ایک اسلامی عقیدہ ہے۔ یہ ایسا قطعی اور مستحکم عقیدہ ہے جو مسلسل روایات اس کے گواہ ہیں اور اس میں ذرہ برابر شک نہیں ہے۔ مگر اس کے متعلق کچھ مسائل ہیں جن کے بارے میں تحقیق کرنا چاہیئے۔ مثال کے طور پر اسی قسم کے مسائل: حضرت مہدی کی عمر کی طویل ہونا، غائب یا غیر حاضر ہونے کی وجہ، غیبت کے دوران امام زمانہ کے فوائد، غیبت کے دوران مسلمانوں کی ذرمہ داریاں، ظہور کی علامات اور حضرت مہدی کے جیتنے کا طور طریقہ، امام کے سپاہیوں کے ہتھیار اور اسی قسم سے بیسویں مسائل کے بارے میں تحقیق کرنا ہے۔ ان مسائلوں کے بارے میں بہت ساری دقتیں اور الجھنیں مخالفین کی طرف سے تحریری اور زبانی طور پر، پڑھے لکھوں اور جوانوں کے درمیاں پھیلی جاتی تھیں اور ان دقتوں اور مشکلات کی جوابدہی بھی کرنی چاہیئے تھی۔ حضرت مہدی کے سلسلے میں بہت ساری کتابیں لکھی جا چکی تھیں مگر افسوس کے ساتھ اکثر مصنفوں نے مشکلات، مسائل اور الجھنوں کی طرف دھیاں نہیں دیا تھا اور ان مصنفوں کے ہاں بھی ان مسائل کے لئے کوئی جواب ہی نہیں تھا۔ آیت اللہ امینی مرحوم نے پچھلے سالوں سے ان مسائل کی طرف توجہ کرتے ہوئے ایک کتاب، حضرت مہدی کے بارے میں صحیح اور مستحکم ماخذوں سے لکھنے کی کوشش کی تاکہ اس کے ذریعے سے ان مسائل اور مشکلات کے لئے جواب دیں۔ خدا کے کرم سے وہ اس میدان میں کامیاب ہوگئے اور 1967 عیسوی میں انہوں نے کتاب شائع کروائی اوریہ کتاب شائقیں کے لئےبھی دستیاب ہوگئی۔ 
یہ کتاب اب، ای بک (ebook) کی شکل میں اور مختلف خصوصیات اور مختلف زبانوں میں، ٹیبلٹ اور اسمارٹ فونز صارفین کے لیے دستیاب ہے۔ امید ہے ان شاء اللہ یہ کام مفید ثابت ہوگا۔

• A large library of executive coaching sessions and expert-led lessons

bluejetty:00038950:ios.description:
Tempo Apps is an iPhone and iPad app that provide full access to Tempo.co free articles as well as premium contents of Majalah Tempo, Koran Tempo and Tempo English Edition. 
Published by TEMPO MEDIA Group a well know publisher in Indonesia which have won many awards and prizes for its independent, and exclusive contents. The group has been chosen as the publisher of Panama Papers in Indonesia.
The Tempo App will provide free articles of Tempo.co, on average 250 articles per day and also more exclusive content which is published on our printed publication. The Platinum subscriber will get a full access of latest content as well as archive content of Majalah Tempo since 1971 and Koran Tempo since 2003.
The app is robust and fast and you can customised your favourites topics based on your interest. Rich of photos, video and infographics content as well. Readers can also save the content for later reading.
Current web subscribers can easily login and access the apps, as well as subscribing via iTunes Subscription.
The iTunes in-app purchase subscriptions durations and prices are:
Platinum Subscription Packages
* 1 month (IDR 66.000 / USD 3.99 )
* 3 months (IDR 169.000 / USD 11.99 )
* 6 months (IDR 329.000 / USD 22.99)

bluejetty:00128069:ios.summary:
Could you survive in the best survival shooting game ever? Show your skills as a sniper to save your own life!
Last day of winter a 3d video game with a special Canadian forest environment and your only companion is a hunting wolf in this
bluejetty:00128069:ios.description:
Could you survive in the best survival shooting game ever? Show your skills as a sniper to save your own life!
Last day of winter a 3d video game with a special Canadian forest environment and your only companion is a hunting wolf in this huge-n-extensive land dominated by trees. You must survive the terrible dangers of the forest with your hunting rifle and your hunting pal a big brown wolf. In this cold weather, you must use your special skills to stay alive and survive attacks on animals living in the depth of trees. Your wolf-pal will go where you go and defend you from the attacking animals. You are alone in this lone snow-covered land except for your obedient wolf, keep your guns ready for the approaching danger. Change your gun from rifle to pistol for close prey and various other guns. Showing off your gaming skill use the smooth and easy controllers on the screen to direct your character to win each level of this free online survival in the winter fps game. Trained to survive any situation, your ability to find the best path to find a safe place is best and your wolf will alert you of approaching threats. In this video game, you will face harsh blowing winter wind and merciless attacks of the wild savage animals to get to freedom.
You have entered the zone of wolf caves and are surrounded by growling evil wolves. Hide with your wolf under bushes and climb a tree, change your gun to a sniper gun, for a clear shot to stop the deadly wolf's attack. As an ex-special forces guy strikes with firing guns at the evil wolves down before they reach you, your wolf will attack to defend you from bad wolves. Shoot with precision at the heads of the wolves to survive and move on to the next level. Improve your gaming skills in this different multilevel gaming environment by taking on and down all of the wolves with your good shots and with the help of your trusty brown wolf. You can experience and play this epic gameplay online as well as offline without wi-fi.
Everything looks the same in this woods-gameplay so keep yourself calm and create a plan to not lose path between trees, on this strange chilled last winter day. You’ve made a bad turn through fog-covered trees and have stepped into the nest of apes mistakenly. You are equipped with the best hunting rifle to escape from getting crushed by angry big apes. It is furtive to run, so use your sniper rifle to shot bullets and go on the ape hunt with your wolf. Play to win in this 3d sniper hunting for survival game against hunting forest critters. In this unique Canadian tree populated gameplay, your survival partner the brown wolf will accompany you everywhere to protect you and slash all the deadly furious apes and growling evil wolves.
Play the best survival in the cold winter-forest game where forest tops and grounds are chirping with gunshots, wolf howling, and apes crushing trees. The player is tasked to lead the characters to safety and survive attacks from bad wolves and furious apes. This game features the best 3D graphics of a thrilling forest-like environment with matching sound effects and music to boost. So download and start playing this entertaining game today!

bluejetty:00144693:ios.summary: Are you tired after a hard day? Have you had a stressful day at work? Do you need a moment for yourself to take a breath and relax? Or maybe you just can't sleep at night or have trouble falling asleep? The "Relaxing Music" application is h
bluejetty:00144693:ios.description:
Are you tired after a hard day? Have you had a stressful day at work? Do you need a moment for yourself to take a breath and relax? Or maybe you just can't sleep at night or have trouble falling asleep? The "Relaxing Music" application is here to help you solve your problems. Relaxing music and meditation music included in the application will help you relax, regenerate and strengthen your concentration.
The music included in the application is natural soothing sounds of sea waves, the sound of the forest, ocean waves, birds singing, rain sounds, sounds of flowing water and many other sounds and soothing music.
You will relax as you hear soothing spa music and beautiful songs used to overcome anxiety, daily stress, headaches and insomnia.
Put on your headphones, close your eyes, create the perfect atmosphere to relax and choose one of the relaxing music and lie down to rest or go to sleep.
Calm Music to sleep included in the application will make you drift away in the moment.
When you achieve balance between body and spirit, you will sleep like never before and all your problems will be forgotten.
You can also train your concentration with our app.
This is the perfect app for everyone who needs music for meditation or a spiritual journey in search of inner peace.
The main advantages of the application:
- 100% free application.
- Large selection of relaxation music, nature sounds, music for concentration and meditation.
- Very easy to use. Only one click to start the selected melody.
- Fade out system that gradually mutes the music towards the end so as not to disturb your state of relaxation, meditation or sleep.
- Reduces stress and tension.
The Relaxing Music app includes:
 - A large amount of high-quality chillout and relaxation music
 - Music for a sleep
 - The sound of sea waves
 - Ocean noise
 - Sounds of nature
 - Spa music
 - Meditation music
 - Music for concentration
 - Bird singing
 - Blowing wind
 - The sounds of the forest
 - Calm and soothing music
 - Sound for baby sleep
 - White noises
and a lot more
Relaxing Music is very easy to use. One click is enough to feel the relaxing power of music.
In the application preferences, you can adjust many settings to your needs such as: default duration of music, fade out time, how long one music should be played adding more minutes with one click and many more.
The Relaxation Music app is the best solution for people who are stressed, suffer from insomnia, had a hard day at work or just are tired.
If you have any comments or suggestions for the Relaxing Music app - please, let us know. Thanks for your support.

Watch and subscribe
● Browse personal recommendations on Home
● See the latest from your favorite channels in Subscriptions
● Look up videos you’ve watched, liked, and saved for later in Library

● Learn about the coolest Creators, Gamers, and Artists on the Rise (available in select countries)

Create content from your mobile device

Support creators you love with channel memberships (available in select countries)
● Join channels that offer paid monthly memberships and support their work
● Get access to exclusive perks from the channel & become part of their members community
● Stand out in comments and live chats with a loyalty badge next to your username
Upgrade to YouTube Premium (available in select countries)
● Watch videos uninterrupted by ads, while using other apps, or when the screen is locked
● Save videos for when you really need them – like when you’re on a plane or commuting
● Get access to YouTube Music Premium as part of your benefits
Note: If you subscribe via Apple, payment will be charged to App Store Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.
YouTube paid service terms: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms_paidservice.

bluejetty:00120166:ios.description:
A free Quran reading and listening app offering 7 widely-used Quranic prints and an offline text-based Quran to our respected app users around the globe.
1. Hafizi Quran (Saudi Print)
2. Mushaf Al Madina (Uthmani Print)
3. Color Coded Tajweed Quran
4. Mushaf Al Madina (Color Coded Tajweed)

6. Nurani Quran (Emdadia Library)

Read quran , listen to quran audio. A must app to keep for Ramadan and Hajj. 
Use it for memorizing or hifz quran by reading or listening to best reciters' telawat.
Features: 
1. Easy and user-friendly navigation to any part of the Quran. 
2. Page curl animation just like real book-pages
3. Zoom by Pinch
4. Choose and switch between your favorite Quran prints, as listed above.
5. Mushaf Text / Ayat Selection, Copy, Share, Tafsir.
6. Mushaf Text / Ayat highlight while playing audio.
7. Offline Text-based Quran, offering translation and topic search in 41 languages.
8. Quran reading is available in both Dark and Light mode.
9. Read Quran in either Portrait or Landscape mode.
10. Listen to verse-by-verse or Surah wise Quran Audio. You can also repeat audio.
11. Choose your favourite Qari / reciter from a list of famous Quran reciters.
12. Search with Arabic word/topic in the Quran
13. Choose your language from a list of 42 languages
14. Get translation of any ayat (verse) in your language.
15. Bookmark any page of your chosen Quran print.
16. Word by Word Quran
17. Dark Mode.

2. Abdullah Ali Jabir
3. Abdur Rahman Al Sudais
4. Mishary Rashid Alafasy

◆ Unique watch faces in minimal design 
◆ Aesthetic complications with fine lines and aesthetic color shades
