FULL FEATURES: 
◆ One-click Install feature
◆ Unlock your Apple Watch potential with the only aesthetic watch faces app
◆ Choose between most aesthetic watch faces 
◆ Enjoy a variety of activity/health, classic, calendar, weather, combined, cartoons, enigma, countdown and seasonal complications
◆ Customize your Apple Watch and easily change watch faces for any need
Enjoy our easy-to-use interface and customize your personal watch face. 
KEY COMPLICATIONS:
◆ Active/Health Complication: track your daily activity and build motivation by getting daily information about progress goal achievement, burned calories and other activity indicators.
◆ Weather Complications: check current temperature, weather conditions for today and upcoming days, wind speed, humidity and other weather indicators
◆ Combined Complications: provides you with a selected set of useful watch faces. Keep track of your most important information in one screen!
◆ Cartoon Complications: Having a bad day? Spice up your watch screen with our funny cartoons
◆ Calendar Complications: keep track on date, time and events
◆ Countdown Complications: Countdown till important events like birthdays, trips and seasonal dates
◆ Seasonal Complications: Choose between Christmas, Easter, Halloween, Valentine’s Day and many more
NOTICE:
→ 
This App is compatible with any Apple Watch: Ultra ,Series 8, Series 7, Series 6, Series SE, Series 5, Series 4, Series 3 & Series 2 + even older models. 
Attention for Apple Watch Series 3 and older: some of the Watch Faces can work not accurately due to watch OS limitations.
Live Watch Faces duration is limited to 2 seconds.
Live Watch Faces works only with Turned OFF "Always On feature" on your Apple Watch. Please, refer to the Help for more details.
→ 
Watch Faces Aesthetic Gallery uses your Health Data to display active/health complications. Please provide access to the Health Kit and geolocation. Your data is safe! We do not collect or keep a record of sensitive personal data. 
→ 
The app requires watchOS 8.0 or later to work correctly
Privacy Policy:

bluejetty:00143720:ios.description:
Epic Anime Fantasy RPG [Lost Sword]
Endless Romantic "Action X Flirting" with the Girls!
Begin the otherworld anime journey with the unique characters from Lost Sword now.
Meet the action flirting RPG with vivid character skill display and strong story line.
“Holy Sword Excalibur, forged by fairies,
has godlike powers that can halve a mountain in a single swing.
This divine relic of the Fairy, at some point, vanished without a trace;
it shall reappear to serve the true king when the blessing of the Red Dragon fades away.
This prophecy had only been taken as myth, but recently grew in prominence,
after Uther Pendragon, who had the blessing of the Red Dragon, was struck down by the False King Vortigern.
The war to determine the true king commenced,
and King Uther’s daughter, Elizabeth Pendragon, left to find Excalibur, but went missing.
Thus began the Great Disorder.”
Game Overview
■ Isekai Adventure RPG Filled with Lively Chemistry and Charming Girls!
Fairy Queen Morgana, who becomes a shut-in after many rebirths,
Princess Elizabeth, who holds strong mind beneath her gentle smile,
Bedivere, a cry baby but who has a strong loyalty to Elizabeth,
and finally, Ethan, who joins the adventure to find the Holy Sword along with them!
Begin the journey with the attractive characters to find the Holy Sword together! 
■ afk RPG of Your Dreams! 2D Side-Scrolling Real Time Action & Various Battles
Growing party play through endless real time afk battles! 
From various dungeons and single raid to interesting event dungeons,
Enjoy the growth through interesting battle RPG contents!
■ Visually Stunning High Quality 2D Anime Illustrations & Spectacular Skill Action!
Visually enjoyable afk battles with detailed Anime LD character motions and spectacular skill cutscenes! 
With battle motions and skill cutscenes that feel like real animation, 
Double the fun of character collection and battle! 
■ Realistic Character Voice with the Top-Tier Voice Actors!
Best voice actors participated! 
Deeply engaging experience enhanced by the realistic voices of our talented voice actors! 
Dive deeper into the world of Lost Sword with the top-tier voice actors.

bluejetty:00183107:ios.description:
Ski, shoot and win!
More than 3,000,000 players from all over the world have already experienced the exciting life of a professional biathlete. Do you have what it takes to ski fast and then shoot down all the targets? It is time you joined the other players in the only game of its kind. In Biathlon Mania you can even compete against real biathletes from the World Cup circuit.
Biathlon Mania is an action sports game with RPG elements and the most successful and most played biathlon game of all time. You can control, improve and train your biathlete as you see fit. You decide everything that goes on - improve your attributes, construct new facilities, learn new skills, build up your club, defeat opponents from all across the world, win tournaments and be at the top of the world. Whether you win or become an also-ran is purely down to your skill. Show everyone that you’ve got it! Biathlon Mania is easy to learn, but difficult to leave.
- Play against thousands of players from all over the world
- Master the combination of cross-country skiing and shooting
- Challenge real biathletes
- Create, level-up and customize your biathlon hero
- Defeat opponents, climb to the top of the rankings and earn achievements
- Test your skills in tournaments, daily league and the world cup
- Join with your friends, become a member of a club and fight for the title in club championships
- Improve your skills on various tracks, use the speed, endurance and shooting attributes to your advantage
- Gain sponsors, improve your equipment and build facilities such as fitness center, shooting range or many more
- Have fun with a wide array of minigames, fulfill daily tasks and earn rewards
- Enjoy the RPG elements
So what are you still waiting for? Experience the life of a biathlete in the exciting multiplayer world. Choose one of the 31 available languages and play for free anywhere and whenever you like!
Note: You can install the game on your ios device for free. The game contains in-app purchases and requires Internet connection.

Organize your photos, links, and thoughts into a timeline just for you.
Want to journal daily but hate complicated apps?
HakoJournal is a simple, beautiful diary app that lets you start in seconds.
A sudden thought. That amazing restaurant. An inspiring article.
Things that don't belong on social media, but are too precious to forget.
Whisper them into HakoJournal.
【What Makes HakoJournal Special】
◆ Seamless Tagging
Just type "#" anywhere in your text.
Tags are created instantly, and your entry is organized on the spot.
#travel #ideas #food — tag as you write, browse by tag later.
◆ Your Personal Design
Customize font size, line spacing, and margins.
Set your favorite photos as backgrounds.
Create your own beautiful "book" that's a joy to open and revisit.
◆ Multiple Photos at Once
Can't choose just one photo? No problem.
Upload several at once — travel landscapes, café moments, everything together.
◆ Links Become Beautiful Cards
Paste a URL and watch it transform into a visual preview card.
Build your own scrapbook of articles, videos, and places to visit.
◆ Privacy First
Lock your app with a passcode.
Your unspoken thoughts and precious ideas stay safe here.
【Premium Features】
HakoJournal is fully enjoyable for free, but premium unlocks even more.
◆ iCloud Sync
Write on iPhone, read on iPad.
Switch devices without losing a single memory.
◆ Liquid Glass Design
Apply the stunning Liquid Glass effect from iOS 26.
Write in a crystal-clear, beautiful interface.
◆ To-Do Lists
Add todo lists right in your journal.
Manage "what to do today" and "today's memories" in the same timeline.
Simple enough for anyone. Powerful enough for everything.
Start journaling with HakoJournal today.

Privacy Policy: https://www.toastplanet.com/apps/hakoJournal/privacyPolicy

bluejetty:00149631:ios.description:
Learn how to sleep again with the award-winning mobile app for insomnia started as a venture at Harvard Innovation Labs, and developed in collaboration with sleep psychologists, therapists, and researchers.
Looking to improve your sleep permanently? 
Any program can tell you to cut coffee, use blue-light filters or meditate. But the truth is much of the generic advice on the internet doesn’t work for people with insomnia. 
Stellar Sleep is different. Stellar Sleep uses the #1 science-backed approach for improving sleep that is personalized to your needs and simply works. We empower you to live a healthier and happier life by better understanding yourself and your brain, so you can wake up every morning feeling refreshed and ready to tackle the challenges of the day. 
Our results speak for itself. We have helped over a thousand patients fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer using psychology. Over 80% of our users see a dramatic improvement in their sleep in less than 4 weeks.
Our evidence-based program takes only 5 to 10 minutes a day, and includes topics around:
* Stimulus control
* Cognitive restructuring
* Undergoing sleep restriction therapy
* Building strong sleep habits
* Calming down a racing mind
* Relaxation techniques
* And much, much more
In addition to our core sleep curriculum, you’ll have access to the following features:

listings.description:
Learn how to sleep again with the award-winning mobile app for insomnia started as a venture at Harvard Innovation Labs, and developed in collaboration with sleep psychologists, therapists, and researchers.

Looking to improve your sleep permanently? 

Any program can tell you to cut coffee, use blue-light filters or meditate. But the truth is much of the generic advice on the internet doesn’t work for people with insomnia. 

Stellar Sleep is different. Stellar Sleep uses the #1 science-backed approach for improving sleep that is personalized to your needs and simply works. We empower you to live a healthier and happier life by better understanding yourself and your brain, so you can wake up every morning feeling refreshed and ready to tackle the challenges of the day.  

Our results speak for itself. We have helped over a thousand patients fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer using psychology. Over 80% of our users see a dramatic improvement in their sleep in less than 4 weeks.

Our evidence-based program takes only 5 to 10 minutes a day, and includes topics around:

* Stimulus control
* Cognitive restructuring
* Undergoing sleep restriction therapy
* Building strong sleep habits
* Calming down a racing mind
* Relaxation techniques
* And much, much more

In addition to our core sleep curriculum, you’ll have access to the following features:

* A comprehensive library of nature sounds, breathing exercises, progressive muscle relaxation exercises, bedtime stories, sleep music and guided meditations to help you relax and unwind.

* Gratitude and worry journaling.

* A deeper dive into other mental health challenges.

We've
bluejetty:00185760:ios.description:
Introducing Cheers, the ultimate party game designed to infuse every gathering with good vibes and non-stop laughter! Whether you’re a fan of classic party games or seeking something new, Cheers is here to transform your next event.
We've handpicked the most popular party games and added our own unique twist for endless entertainment. From intimate gatherings to epic bashes, Cheers ensures every moment is unforgettable.
Simply input player names, select your favorite game modes, and let Cheers take care of the rest — no more struggling with rules or keeping score manually. Dive right into the fun with beloved classics like Never Have I Ever, Who's Most Likely, Would You Rather, and Truth or Dare, all seamlessly integrated into one app. But that's not all — Cheers takes it a step further by introducing innovative game variations that will surprise and delight you. Get ready for unexpected twists, crazy challenges, and friendly competitions like never before.
Cheers is designed to ignite your night, creating an electrifying atmosphere that keeps everyone engaged and entertained. It's the perfect catalyst for forging new friendships, generating uncontrollable laughter, and serving as a guaranteed source of boundless amusement. It’s the Picolo PartyPal you didn’t know you needed — until now.
Ready for thrilling fun? Get into games like:
• Never Have I Ever: Uncover hilarious secrets and share wild experiences with your friends.
• Higher or Lower: Test your intuition as you predict if the next card is higher or lower.
• Horserace: Place your bets and cheer on your favorite virtual horse in a race to the finish line.
• Who's Most Likely: Discover who among your friends is most likely to do outrageous things.
• Give or Take: Dive into a captivating game of chance and discover who among your friends will succumb to their wild side.
• Back to Back: Prepare to put the knowledge of your friends to the ultimate test in this challenging and revealing game.
• Throwing Game: Expose your friends honest opinions while showcasing your throwing skills.
• Dice Game: Experience the heart-pounding thrill of chasing after those elusive sixes. Get ready for an adrenaline-fueled race against the clock.
• Roll The Dice: Take turns rolling the dice and embark on a thrilling journey of challenges and rewards.
• Spin the Bottle: Ignite the atmosphere as you spin the virtual bottle to determine thrilling dares or surprises.
And there’s more to come! Stay tuned for even more exhilarating party games. Why wait? Download Cheers now and make your next gathering the talk of the town!
Cheers

bluejetty:00032393:ios.description:
Discover the effortless journey of banknote collecting with NoteScan. This app is your gateway to unlocking the rich history and value of banknotes from around the globe. 
Key Features:
- Instant Identification: Just snap a photo, and NoteScan swiftly identifies your banknote, making the process incredibly simple and efficient.
- Rich History and Facts: Delve into detailed narratives and facts about each banknote, enhancing your knowledge and appreciation.
- Value and Rarity Insights: Access an extensive database with up-to-date prices based on the latest transactions, understanding the rarity and value of your banknotes.
- Collection Management: Easily create and manage your digital collection, keeping track of your precious finds with a few taps.
- AI-Powered Expert Consultation: Consult with our AI-driven banknote expert, developed by professional collectors, for in-depth analysis and advice.
- Global Database: Explore a vast database of banknotes from across the world, making it a comprehensive tool for collectors.
The recognition process is designed to be seamless and user-friendly. Capture a banknote with your camera, and within seconds, NoteScan provides a wealth of information, all at your fingertips. Elevate your collecting experience, whether you’re a seasoned numismatist or just starting. NoteScan is the perfect companion for anyone passionate about the art and history of banknotes.
Subscription pricing and terms:
NoteScan offers the following auto-renewing subscriptions to provide you with unlimited access to identification and database within Premium Plan while you maintain an active subscription: Weekly with a 3-day trial at $5.99; Weekly at $5.99; Monthly at $12.99; Yearly with a 3-day trial at $29.99; Yearly at $29.99; Lifetime at $39.99. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
If you have any questions or suggestions on how we can improve the application, please do not hesitate to contact us.

bluejetty:00152982:ios.description:
Might & Magic Fates is a free-to-play strategy card game (TCG) set in the legendary Might & Magic universe. Build powerful decks without faction restrictions, recruit iconic heroes, unlock their unique abilities, summon mythical creatures, reshape the battlefield with Building cards, and battle players from around the world in fast-paced tactical PvP card battles.
Enter the Sea of Fates, a fractured multiverse where timelines collide and destinies are rewritten. Command legendary heroes, mix cards from every faction, and discover endless deckbuilding possibilities in strategic battles where every decision counts. Whether you're a longtime Might & Magic fan or new to collectible card games, Fates delivers a fresh and rewarding take on the genre.
COMMAND LEGENDARY HEROES
Lead iconic heroes from the Might & Magic universe and unlock powerful abilities that evolve your strategy throughout every battle. Every hero offers a unique playstyle and new ways to outsmart your opponents.
COLLECT HUNDREDS OF CARDS
Expand your collection with hundreds of creatures, spells, artifacts, Building cards, and hero cards. Discover powerful synergies, experiment with new strategies, and create the perfect deck for every challenge.
MASTER ICONIC FACTIONS
Choose your side and fight for glory.
• Haven – Noble knights, angels, and holy magic.
• Necropolis – Undead legions, necromancy, and dark powers.
• Inferno – Demonic armies and devastating fire magic.
• Academy – Brilliant mages, magical constructs, and arcane mastery.
• Stronghold – Fierce orcs, shamans, and relentless warriors driven by raw strength.
Mix cards from every faction to unlock unique combinations and create strategies that are entirely your own.
BUILD WITHOUT LIMITS
Forget faction restrictions. Build your deck with cards from every faction and combine heroes, creatures, spells, artifacts, and Building cards to create powerful synergies. Experiment freely, adapt your strategy, and surprise your opponents with unexpected combinations.
FAST, TACTICAL BATTLES
Jump straight into the action. Without a traditional mana-ramp system slowing down the early game, every turn presents meaningful decisions from the very beginning. Victory comes from clever deckbuilding, positioning, timing, and mastering your hero's abilities.
COMPETE SOLO OR ONLINE
Challenge players worldwide in competitive PvP, climb the ranked ladder, complete solo adventures, and take part in seasonal events with exclusive rewards and new challenges.
FAIR FREE-TO-PLAY
Play for free and unlock cards through gameplay. Optional purchases help you grow your collection faster but are never required to compete.
Forge your deck.
Command legendary heroes.
Master the battlefield.
Shape your destiny.
The Sea of Fates awaits.
Will you answer its call?
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.ubisoft.com/legal/documents/termsofuse

• Live Flig
bluejetty:00144012:ios.description:
Stay ahead of every flight with byAir - get live flight updates, delay predictions, and airport guidance before you need them.
Trusted in the cockpit. Loved on every trip. No ads. Privacy first.
▶ Track What Matters, Instantly
• Live Flight Updates
Search and track flights in real time - get live status updates, estimated arrival/departure times, terminal and gate info, route, distance, duration, and remaining flight time.
• Delay Prediction
Plan ahead, not last-minute - byAir Predict monitors your flight starting six hours before departure, analyzing inbound aircraft, weather, airport congestion, and air traffic data.
• Inbound Plane Status
No surprises at the gate - see where your incoming aircraft is coming from and get aircraft details, so you know what to expect before it even lands.
• Friends & Family Sharing
Invite friends and family to byAir with a link so they can follow your flights in real time. Flight status, gate details, and airport information update automatically. No more "landed yet?" texts.
• Live Activities & Widgets
Stay informed about delays, gate changes, and cancellations with instant notifications. See flight updates at a glance with Live Activities and widgets.
▶ Your Flight History, On Autopilot
• Personal Flight History
Your flight history, beautifully organized - explore aircraft details, countries you've visited, and airports. See your journeys on a map and share your travel moments.
• Auto-scan Email & Calendar
No more manual entry - connect your email account once and byAir will automatically detect and add your upcoming flights as new bookings arrive.
• Import from Other Apps
Keep all your flight data in one place - easily import your flight history from FlightRadar24, App in the Air, Flighty, TripIt, OpenFlights, and more.
• Personal Flight Tracking MCP
Connect your travel data to your AI assistants - use your personal MCP link to access flights, trips, airport information, and travel history in Claude, Perplexity, Codex, and other compatible assistants.
▶ Arrive Prepared, Every Time
• Airport Guide with Travel Tips
Find your way around airports with tips verified by travelers - discover the fastest security lanes, best food spots, quiet lounges, and useful shortcuts.
• Live Flight Board
Stay up to date with real-time arrivals and departures for every airport, updated every minute.
• One-Tap Check-In
Open your airline's check-in page directly and get your boarding pass faster.
• Taxi & Transport Options Worldwide
From your door to the departure gate - find taxi and public transport options for any airport. Plan your journey to and from the airport with ease.
Stay ahead of every flight - download byAir today!

bluejetty:00080691:ios.summary:
LEGO® Play is the safe creative app for all brick lovers, builders, and creators! Step into a world of digital creativity tools where you can create, experiment, and explore your imagination. Play your way!
Explore creative ideas
Got a pa
bluejetty:00080691:ios.description:
LEGO® Play is the safe creative app for all brick lovers, builders, and creators! Step into a world of digital creativity tools where you can create, experiment, and explore your imagination. Play your way!
Explore creative ideas
Got a passion? Express your creativity with fun tools designed for kids. From drawing and storytelling, to making videos and building with LEGO® bricks, there's no limit to what you can imagine.
• Whether you're into building, art, drawing, photography or comics, the Creative Canvas tool is where your ideas come to life.
• Want to make a film? Use the Stop-Motion Studio and be your own director!
• Master builder? The Brick Builder tool lets you make your own fun 3D LEGO® creations.
• Love art and design? The Pattern Designer tool lets you create everything from colorful patterns to characters and creatures.
Make it yours
A creative app that you can make your own. Style your avatar, your space, your vibe. It’s your world to express yourself in.
• Design your own LEGO® avatar and choose fun outfits and accessories.
• Create a custom username.
• Showcase all your creative builds on your profile.
• Get ready for home design! Create and personalize your dream digital home with brick-built furniture and decorations.
• Build multiple homes and create your very own LEGO® neighborhood! 
Search for inspiration with LEGO® Play
Discover a safe and creative space to find inspiration for your next build.
• Explore new ideas and skills for your own builds.
• See unique digital art, stop-motion animations and LEGO® builds.
• Search and discover creations related to your interests.
Enjoy creative games for kids
Explore a growing collection of safe games for kids. Race awesome vehicles, blast off into space, take on sports challenges, and meet amazing animals in fun games designed for creativity and play.
Discover LEGO® stories and characters
Explore adventures, challenges and creative content from your favorite LEGO® themes and characters.
• Follow adventures featuring your favorite LEGO® characters and heroes.
• Explore content inspired by LEGO® City, LEGO® Friends, LEGO® NINJAGO®, LEGO® Star Wars™ and other popular themes.
• Complete fun challenges, watch videos and unlock new ideas for building and play.
Play & explore safely
LEGO® Play is a secure, moderated app for kids to explore creative ideas and LEGO® content safely.
• Verified Parental Consent is required to unlock the full LEGO® Play creative building experience.
• All content is moderated before appearing in the app.
Unlock the full experience with LEGO® Insiders Club
Get full access to all LEGO® Play content, with a LEGO® Insiders Club membership — it’s free and easy to sign up! Ask a parent or guardian to help you sign up.
Important information:
• The app is FREE and there are no in-app purchases or third-party advertising.
• To help create a safe and creative space for kids, verification is required to access some functionality. Verification needs to be given by an adult. Verified Parental Consent is free, and we will not store your personal details.
We use your personal information to manage your account and (with parental consent) to improve your experience. We review anonymized data to provide a safe, contextualized, and excellent LEGO® building and learning experience for kids.
• You can learn more here: https://www.lego.com/privacy-policy and here: https://www.lego.com/legal/notices-and-policies/terms-of-use-for-lego-apps/.
• For app support, please contact LEGO® Customer Service: www.lego.com/service.
• Check if your device is compatible at: https://www.lego.com/service/device-guide.
LEGO®, the LEGO® logo, the Brick and Knob configurations, and the Minifigure are trademarks of the LEGO® Group. ©2026 The LEGO® Group.

bluejetty:00171646:ios.description:
Make learning the alphabet fun with this interactive game featuring an Australian and American style garbage truck.
Explore the city in search of bins containing letters of the alphabet.
FEATURES:
A fun way to learn by collecting all the letters of the alphabet with a garbage truck.
Easy, Normal and Hard Modes: 
Easy Mode allows younger players to enjoy the game by focusing on collecting the letters with location hints.
Normal Mode adds vehicle damage.
Hard Mode removes the letter location hints and adds fuel being required to drive resulting in game over if it reaches zero before a gas station is found to fill up again.
Parent Mode / Complete Game:
For when it's time to go to bed and still feel like you have achieved collecting all the letters. Access this from the pause menu during the game.
Four drivers to choose from.
Time Trial mode to race against the clock and compare your score others with a global Leaderboard.
Micro racing game levels for tiny vehicle racers!
Endless Runner mode with four game types to play!!
Note:
This game contains Ads and In-App Purchases. An active internet connection is required to process your privacy options and to make purchases. This game will not work in offline mode. Always ask a parent or guardian for help when making choices about your privacy.

bluejetty:00062709:ios.summary:
The Spare platform connects schools, stores on campus, parents, and students. 
At Spare-enabled schools, parents can rest assured that their children have arrived at school safely, and are able to buy whatever they want without carrying
bluejetty:00062709:ios.description:
The Spare platform connects schools, stores on campus, parents, and students. 
At Spare-enabled schools, parents can rest assured that their children have arrived at school safely, and are able to buy whatever they want without carrying any cash. Furthermore, they can add limits to their child's account to promote healthy spending habits, and can keep track of their child's nutritional intake.
The on-boarding process is simple: parents download an app, pair their child's wristband, and recharge their account using cash at the school or using their credit card in-app.
The platform does not require a credit card nor a bank account, nor does it require any complex sign-up procedures; all you need to get started is a valid phone number, a Spare Digital ID, and a quick visit to the app store.

bluejetty:00124114:ios.description:
Relaxing pets and home decorating game for ADULTS. 
* RELAX! Spend hours decorating and enjoying your pet's wonderful personality.
* BE NURTURING! Adopt and customize a cute and adorable virtual pet. Feed and care for your virtual pet and it will love you back! 
* DECORATE ROOMS! Beautifully drawn furniture and home decor items in a paradise of pet friendly items released EVERY WEEK. 
* DRESS UP YOUR PET! Super cute and stylish clothes to dress up your pet, from magical fairy to rock star! 
* MAKE NEW FRIENDS! Our social network of players have one thing in common: They love their pet and are huge cat and dog lovers! And..they love decorating!
* BE HELPFUL! Visit neighbor houses, send and receive gifts, and form help each other with decorating ideas. 
* JOIN TRADING GROUPS. Trade with others to acquire rare or highly sought after decor and dress up items!
Why is Pet Buddies so addictive?
- You will enjoy your pet's Tamagotchi sensibility and attractiveness 
- You can relax, decorating your pet's house with new design and decor themes every week
- Trading is a huge part of the game! 
- Weekly shop updates with beautifully designed furniture and pet dressup clothes
- A social network of wonderfully helpful and friendly players
- Advanced home decorating tools
- A great variety of pet customize options to create the cutest pet just the way you want.
- Your pet has fun social interactions when visiting homes of neighbor pets
- Animal lovers will love that their pet seems to have a life and personality all its own
- Every possible furniture and decor items can be found in shops to decorate with. From lamps, to wall clocks, beautiful outside sceneries, to gorgeous window, curtains, carpets, sofas, armchairs, floor lamps, ceiling lamps, and more!
- Dress up items for your pet includes modern fashion, retro fashion, special outfits for cultural events and holiday celebrations, formal wear, cute winter wear, spring outfits and much more!
Join Pet Buddies today!

bluejetty:00180224:ios.description:
Your Edge From the Midwest to the Mountains
Discover HuntStand, now featuring a redesigned look and feel to enhance your scouting and navigation experience in the field — and introducing HuntStand Ultimate, our most powerful membership ever. Recognized by Outdoor Life Magazine as the Best App for Hunters, HuntStand is North America’s #1 Hunting & Land Management App with over 9 million downloads. Whether you’re glassing in the Rockies or setting stands in the whitetail woods, HuntStand is your ultimate hunting companion from the Midwest to the mountains. Install now for free!
► Popular Features ►
◆ Nationwide Property Lines: Search for property lines, access private and public boundaries, and view curated public land maps nationwide for all 50 states and most of Canada.
◆ Advanced Game Forecasts: Exclusive 15-day activity forecasts for whitetail, elk, mule deer, and blacktail at your exact location.
◆ Monthly Satellite Imagery: See changes in your hunting ground with monthly satellite updates plus years of historical imagery.
◆ Group Hunt Areas: Share hunt areas with buddies, lease partners, and family seamlessly.
◆ Exclusive Rut Maps: County-level rut maps for whitetail, elk, mule deer, and blacktail, with detailed dates for each phase.
► Start Mapping for FREE ►
Download HuntStand and start mapping your hunting areas today — completely free.
◆ GPS Mapping: View your location, track movement, and add markers for stands, blinds, and other key spots.
◆ HuntZone Wind Forecasting: Predict scent impact with hour-by-hour forecasts up to 72 hours ahead.
◆ Hunt Area Customization: Build and share detailed maps tailored to your hunts.
◆ High-Resolution Satellite: Navigate with crisp satellite imagery.
◆ Digital Rangefinder: Instantly calculate distances in the field.
► HuntStand Pro ►
$29.99/year – Premium mapping tools and nationwide coverage.
◆ Nationwide Property Lines: Detailed property line maps for all 50 states and most of Canada.
◆ Property Ownership Data: View landowner info and search by name.
◆ Monthly Satellite Imagery: Fresh updates and historical archives.
◆ Public Hunting Land Maps: Discover new hunting spots nationwide.
◆ National Aerial Imagery: High-resolution aerial maps for the U.S.
◆ 3D Mapping: “Fly through” terrain in dynamic 3D.
◆ Unlimited Offline Maps: Save maps for use without internet.
◆ Gear Store Discount: Save up to 20% on top hunting brands.
► HuntStand Ultimate ►
$99.99/year – Everything in Pro plus exclusive tools to give you the edge in the field from the Midwest to the mountains.
◆ All HuntStand Pro Maps and Tools.
◆ 15-Day Activity Forecasts: Peak activity times for whitetail, elk, mule deer, and blacktail.
◆ Advanced Rut Maps: Detailed rut dates for all four species.
◆ Whitetail Habitat Map: Identify top whitetail habitats (U.S. only).
◆ Gear Store Discount: Save up to 50% on top hunting brands.
Billing & Subscription: Charges apply to your iTunes Account upon purchase confirmation.
Privacy Policy: https://huntstand.com/privacy

bluejetty:00100264:ios.summary:
Tired of video playback being interrupted suddenly, or music suddenly stopping when switching pages? Welcome to a new era of smooth playback ! Install Pure Tube, enjoy smooth background play and floating popup play right now!
Install the P
bluejetty:00100264:ios.description:
Tired of video playback being interrupted suddenly, or music suddenly stopping when switching pages? Welcome to a new era of smooth playback ! Install Pure Tube, enjoy smooth background play and floating popup play right now!
Install the Pure Tube app and nothing else will ever distract you from watching video content of the most popular video resource, because all video ads and pop-ups will be automatically blocked by the app! With this app you will get a completely new, much more pleasant experience from watching Tube videos! 
FUNCTIONS IN DETAIL
Floating Video Player
- Allows you to play videos and MP3 music in Floating Popup Play Mode.
- Play in both full-screen or floating popup window mode as you wish
Background Video & Music Player
- Allows you to play videos & music or audio in the background, in which way the video & mp3 or audio will continue to play when you exit Pure Tuber for other social media apps, such as Line, Messenger, WhatsApp, etc.
- Use the Minimize function to fit Tube videos & music, on a small resizable, and movable window in the corner of your screen. Now you can play your favorite game, check your email, or perform any other task!
Sleep Timer
Set a timer before going to sleep, then you can put the phone aside, close your eyes, enjoy the media, and fall asleep sweetly or focus on other things.
-No need to worry about the media being played until dawn, turn it off regularly to save traffic quota and power. You can play popular ASMR, sleep aid songs, classical music, listen to story sessions, sing, etc.
- Some users will use the timer to help set the Pomodoro! Let the timer remind you to take a break while enjoying the background music, and enter the next Pomodoro in a better state.
Up to 4K Resolution
- Maximum resolution of videos active by default.
- able to play videos or music videos with all resolutions from 144p to 4K, enjoy the best user experience.
Note
1. Free Premium is a third-party tube API. The contents of the videos are from the API Services.
2. Pure Tube complies with the API Terms of Use.
3. According to YouTube's Terms of Use, we are not allowed to display videos from YouTube with the screen locked, nor to let you download songs or music.
Privacy: https://sites.google.com/view/puretube/home
Service: https://sites.google.com/view/puretube/home

bluejetty:00100606:ios.description:
Experience the ultimate 3D destruction in Cube Crush 3D: Color Shooter!
Are you ready for a satisfying and addictive color shooter experience? Cube Crush 3D brings a fresh twist to the pixel art genre. Blast vibrant colors, and watch massive 3D shapes crumble into thousands of tiny, colorful pixels!
A solid 3D shapes waits at the center, and every tap sends a color shot straight into it. Each hit breaks the surface into pixels, and with every new shot, those pixels shatter and fall, revealing a clean board underneath. The mechanic is simple, but the color flow is sticky: shoot, watch it shatter, keep firing, and finish the clear.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE CUBE CRUSH 3D:
Epic 3D Destruction: Don't just hit a wall; destroy complex 3D shapes! Watch them collapse into pixel piles that react to every hit with realistic physics.
Relaxing ASMR Gameplay: Looking for a stress-relief game? The sound and visual of crumbling pixels provide the perfect ASMR escape.
Challenging Puzzles: It starts easy, but as you progress, the 3D models become more complex.
HOW TO PLAY:
Shoot colors to break the blocks piece by piece.
Watch the pile as the pixels fall and stack up in real-time.
Clear the entire shape to unlock the next satisfying level!
Cube Crush 3D: Color Shooter offers a unique blend of challenge and relaxation. Stop scrolling and start crushing! Join the most colorful 3D destruction journey today!

bluejetty:00149564:ios.description:
Lyndon State Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with LSB Hometown Anywhere 2.0:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the LSB Hometown Anywhere 2.0 app, you must be enrolled as a Lyndon State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00132324:ios.summary:

Have you ever tried going on a shopping spree for new fabrics (in physical stores or online), only to feel completely lost by not knowing exactly h
bluejetty:00132324:ios.description:
(NOTE: This free trial version is fully functional, but has a maximum limit of 10 Patterns)
Have you ever tried going on a shopping spree for new fabrics (in physical stores or online), only to feel completely lost by not knowing exactly how you would use that nice-looking piece of fabric, and end up purchasing the wrong thing - or purchasing the right thing, but in the wrong quantity - or worse, still: Leaving empty-handed?
If your answer is "yes", then Sewing Patterns will be your indispensable companion in the future. The inspiration in the form of your pattern library is right at your fingertips, wherever you go, and you can easily make sure that you purchase the right fabric in the right quantity - and with the right accessories. The app also helps you find inspiration on how to best make use of your current stash of fabric.
The app lets you gain the perfect overview in a single place, whether your patterns are purchased, found in magazines, or your own creations entirely. You can categorize your patterns based from standard garment types, or create as many of your own categories as you like. You can have your patterns sorted alphabetically, by most recent usage, or in any particular order you like. Each pattern can be associated with as many categories as you wish.
It is entirely up to you how many details you want to register for your individual patterns, but the more details you supply, the more help you will find in the built-in filtering function. When browsing your patterns, only the filled-in information is shown, so you won't have to deal with lots of empy fields.
Using the camera, you can supply your pattern details with pictures of the model, the instructions, or perhaps of the finalized garments. You can add as many pictures and PDF files as you like, both for your categories, your patterns and your fabrics.
Use the Filter function if you need to search for a specific pattern in your pattern library, or just need inspiration for your next project, based on a specific piece of fabric.
In all aspects, Sewing Patterns is an indispensable app, for the experienced seamstress and the newcomer alike!

bluejetty:00185383:ios.description:
This game is for fun only and has no actual photo detection or recognition capabilities.
How it works: 
- Press start to take a new photo OR choose an existing photo of the player from within the game!
- Add the name of the player! (optional)
- Long press the scanner needle before you play to pre-select the game result (hot, crazy hot, sizzlin hot or smokin hot) OR wait and see what the game chooses!
- Press scan and the scanner lights up and scans over your photo then speaks a pre-selected Or random game result - hot, crazy hot, sizzlin hot or SMOKIN HOT!
Voice recorder feature (record and use your voice instead of the Hot O Meters):
- Press 3 dots menu button (top right of scanning screen) and select 'Record your voice'. Here you can record and playback voice recordings of up to 10 seconds for each of the 4 Hot O Meter game results. The game will change the pitch of your voice to sound like the Hot O Meter. After you have recorded turn the switches ON to use your recording instead of the Hot O Meters when he speaks the scan result. This means you can customise your scans to have fun with your friends. Example recording if your name/friends name is Kim: "Hey baby, Hot O Meter says Kim is hot!".

bluejetty:00160835:ios.description:
The complete Holy Bible in Amharic, Old and New Testament. 
Fully offline, no internet needed, so you can read it anywhere.
READING THE BIBLE
• Every book of the Bible, with Amharic and English book names side by side
• Sort books between the Old and New Testaments for an organised selection
• Search books for the fastest selection
• Select a chapter with an easy button interface
• Move between chapters with a swipe or the page buttons
• Picks up where you left off
• Highlight verses in several colours and find them all again in Highlighted
• Copy and share verses with family and friends
READING PLANS
Build a daily habit with a plan that fits your season:
• Bible in a Year
• New Testament in 90 Days
• The Gospels in 30 Days
• Psalms in 30 Days
• Proverbs in 31 Days
A calendar shows the days you've read and today's reading. Tap a day to read it, and continue from where you stopped.
WORSHIP: FIND THE KIÑIT AND KEY OF ANY MEZMUR
Made for worship teams, choirs and musicians. Play or sing a mezmur and Worship listens, then shows:
• Which Kiñit it uses: Tizita, Bati, Ambassel or Anchihoye
• The key the mezmur is in
• Which shape to play and how far to transpose, so you can play it in the key you know
Includes Learn Kiñit, a short guide to the five-note scales and the four Kiñit for worship teams.
Audio is analysed live on your device. Nothing is recorded or saved.
SYSTEM FEATURES
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, with a wide reading page on iPad in portrait and landscape
• Supports Dynamic Type for those who prefer larger text, plus an in-app text size control
• Supports Dark Mode, easy on the eyes for reading at night
ADVANCED FEATURES
Reading, reading plans and text size are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks Advanced Features: highlighting, book search and unlimited use of Worship. Worship includes 30 free tries so you can try it first. Purchases can be restored on all your devices from Settings.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your highlights and reading progress stay on your device (Worship NEVER records).
Tebareku!

bluejetty:00155779:ios.description:
MVB Bank is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with MVB Bank:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the MVB Bank app, you must be enrolled as a MVB Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

After becoming a filthy rich tap tap trillionaire, life got boring. What else is there to do? Build an evil empire and go on a quest for world domination – duh!
In this dangerously fun, evil idle clicker game, you work for the secret organization – The League of Evil. Starting with a small dungeon and just a few henchmen, you must use those infamous fingers to tap your way to power and riches!

• … Or fire them!

• … Or have your employees invest for you!
• Decorate your office with a huge range of cool super villain stuff
• Upgrade your fingers for more idle clicking power.
• Upgrade your HQ and move to a volcano, secret fortress, Santa’s workshop and more!
• Defend your dungeon from rival villains using hand to hand combat.
• Accumulate vast riches and make trillions of coins.
• Enjoy hours of evil idle clicker fun.
★ BUILD AN ARMY OF LOYAL HENCHMEN
Recruit henchmen to your cause – from the legendary Big Bad Wolf to Foxx the Cyborg, each character has their own unique skills to help your quest to become an evil titan. Upgrade your henchmen to improve their success rate in trades, intel gathering rate and combat skills.
★ INVEST & TRADE IN THE BLACK MARKET
Using your knowledge as a business tycoon, you’ll have to invest and trade in questionable businesses and resources on the black market to make your evil quest a profitable one. View charts to predict the markets, get your henchmen to trade for you and – hopefully – make another trillion dollars! As you grow you’ll get fans and receive free gifts as a reward for being so damn evil!
★ DEFEND YOUR HEADQUARTERS FROM RIVAL VILLAINS
You can’t build an evil dungeon without making a few enemies along the way! Rival villains will attack your secret HQ and your henchmen will try their best to defend you. The better your henchmen

Tap That Tempo is a simple
bluejetty:00145720:ios.description:
Just tap along the beat of your favorite music to measure the BPM of any song.
"The perfect app for discovering BPM. Way faster and more accurate than anything that claims to be able to detect it automatically."
Tap That Tempo is a simple yet powerful utility for musicians, music producers, DJs, or anyone who wants to know the tempo of their musical ideas. Simply tap the button in rhythm with the music, and the app calculates the BPM using advanced algorithms.
Key Features:
• Precise BPM detection by tapping along the beat
• Automatic reset after customizable intervals (1-4 seconds)
• Clean, minimal interface designed for musicians
Perfect for:
• Discovering the BPM of songs
• Measuring tempo of musical ideas
• Quick tempo reference during music production
• DJs who need to know track tempos
The tempo tracking automatically resets after a few seconds, so you can easily measure multiple songs or sections. No complicated setup - just tap and get your BPM.

Snore no more! Get instant alerts for snoring (choose 1, 5, or 15 minutes). Customize alerts with sound, vibration, or both. Plus, advanced apnea detection alerts when breath-holding reaches dangerous levels.
AI-Powered Sleep Analysis:

Custom Sleep Programs:
Get personalized sleep routines to help you fall asleep faster, reduce night awakenings, and enjoy deeper, restorative sleep.

Track snoring and sleep talking with advanced detection. Uncover potential issues like sleep apnea with detailed insights.

Monitor and improve your sleep environment by identifying disruptive noises.

Drift off to over 200 soothing sounds, healing frequencies, and guided meditations tailored to your needs.
Sleep Stories & Sounds for All Ages:
Enjoy enchanting sleep stories featuring new characters, world classics, and soothing sounds to help everyone, including babies, sleep peacefully.

Chat with Pia:
Ask questions, review your sleep report, or get real-time personalized advice.

Sleepia helps you sleep better, detect potential health risks like sleep apnea, and improve your well-being in just two weeks. From advanced AI tracking to personalized programs, it’s the sleep app you’ve been waiting for.

Download Sleepia today and start your journey to better sleep and brighter mornings!

bluejetty:00097725:ios.summary:
MeAgain is the GLP-1 tracker app for shots and pills — the simple place to track every dose and everything in between.
Use MeAgain for Zepbound®, Wegovy® injection or pill, Ozempic®, Mounjaro®, Foundayo®, semaglutide, tirzepatide, oral GLP
bluejetty:00097725:ios.description:
MeAgain is the GLP-1 tracker app for shots and pills — the simple place to track every dose and everything in between.
Use MeAgain for Zepbound®, Wegovy® injection or pill, Ozempic®, Mounjaro®, Foundayo®, semaglutide, tirzepatide, oral GLP-1s and weekly injection routines.
GLP-1 tracking should not feel like another job. There is shot day, pill timing, food noise, low appetite, protein and water goals, side effects, weight stalls, progress photos and dose-day patterns. MeAgain brings the routine together with less mental load, less guesswork and one place to stay on top of what matters.
TRACK SHOT DAYS, PILLS AND DOSES
• Log GLP-1 shots and oral pill routines
• Track dose timing, injection sites and shot days
• Set shot reminders and pill reminders
• See medication-level context between doses
• Keep first-month GLP-1 tracking more organized
FOOD, PROTEIN, FIBER AND WATER
• Log food with photo, barcode and search
• Track protein, fiber and water when appetite is low
• Keep meals connected to symptoms, weight and dose days
• Sync movement and health data with Apple Health
SIDE-EFFECT TRACKER AND JOURNAL
• Log nausea, constipation, reflux, fatigue and custom symptoms
• Track timing, severity and notes
• See symptoms beside food, water, weight and dose context
• Keep clearer notes to discuss with your healthcare provider
PROGRESS BEYOND THE SCALE
• Weight tracker and trend view
• Progress photos and Journey Cards
• Daily timeline for food, shots, pills, symptoms and movement
• Widgets, including Capy, to keep your routine visible
WHY MEAGAIN
Generic food apps focus on calories. Medication reminder apps focus on alarms. MeAgain is built for the GLP-1 routine itself: dose, site, food, protein, fiber, water, side effects, weight, photos and consistency together.
MeAgain is for tracking and education only. It does not provide medical advice, diagnose conditions, treat side effects, recommend dose changes or replace your healthcare provider. Always talk with your healthcare provider about medication decisions, side effects or health concerns.
Some features require a subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://meagain.com/privacy 
Terms: https://meagain.com/terms
Support: https://meagain.com/support

bluejetty:00118729:ios.description:
Actor App is an essential video/voice recording & networking app that's built by industry professionals specifically for actors to find acting jobs & create/share self tape auditions seamlessly with their team of managers, agents, production and casting.
Find Acting Jobs Locally and Worldwide. Actor App works in tandem with Casting Workbook, one of the leading platforms for casting online in the world with over 330,000 acting roles cast to date.
Filter for Acting Auditions Right For You. Use filters to quickly find jobs that you are interested in. Narrow the job search by project type, role, age, gender and more. Use My Jobs to keep track of casting audition drafts and submissions.
Add or Create Self Tape Auditions. Our Audio & Video Recording features are a powerful and simple way to customize your reel for unique submissions to each role of interest. Easily adjust zoom, lighting and shoot multiple takes (including slates) to help you guarantee network audition standard quality.
Edit Your Audition Reel Quickly & Easily. Add captions, titles and fades, trim clips and send individual clips or drag and drop to organize mulitple clips together.
Audition For Acting Roles. Apply directly to listed roles in our network by uploading your audition photos/videos, skills, resume and more.
Add Skills, Photos, Audio/Video Demos & Your Resume. Showcase your talent to Casting Workbook's network of industry professionals by taking pride in your Acting App Profile. All of your auditions, demos, skills & materials are directly searchable to your agents & managers.
Share Your Online Auditions With Other Casting Services. Actor App is integrated with industry leading software to make communication easy. Send emails featuring audition clips to casting & production. Alternatively, your agent can request these materials to sent to their Casting Workbook dashboard for approval prior to submission.
Casting Workbook was contracted by Twentieth Century Fox feature film casting to create the first online audition management solution. We are proud leaders in the digital audition industry with access to a large network of agents, production and casting. Experience the most powerful, integrated audition and recording App for Actors in the world. Self-Tape professionally with ease! Just some of the key professional functionality for video capture includes your ability to easily adjust lighting, zoom & shoot multiple takes including slates. Drag-and-drop multiple clips or trim them to send individually. Add captions, titles & fades to make your materials more professional and descriptive.
Download Actor App to get started for free, or unlock pro features with Actor App Pro.
Pro plans automatically renew unless turned off at least 24h before the current period ends. Payment is charged to your iTunes account and can be cancelled at any time. Any unused portion of a free trial will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription. Manage your subscription by going to your account settings.
By downloading this app you are agreeing to Casting Workbook’s Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.castingworkbook.com/privacy.asp

Airrosti has a proven track recor
bluejetty:00149865:ios.description:
Airrosti Remote Recovery connects you with an experienced provider who will help you understand your condition, prescribe an individualized recovery plan, and give you the tools you need to live pain free.
Airrosti has a proven track record of effectively diagnosing and resolving most musculoskeletal conditions. Now, we’re able to bring our effective and efficient care to you as a convenient, affordable, and effective digital solution.
CONSULTATION & EVALUATION
You’ll begin with a video consultation with a licensed Airrosti Provider who will walk you through a step-by-step orthopedic evaluation to help accurately diagnose your injury.
CONVENIENT CARE
Your Provider will prescribe a customized recovery plan, tailored to your condition and needs. You’ll receive easy-to-follow mobility and stability exercises you can do at home, delivered directly through the Airrosti Remote Recovery App.
OUTCOME-BASED PROGRAM
Your recovery is tracked in real-time through the app, and your Airrosti Provider will modify your personalized recovery plan as needed to ensure your continued improvement.
CONSTANT SUPPORT
Your Provider will be with you every step of the way to help you stay on track and support you during your recovery. In addition to scheduled video check-ins, in-app messaging gives you unlimited access to your Provider — anywhere, anytime.
CARE COORDINATION
Your Provider will educate you on the specifics of your injury and prescribe an individualized recovery plan. If your injury cannot be effectively resolved through Airrosti Remote Recovery, your provider will assist you with an appropriate care referral.

bluejetty:00100321:ios.description:
Dive into 《Color Sort & Paint》, a soothing yet engaging puzzle game that combines the satisfying challenge of color sorting with the creative joy of painting! Sort colorful liquids to unlock vibrant pigments, then use them to bring beautiful line art to life. Perfect for unwinding while giving your brain a playful workout!
How to Play?
1. Color Sorting Challenge
Sort the Liquids: Tap any bottle to pour its colored liquid into another.
Match Colors: Only pour if the top colors match and the target bottle has space.
Complete the Bottles: Fill each bottle with a single color to clear the level!
2. Unlock & Paint
Earn Pigments: Every sorted bottle rewards you with vibrant pigments based on the colors you mastered.
Paint Masterpieces: Use your collected pigments to fill in stunning black-and-white sketches, transforming them into dazzling artworks!
Why You’ll Love It
Double the Fun: Two relaxing games in one—solve puzzles, then unleash your creativity!
No Rush, No Stress: Play at your own pace with no time limits.
Endless Relaxation: Hundreds of unique sorting puzzles + a growing gallery of art to color.
Satisfying & Rewarding: Watch chaotic colors turn into orderly hues, then see blank canvases burst to life!
Download Now!
Ready to sort, collect, and paint? 《Color Sort & Paint》 is the perfect blend of brain-teasing puzzles and artistic joy. Let’s create something beautiful—one drop at a time!

bluejetty:00179732:ios.description:
If you have photo with poor quality, or want to increase resolution this app is for you. It will enhance image quality automatically just with one tap using machine learning technology.
It's very simple, first you import photo with bad quality from gallery or take new one with camera, then tap on one button, wait a bit, and get photo with good quality. You can compare enhancement results in detail in real time by the looking at the photo before and after.
Technology is optimized to work with images with faces, but also works fine with all other kinds of photos. You can share enhanced photo with other apps like social networks, messengers, photo editors, etc or save to gallery.
Typical use cases: 
- Fix pixelated and blurry photos
- Restore photos
- Remove image resize artifacts
- Enhance image quality
- Increase image resolution
- Improve image details
- Enhance facial photos

bluejetty:00126721:ios.description:

「ニフティ不動産」の不動産情報アプリは、SUUMO（スーモ）やLIFULL HOME'S（ライフルホームズ）、athome（アットホーム）など8つの有名な不動産サイト（※1）の新築/中古マンション、新築/中古一戸建て、土地情報をまとめて掲載しています。

調査手法：公開情報および関係者へのヒアリング等を基に、現時点での累計データを比較・検証したものです。実際の数値とは異なる場合がございます。

bluejetty:00031523:ios.description:
You are new to 3x3 Cube. You've tried all sorts of rotations but still can't solve your 3x3 cube.
Let "Easy 3x3 Cube solver" App help your friend!
With the option of 2 very intuitive manual and camera input methods will help you enter your 3x3 cube easily. The application will then check and give you a way to solve your 3x3 cube quickly and accurately.
The step-by-step solving mode will help you follow the instructions so that your 3x3 cube returns to its original shape quickly.
If you know how to solve a 3x3 cube, you can also play to see who can solve the number of steps faster.
This is a very interesting app that I hope you will like.

The dragon Zantorian locked Prince Rupert away in a castle tower on a dangerous and mysterious island. Lord Baldor dispatches the princess
bluejetty:00168155:ios.description:
The Apple Arcade hit Kings of the Castle is now available on the App Store for FREE. NO ADS. NO IAP.
The dragon Zantorian locked Prince Rupert away in a castle tower on a dangerous and mysterious island. Lord Baldor dispatches the princess to investigate the hostile and unfamiliar territory and save the prince. 
Playing as the princess, you must use your speed, courage, and savvy sense of direction to save the prince. Avoid traps, battle enemies, jump over obstacles, and collect gems along your journey to pay a ransom for the prince's safe return. But do it fast. The dragon is hungry! 
Kings of the Castle is colorful rescue mission and speed run you can play by yourself, or with family and friends in multiplayer mode. 
Kings of the Castle highlights:
Play With Friends: Grab up to four friends and play together online. Invite friends and family to go for a run using iMessage. 
Rescue Mission: Each island level has a main rescue mission to save the prince.
Speed Runs: How fast can you complete all nine speed runs?
Play Offline: Kings of the Castle can be played entirely without an internet connection in single player mode.

bluejetty:00070109:ios.description:
Dynamic matches await you in the universe of the world-famous Warface shooter! Enjoy various combat modes, easy-to-learn controls, and amazing graphics. Create a unique character and break into exciting multiplayer PvP matches designed specifically for mobile devices!
Warface: GO is actively growing and developing: new maps, weapons, equipment and character skins regularly appear in the game, as well as unique new game modes and events in which you can receive valuable rewards. The team is constantly improving the game optimization and matchmaking system with each update, providing the best gaming experience for fans of mobile first-person shooters.
Warface: GO is:
- 7 awesome maps for dynamic PvP battles;
- 4 game modes and more than 20 mini-events in which the conditions change every day;
- More than 200 types of customizable weapons and equipment;
- 15 skins to alter your character's appearance - and the list is constantly updating!
PVE MISSIONS AND CO-OP RAIDS
Get a series of brand-new special weapons and gear, and play as a team of four to smash through enemy hordes and dangerous bosses. Unearth the latest Blackwood plot!
Warface: GO is a military team-based action shooter in which everything depends on your skill. Carefully consider your tactics for each battle, explore different locations and modes, develop your shooting skills, upgrade your equipment and demonstrate your superiority!
INTUITIVE CONTROLS
You can easily master Warface: GO! Even if you are new to the world of mobile shooters, you will become familiar with the game controls in no time.
SKILL DETERMINES EVERYTHING
The game provides dynamic team gameplay in perfectly balanced maps designed specifically for mobile gaming. Take part in exciting matches and enjoy the intense action!
FULL CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION
Is it important for you that your character's appearance reflects your playstyle perfectly? Warface: GO gives you this opportunity! Dozens of pieces of equipment and many skins will allow you to create a unique, memorable character and stand out among millions of other players!
If you have any problems with the game, please let us know: warface@inn.eu
Join our communities to stay up to date with the latest game news:
Facebook: facebook.com/WarfaceGlobalOperations/
Discord: https://discord.gg/ttJCTXW

bluejetty:00063779:ios.name: MyPianist: A.I. accompanist
bluejetty:00063779:ios.summary: Play classical music with a virtual pianist that listens and reacts to your playing like a real musician. Designed for professionals, students and amateurs alike, MyPianist lets you augment your music-making through the power of artificial
bluejetty:00063779:ios.description:
Play classical music with a virtual pianist that listens and reacts to your playing like a real musician. Designed for professionals, students and amateurs alike, MyPianist lets you augment your music-making through the power of artificial intelligence.
== Expressive Freedom ==
MyPianist recreates the piano accompaniment in real time reacting to all the nuances of your interpretation. The app’s advanced AI masters a great variety of musical styles and situations, and with its fast reflexes it can catch you even if you miss a note or two.
== Expanding Repertoire ==
The growing music library of MyPianist includes hundreds of works of the core classical repertoire as well as rarities to be discovered. The concertos, sonatas and other large-scale works are always available in their entirety.
== Powerful Practice Tools ==
Enhance your music practice with tools tailored for an effective learning process. Choose between several practice modes designed for different styles of practice. Create customized practice loops to master difficult passages. Use our Practice Assistant to get detailed live feedback about your intonation and rhythm. Automatically record and review your practice sessions.
== Simply Elegant ==
MyPianist’s clean and uncluttered interface lets you focus on what matters most: music. Our beautifully engraved scores, enhanced with interactive elements such as adjustable metronome marks, adapt to your screen for an optimal reading experience on any device.
== Outstanding Artistry ==
MyPianist is truly created by musicians for musicians: the app is developed by Juho Pohjonen, an internationally acclaimed concert pianist who has performed as a soloist with major orchestras such as Cleveland Orchestra and Los Angeles Philharmonic.
== And Much More ==
Fine-tune the sensitivity of the accompaniment. Annotate music with easy-to-use tools. Transpose the accompaniment to different keys. Discover all the features of MyPianist by downloading the app!
Note Regarding Subscriptions:
MyPianist is free to download and to use. In order to access the complete library and all the features of the app a paid subscription to “MyPianist PRO” is required. We offer two auto-renewable subscriptions: “Monthly Subscription” and “Yearly Subscription”. When purchasing either of the subscriptions payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase.
Please review our Terms of Use
https://mypianist.app/termsofuse.php
and Privacy Policy
https://mypianist.app/privacy.php
before installing and using MyPianist.

bluejetty:00166040:ios.description:
EXTENSION.app is the all-in-one extension app for iOS, iPadOS, iMessage, watchOS, macOS, tvOS and visionOS.
■■■ EXTENSION.app for iOS and iPadOS
■ In-App Web Browser:
- Automatic activation of "Picture-in-Picture" video mode on supported websites.
- Simultaneous playback of "Picture-in-Picture" video with other video apps, without sound.
■ In-App Video Picker:
- Selection of video files from Files app, iCloud Drive and On My Device directories.
- Selection of music videos from Music Library.
- Selection of videos from Photo Library.
- Simultaneous playback of "Picture-in-Picture" video with other video apps, with or without sound.
■ Share extensions:
- Player > Picture-in-Picture: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos.
- Player > Picture-in-Picture Mix: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos to play simultaneously with other video apps, without sound.
- Player > Fullscreen: extension activates Fullscreen mode for videos.
- Player > AirPlay: extension activates AirPlay for sharing video to another device.
- Player > Background Audio extension plays video in background.
- Supported apps: Safari, Photos, Files, Messages and other apps with a Share button.
■ Safari browser extensions:
- Player > Picture-in-Picture: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos.
- Player > Picture-in-Picture Mix: extension activates Picture-in-Picture mode for videos to play simultaneously with other video apps, without sound.
- Player > Fullscreen: extension activates Fullscreen mode for videos.
- Player > AirPlay: extension activates AirPlay for sharing video and audio to another device.
- Player > Background Audio extension plays video and audio in background.
- Player > Mute: extension mutes or unmutes video and audio.
- Player > Loop: extension loops video and audio playback.
- Player > Skip Forward and Backward: extension skips forward or backward 15 seconds of video and audio.
- Player > Next: extension skips to the next video and audio, or skips to the end of video and audio.
■ Shortcuts:
- Collection of Shortcuts to launch X.app from Home Screen, Action Button, Tap Back or automation.
- "Browser" shortcut to open In-App Web Browser with On Screen website, Clipboard or list of suggested websites.
- "Browser > Favorite" shortcut to open favorite website.
- "Files" shortcut to open Files picker.
- "Photo Library" shortcut to open Photo Library picker.
■■■ EXTENSION.app for iMessage
- Activation of "Picture-in-Picture" video mode via Copy&Paste and Drag&Drop of a video or a website URL from a conversation.
■■■ EXTENSION.app for watchOS
■ In-App Web Browser:
- Input of a website URL to open a website.
■ Web Search:

bluejetty:00071285:ios.description:
Educational video game for children from 6 years. Travel through the human body and discover how it works inside!
TAILORED FOR KIDS OF ALL AGES
A mysterious virus from outer space is threatening mankind, and your best friend Finn is the very first patient infected! But not everything is lost, as the young team of scientists led by Max, Jin, Lia and Zev is here to help. Using their cutting edge nanobots technology, they will be able to get themselves into Finn’s body and combat the virus and its destruction all along Finn’s organs to save his life, and at the same time, also the future of humanity.
Hold on to the nanoskate to slide through the human body systems and save Finn, but remember, you will need to get the nanobots solution to heal him. Get them by solving fun science challenges across the body systems: musculoskeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory, nervous… overcome them all to save your best friend… and the world!
EVERY BODY SYSTEM IS AN ADVENTURE
Have fun with over 25 levels and negotiate all kinds of obstacles in order to get the disk that unlocks the nanobots solution. It will be a real adventure—you'll have to deal with viruses, giant rolling stones, sticky walls, typhoons, puzzle games, toxic smoke, etc. It will surprise you!
UPGRADE YOUR SKILLS
Improve your knowledge of the human body to unlock new forms and skills for your nano-tool: vacuum express, laser scalpel, extinguisher… and more! Use them all to overcome all the dangers that await inside the human body and build the cure. 
EDUCATIONAL CONTENT
For children aged 6-7:
. Musculoskeletal system: Main elements, most important bones and muscles, difference between bones and muscles.
. Nervous system: Basic elements, sense organs, perception through different senses.
. Digestive system: Main organs, healthy eating habits, different foods and flavors.
. Respiratory system: Main parts, difference between inspiration and expiration, healthy habits.
. Circulatory system: Main organs and their functions.
For children aged 8-9:
. Musculoskeletal system: Elements, up to 10 bones and 8 muscles names, difference between bones and muscles.
. Nervous system: Organs (brain, cerebellum, spine, neurons and nerves) and their functions, basic parts of the eye, basic parts of the ear.
. Digestive system: Elements, digestion process and foods classification according to their nutritional value.
. Respiratory system: Organs, inspiration and expiration process.
. Circulatory system: Organs and their functions.
For children aged 10+ and adults:
. Musculoskeletal system: Joints and cartilages, deeper knowledge of the musculoskeletal system.
. Nervous system: Parts of the eye and their functions, parts of the ear and their functions
. Digestive system: Parts and their function in the digestion process, food wheel for a balanced diet, different foods and their nutrients.
. Circulatory system: Process of blood circulation, main arteries and veins, parts of the heart.

bluejetty:00071431:ios.name: Picture Keeper Connect
bluejetty:00071431:ios.summary:
Mobile Backup Simplified.
Whether you've run out of space or just got a new phone, backing up your precious memories is essential — and it makes room to keep creating new ones! Picture Keeper plugs directly into your phone or tablet for a
bluejetty:00071431:ios.description:
Mobile Backup Simplified.
Whether you've run out of space or just got a new phone, backing up your precious memories is essential — and it makes room to keep creating new ones! Picture Keeper plugs directly into your phone or tablet for a simple, easy download of your mobile files right to a portable drive. Easily transfer photos, videos, and contacts from your mobile device directly to your Picture Keeper drive, free up valuable space on your device, and use our Photo Scanner to digitize physical photos while reducing imperfections. Our comprehensive suite of free photo tools helps your memories truly shine!
Why Picture Keeper Connect?
On-The-Go — A must-have during travel, Picture Keeper can be used anytime and anywhere, no Wi-Fi needed.
Free Up Space — Backup your device to Picture Keeper, then delete the photos and videos off your phone to make room for more, knowing they're safe and secure.
Compatible — Works on all major mobile devices and computers. Picture Keeper recognizes each device and remembers where each backup left off, making it easy to share with the whole family.
Secure — Your files are always kept private and protected.
Convenient — Want to show someone pictures from your computer or another device? Just plug Picture Keeper Connect into your smartphone to view, manage, and share those files!
Backup & Restore — Have an old phone full of awesome pictures and videos, or a broken phone that needs replacing? Easily transfer your photos, videos, and important files from one device to another with Picture Keeper Connect.
Take Your Protection Even Further with KeepSafe!
With KeepSafe, your memories get an extra layer of protection beyond your Picture Keeper drive. KeepSafe stores an additional copy of all your files in unlimited, private, secure cloud storage, with automatic backup that runs quietly in the background so you never have to think about it. Your subscription also includes lifetime drive replacement — if anything ever happens to your Picture Keeper, we'll replace it — plus a digital beneficiary feature that ensures your memories can be passed on to the people who matter most.
For over 15 years, Picture Keeper has been the most trusted name in photo backup solutions.

bluejetty:00070798:ios.description:
FREE Try Before You Buy trial, your App Store account is not charged by Apple during the free trial.
The Measure Master Pro app from Calculated Industries allows you to solve U.S. and metric unit conversions on your iPhone or iPad. 
Get professional results every time with this handy and easy-to-use tool for projects involving measurements.
Ideal for Designers, Tradespersons, Woodworkers, Craftsmen, Fabricators, Technicians, and Students.
-----
MULTI-DIMENSIONAL UNIT CONVERSION
-----
• Convert between feet-inch-fractions, inch fractions, yards, and decimal feet and inches (10ths, 100ths)
• Utilize full metric conversions, including meters, centimeters, and millimeters
• Effortlessly switch between U.S. and metric units, ideal for international projects
-----
ADVANCED WEIGHT CALCULATIONS
-----
• Calculate weight in pounds, tons, metric tons, and kilograms
• Determine weight per volume for materials management
• Essential for accurate material estimation in construction and fabrication
-----
GEOMETRY SOLUTIONS
-----
• Instantly solve for circle area, circumference, and arc lengths
• Ideal for designers and craftsmen working with circular designs
• Enhance accuracy in geometrical calculations
-----
COMPREHENSIVE DIMENSIONAL ANALYSIS
-----
• Solve for linear, area, volume, and perimeter dimensions
• Length, Width, and Height keys for quick calculations
• Reduce errors in dimension estimation, crucial for tradespersons and technicians
-----
USER-FRIENDLY INTERFACE
-----
• Developed by the creators of the Construction Master(™) calculators
• Input numbers as you would naturally say them
• Built-in help with clear definitions, explanations, and examples
-----
PRECISE MATH AND CONVERSION TOOLS
-----
• Includes preset fractions from 1/2" to 1/64" for detailed work
• Conversion capabilities for Decimal Degrees and D.M.S.
• Comprehensive for all types of mathematical and conversion needs
-----
DEDICATED FUNCTION KEYS
-----
 • Linear measurement keys for feet, inches, yards, meters, etc.
• Area and Volume calculation keys for various units, including acres and cubic meters
• Specialized keys for weight and weight per volume calculations
-----
SPECIALIZED PROFESSIONAL FUNCTIONS
-----
• Entry Editing Backspace Key for easy corrections
• Cost per Unit function for simple pricing and cost analysis
• Advanced Paperless Tape feature to review past calculations
-----
CUSTOMIZATION AND MEMORY FEATURES
-----
• Board Feet calculation function for woodworking projects
• Customizable preferences to set user-specific options
• Memory function to store and recall past calculations
-----
INTUITIVE DESIGN AND HELP FEATURES
-----
• Designed for ease of use by students, craftsmen, and professionals
• Comprehensive help features for all functions
• Streamlined interface for quick and easy calculations
Whether you're a student, designer, tradesperson, or technician, this app is the perfect companion for all your measurement and conversion tasks.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
The first 7 days are free. Subscriptions offered will automatically renew at the end of the chosen period. Payment will be charged to your Apple account upon purchase confirmation. The subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off or the subscription is canceled in settings at least one day (24 hours) before the subscription period ends. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your Apple account Settings > Subscriptions. 
LEGAL
