bluejetty:00119905:ios.description:
Audipo is a versatile music player capable of altering the playback speed of music files.
This app proves to be valuable for various purposes such as music transcription, musical practice, language learning, dance rehearsals, and enjoying lengthy audio content.
It can even be utilized as an audiobook player and for playing recorded radio broadcasts.
Key Features:
- Adjust audio playback speed within the range of 0.25x to 4.0x .
 * This application enables speed adjustments (both acceleration and deceleration) without altering the pitch.
- Enhanced audio controls designed for prolonged audio tracks.
 Utilize multiple seek bars for precise navigation within lengthy audio content.
- Marking feature integrated into the audio track.
 You have the ability to place markers anywhere within the audio timeline. These markers facilitate repeated playback from your chosen positions.
- Partial repeat playback functionality.
 Effortlessly repeat specific sections of a music file.
Pro Version (Available via in-app purchase):
- Ad-Free Experience
- Continuous Playback
- Resumable Playback
- Apple Music Compatibility (Please note that speed changes are not supported in iOS 15.4 and 15.4.1)
- Headset Button Integration
This music player significantly benefits users seeking to listen to specific portions of music on loop (e.g., for music transcription purposes).
Furthermore, it proves useful for accelerating playback (e.g., for audiobooks or radio content) or slowing it down (e.g., language learning).
 A purchase will be applied to your iTunes account on confirmation.
 Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled within 24-hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime with your iTunes account settings.
 For more information, see our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.

Privacy Policy: https://devcice.com/audipoios/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00119740:ios.name: Vittle Pro Video Whiteboard
bluejetty:00119740:ios.summary:
Turn your slides, PDFs, and photos into narrated videos. Import a deck, hit record, then write and talk. Vittle Pro captures it all as a 1080p HD video that is ready the moment you stop recording, instantly.
One-time purchase. No subscript
bluejetty:00119740:ios.description:
Turn your slides, PDFs, and photos into narrated videos. Import a deck, hit record, then write and talk. Vittle Pro captures it all as a 1080p HD video that is ready the moment you stop recording, instantly.
One-time purchase. No subscriptions. No recording limits.
Create Video Screencasts from your Slides and Photos.
Vittle lets you easily narrate and annotate your photos and PDF slide decks to create highly engaging videos.
CREATE VIDEO SCREENCASTS, JUST BY WRITING AND SPEAKING
Import a PDF from Keynote, PowerPoint, or elsewhere into Vittle. Drop in photos from your camera roll. Hit record, and start talking.
It's that easy. 
Vittle works like a magic whiteboard that records what you write and say:
 - Annotate images and sketch using the ultra-smooth ink of our proprietary Inkflow Engine,
 - Add shapes, arrows, connectors, and text, then align and style them in a tap,
 - Resize and move anything around the page,
 - Zoom in to focus on key points,
 - Put yourself in the picture with the presenter camera,
 - Describe even complex topics in a clear and engaging way.
 - Record quick memos or entire lectures - hours and hours if you like,
 - Use any color you want with the fully customizable color palette,
 - Import PDFs of your slide decks,
 - Use sophisticated storytelling techniques with the Camera Lock tool,
 - And more.
POST VIDEOS TO YOUTUBE, SHARE THEM WITH ANYONE
Use Vittle to flip your classroom, or create engaging explainer videos for your products. Quickly annotate slides and share a video recording with your colleagues. Get your point across exactly and in an impactful way. Collaborate across time and space with any number of people.
Create personalized videos for your family and friends. Narrate your adventures with your photos. Stay in touch no matter where you are. 
VIDEO FILES THAT YOU OWN AND CONTROL
Vittle produces video files that you own. They can be easily shared on Facebook, YouTube, or elsewhere. You can also email videos directly, or securely post them to your company server. No third party service is needed.
NO WAITING
There's no lengthy encoding step or extra compressors to buy. Videos are ready the moment you stop recording, even on older devices.
PRO FEATURES FOR PRO EDUCATORS
Features in Vittle Pro include:
+ Unlimited video lenth
+ Unlimited projects, and pages per project
+ No video watermark
+ Import PDF slide decks and documents from Keynote, PowerPoint, and more.
+ Type text with multiple fonts.
+ 1080P HD Widescreen videos.
+ Custom image background for presenter videos
+ Additional shapes in the shape library
+ Adjust video speed 1.0 - 2.0x.
+ Camera lock and smooth pan.
+ Custom page background colors.
+ Color-Select (separate ink by color).
+ Flip selected ink.
+ Export to PDF and JPEG.
+ And more!
THE FUTURE OF CREATIVITY
We strongly believe that the iPad is a powerful creativity device. Vittle is a new kind of tool that's designed specifically with the iPad in mind. We can't wait to see what you'll do with it!

bluejetty:00024941:ios.name: Spanish for kids 3+ Speak Po
bluejetty:00024941:ios.summary:
A fun way to learn Spanish and build confidence in speaking.
Speak Pocket helps young children learn Spanish in a natural and enjoyable way through listening, repetition, speaking practice, and interactive activities. Through vocabulary ga
bluejetty:00024941:ios.description:
A fun way to learn Spanish and build confidence in speaking.
Speak Pocket helps young children learn Spanish in a natural and enjoyable way through listening, repetition, speaking practice, and interactive activities. Through vocabulary games, quizzes, and interactive audio stories, children gradually begin to understand and speak Spanish step by step. The app is specially designed for children aged 3 to 7, with a focus on early language awareness and building confidence in speaking from a young age.
As they progress, children can also discover other languages such as French, German, Italian, and Portuguese, making Speak Pocket a long-term language learning companion.
Spanish for kids — Listen, repeat, speak
Children learn useful vocabulary and simple sentences related to everyday topics such as animals, food, family, school, colors, and emotions. By listening to native speakers, they naturally develop clear pronunciation and an accurate accent. Short, fun, and engaging audio stories strengthen listening comprehension, while repetition and playful practice reinforce vocabulary and encourage children to speak Spanish with confidence.
Discover Speaky — The AI voice coach powered by Apple Intelligence.
Speaky is a friendly AI voice coach that encourages children to speak out loud through natural and varied AI conversations. It listens to their pronunciation and responses, and gently guides them to improve clarity and accuracy while providing positive feedback. This reassuring approach helps children gain confidence and enjoy speaking Spanish. It also builds on their answers and everyday topics.
WARNING: This AI conversation feature is only available on selected devices compatible with Apple Intelligence and requires iOS 26 or later.
Learn through play: words, stories, quizzes, and speaking
Learning with Speak Pocket is entirely based on play and interaction. Children discover new words through animations, images, and sounds, repeat vocabulary, guess meanings, and practice speaking. Story-based lessons develop listening and vocabulary, and the entire experience is designed for beginners, with no reading required.
New words and stories every month
New educational content is regularly added to maintain motivation and the desire to learn. Children gradually unlock new vocabulary, useful expressions, audio stories, and language games, while reinforcing their knowledge over time.
Safe for kids — No ads and no internet required
Speak Pocket provides a calm and safe learning environment for children. The app works offline, contains no ads, and offers carefully selected content. It is suitable for children from preschool to early elementary school, allowing them to learn Spanish independently and safely.
Speak Pocket — A pocket full of languages
Speak Pocket offers authentic Spanish pronunciation, listening and speaking exercises, simple vocabulary, and short beginner stories. Through educational mini-games and repetition-based learning, children build confidence.

bluejetty:00045577:ios.description:
SFCU Mobile Banking is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with SFCU Mobile Banking:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount.
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend.
Transfer money between your accounts.
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back.
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it.
View and save your monthly statements.
Find branches and ATMs near you.
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the SFCU Mobile Banking app, you must be enrolled as a Signature FCU digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00126525:ios.description:
Introducing the Thomson Reuters Authenticator: one app to verify your identity to access to Thomson Reuters software, providing an additional layer of security when signing in, helping you protect your data.
Whether using this app to access Thomson Reuters software for work or personal use, multi-factor authentication adds an extra layer of protection to your data, wherever your software or data are stored. The easy-to-use design makes it simple.
If you’ve enabled multi-factor authentication for any of your Thomson Reuters software, logging in to that software will trigger the Authenticator app to notify you on your device. Simply press approve (or use Face ID / Touch ID) to complete the sign-on process, or press ignore if you’re not trying to access the software at the time.
Software that works with Thomson Reuters Authenticator allows you to authenticate on three levels:
1) Something you KNOW (your login and password)
2) Something you HAVE (your mobile device with the Thomson Reuters Authenticator app)
3) Something you ARE (Face ID / Touch ID)
Features include:
• Automatic setup via QR code
• Support for multiple accounts
• Generate verification codes without a data connection

bluejetty:00095434:ios.description:
Mississippi Live Weather:
Mississippi's Trusted Weather Experts
Trust is Earned-and that's why Mississippi's weather team is bringing you the only 24/7 live, local weather stream designed from the ground up to keep your family safe.
And if you live in Mississippi, this is the only weather app you'll ever need.
With live severe weather coverage, life-saving alerts, interactive radar, and homescreen widgets for today's current and forecast weather, Mississippi’s Trusted Weather Experts will keep you and your family prepared and safe no matter what mother nature sends your way.
 WARNING YOU FIRST - KEEPING YOU SAFE
 LIVE Severe Weather Coverage
When severe weather threatens, seconds can be the difference between life and death. You don’t have time to wait for a delayed update from a national network. Our expert local team is on-air and online 24/7, giving you real-time, Mississippi-based life-saving warnings before the weather turns dangerous.
 Tracking the Threat - Interactive Radar – Real-time storm tracking with the highest resolution radar composite available anywhere. With a 2 hour future radar scan, see where and when rain, snow, and storms will hit you, in real time. 
 LIFE-SAVING ALERTS – WHEREVER YOU ARE
Severe storms, tornadoes, lightning, winter weather, and more —our real-time alerts follow you wherever you go.
 Exclusive Severe Updates: We use proprietary technology to give you an even earlier head-up to dangerous and twisting storms even before the NWS issues warnings
 Customizable Location-based warnings—no matter where you travel in the U.S., we’ve got you covered. Don’t care about heavy rain or lightning alerts? Just toggle them on and off.
 Video Updates - Forecast updates, directly from the Team You Trust.
Wherever life takes you, we’re watching the skies to keep you safe.
HYPER-LOCAL MISSISSIPPI FORECASTS 
Daily forecasts, breaking weather updates, and expert analysis—not generic national data, but Mississippi’s most experienced forecast team.
 Exclusive Mississippi Skycams – See the storm before it hits you with our live, real-time skycams across the state as part of a partnership with the NMSC.
 CLOSINGS, SHELTERS, AND YOU
When disaster strikes, know where to go. Our app will connect you to storm shelters, school & business closings, and vital safety resources to protect you and your family.
 Be Part of the Coverage – Your weather. Your story. Submit your videos and photos to be featured in our live broadcasts.
Mississippi’s weather can change in an instant. Be prepared. Be safe. Trust the experts who are Warning You First and helping you find your Safe Place when it matters most.
 Download the Mississippi Live Weather App now—because when seconds count, you can rely on Mississippi’s Trusted Weather Experts.

bluejetty:00039825:ios.description:
Everything you need for your knitting in one place.
Bring out your creative potential with Knit&Note – an app designed to make your knitting and crochet journey as easy, inspiring and enjoyable as possible. We're here to simplify every aspect of your crafting, allowing you to focus on unleashing your creativity and create beautiful, handmade items.
Key Features:
- Organize your projects effortlessly with detailed pages for patterns, yarn details, and more.
- Experience an expansive pattern library and dive into a wide range of high-quality knitting and crochet patterns, presented in a convenient and intuitive style, similar to popular streaming services. Ideal for crafters at any skill level.
- Buy the yarn and stash you need for your projects in our in-app yarn shop, and get it delivered to your doorstep
- Enhance your knitting with tools that helps you progress. Multi-functional pattern-viewer, featuring color highlighters, integrated row counters, increase/ decrease calculator, yarn calculator, ruler, video tutorials and more.
- Stay motivated and keep track of your progress with fun statistics that showcase your crafting achievements and growth.
- Efficient Yarn & Needle Inventory: Keep track of your crafting materials with ease, ensuring you're always prepared for your next project.
-Social Community where you can share, inspire, and connect with fellow crafters in a supportive and creative environment.
- Eco-Conscious Crafting: Embrace sustainability with our eco-friendly app, powered by 100% renewable energy.
Knit&Note isn't just an app; it's a catalyst for your creativity. It's designed to remove the hurdles in your crafting journey, leaving you free to explore, create, and share in a more organized, sustainable, and enjoyable way.

bluejetty:00016143:ios.description:
The most advanced Flight Simulator and Aircraft Carrier Landing System ever created.
Landing on an aircraft carrier is one of the most difficult tasks a pilot has to execute. The flight deck is only 150 meters long, just enough to stop the aircraft.
Accept the challenge, take on over thirty missions in the world's most dangerous and spectacular scenarios and join the best Top-Gun pilots.
Take control, climb into the realistic 3D cockpits and fly the most famous military aircrafts, faithfully reproduced.
Exceed your limits and get the excellence in all 90 engaging challenges!
Discover the REAL WORLD TECHNOLOGY and begin now to plan your flight!
WORLDWIDE NAVIGATION and FLIGHT PLAN with 500+ accurate AIRPORTS, DAY&NIGHT CYCLE, REALTIME METAR weather conditions, AIR SPACES CARTOGRAPHY with over 8,000 WAYPOINTS.
Try out the latest evolution of the RORTOS flight system, already appreciated by millions of users around the world: unprecedented graphics, realistic weather conditions and a REPLAY function that lets you review your flight moves and record video to immediately share with your friends.
For an even more thrilling experience, connect two devices online and activate the multi-screen mode.
Featuring:
* Game campaign with 6 training missions and 30 missions in 5 different scenarios
* WORLDWIDE TERRAIN AND NAVIGATION SYSTEM
* 90 new challenges
* Free flight with choice of weather conditions and time
* Landing competitions with worldwide ranking
* Multi-camera Replay with dynamic CINEMA view and option to save your videos
* Aircraft carrier landings, airbase landings and emergency landings
* Take-off, practice, transfers, recon and flights in formation with a flight guide
* Vertical take-off and landing (F35B Lightning II, AV-8B Harrier II)
* In-flight refuel
* More realistic extreme conditions with wind, rain, snow and lightning
* 3D virtual cockpit with integrated instrumentation, rain/snow effects and 6 different camera angles
 visual perspectives
* Radar with runway and aircraft carrier orientation
* Realistic fuel consumption
* Approach system I.F.L.O.L.S.
* Radio communication
* REMOTE CONTROL: you can connect two devices and use one of them like a remote control with a complete instrumentation view
Aircraft: 
* F/A-18 Super Hornet 
* F-14 Super Tomcat 
* C-2A Greyhound 
* F-16 Fighting Falcon
* AV-8B Harrier II (vertical)
* F35B Lightning II (vertical)
* MiG-29K Fulcrum
* F4E Phantom II 
* A-6 Intruder 
* A-7 Corsair II
* F-22 Raptor
* SU-47 Berkut
Scenarios:
* Islands
* Canyon
* Arctic
* Arcs
* Volcano
* Flight Simulator

bluejetty:00024720:ios.description:
Pic Scanner: Batch Photo Scanning for iPhone and iPad
----
The original, world's first app to scan and crop multiple photos with one click. Bring your analog photo collection into the digital present quickly and easily. Scan multiple photos at a time. Pic Scanner automatically crops, enhances, and corrects perspective using highly accurate AI.
Unbeatable value: A low, one-time, all-inclusive price for unlimited, forever use of all features. No ads, watermarks, subscriptions, sign-ups, or in-app purchases—your purchase is yours forever.
Essential Features
----
- Unlimited scans and full feature access.
- Accurate AI-powered auto-cropping
- Automatic perspective correction.
- Photo editing tools and filters.
- Add captions (date, place, description) to memories.
- Create unlimited albums and slideshows.
- Privacy assured: Your photos stay on your device (No server uploads)
- Back up to Mac, sync iPhone-iPad without expensive cloud subscriptions.
- Freely save & share photos to any computer, social network, messaging app.
- Universal purchase: Pay once and use it on both your iPhone and iPad.
Your Portable Photo Scanner
----
Turn your iPhone or iPad into a powerful, portable photo scanner. Scan your entire collection in hours, not days, with high-quality results.
Scan anytime, anywhere: No internet connection is needed. Digitize those unique photos only you or your relatives possess, then easily share them so everyone in the family can have a copy.
Note: For high DPI / PPI (pixels per inch) scans for photo books or high-resolution prints, digitize one or two pictures at a time.
Reviewers and Users Love Pic Scanner
----
- "Saves loads of time" - BBC Click
- "Deserving of the rave reviews" - Cult of Mac
- "40 Best Apps" - The Guardian
- "Who needs a desktop scanner?" - App Advice
Users say it's easy enough for a 7 or 77 year old and praise the friendly, prompt customer service.
We are dedicated to this app and want you to love it. Email us for fast, personalized advice. Check out the "5 Minute guide" on our website to get started quickly.
Upgrade Path
----
Pic Scanner is the perfect way to begin your photo scanning project. If you need more advanced and fun features later, you can upgrade anytime and seamlessly transfer your work to our pro app, Pic Scanner Gold, by simply paying the price difference.

Tabata Stopwatch Pro is a un
bluejetty:00031539:ios.description:
Tabata Stopwatch Pro is the ultimate Tabata Interval Timer that works for 'all' your interval training needs. You can use it with Tabata, HIIT, kettlebells, bodyweight exercises, interval running, sprints, etc.
Tabata Stopwatch Pro is a universal (both iPhone and iPad) feature packed interval timer for people who follow the Tabata training method. The main thing the Tabata app will aid you with is automating your exercise, rest, cooldown and other intervals. As simple as this sounds, it has a profound effect on your workout. You will be able to concentrate much better, won’t have to constantly count and honestly the whole workout just goes by faster. Try it with your Tabata, HIIT, kettlebells, bodyweight exercises, interval running, sprints, and other workouts.
Designed with both beginners and advanced users in mind Tabata Stopwatch Pro comes ready to use with basic Tabata already set up for you. As you gain more experience you can customize all intervals to match your pace. You may even create and store your own interval presets to quickly change to different workouts.
Tabata Stopwatch Pro is loaded with beeps that help identify what part of a workout you are in, interval beeps for example tell you when a new interval has started. Tabata Stopwatch Pro also has voice support that announces intervals to further help you focus on your workout. Oh and what would an exercise app be without music, select your favorite tracks from your iPod and blast through that workout.
The Apple Health app is supported and the Tabata app will write your Tabata workout times, calorie burned estimates and heart rates (needs a chest strap heart rate monitor) after each workout. 
By far the best app for Tabata training available for your iPhone and iPad, Tabata Stopwatch Pro includes:
+ Pro grade Tabata timer.
+ Ready to use out of the box. Classic Tabata already set up for you.
+ Simple to use, just push play.
+ Works on both iPhone and iPad.
+ Comes with 2 beautiful themes.
+ Color coded display visible from afar. Colors represent the amount of energy you are using in an interval.
+ Customize initial countdown and warmup time.
+ Customize exercise, rest, recovery and cooldown intervals.
+ Adjust the number of sets and cycles to match your pace.
+ Jump between intervals in the middle of a workout as needed.
+ Build presets to support your multiple interval training needs.
+ Pause your workouts if needed.
+ Works with the screen locked and in your pocket.
+ Interval beeps for each individual interval. Need a separate beep to mark when it's time to rest, no problem.
+ Interval vibration.
+ Continuous beeps.
+ Three second beeps.
+ Halfway beeps.
+ Voice assist so that you focus on your workout and not the screen.
+ Workout to music from your iPod.
+ Set music to pause to hear beeps and voice assist clearly.
+ Shuffle tracks or albums to suit your taste and workout. 
+ Apple Health support.
This IS the best app in it's class, just have a look at the reviews.
Health Disclaimer:
Exercising can be extremely stressful for the body, please consult your doctor, trainer or coach before using this app. This app does not aim to teach, coach or guide you with fitness, exercises or working out. It is a utility for people (adults only) who already know what they are doing and why. Further, calculations for workout times, calories burned and heart rates when working out are only approximations and should not be used for any medical purposes.

bluejetty:00071632:ios.description:
Welcome to a world where you can design, decorate, and merge your way to success! In this merge 2 game, you will help Elsa fulfill her lifelong ambition to design a world-class resort. If you love to decorate and enjoy the mechanics of a merge 2 game, you have found your perfect match. Dive into the ultimate design experience and show off your skills as you decorate every corner of the manor.
Elsa bought her dream house, but it is in terrible condition. The mansion requires a massive renovation, and she needs a partner who loves to design and decorate to save the day. Between a rival hotel owner trying to shut her down and a mysterious ""curse"" hanging over the city, Elsa has her work cut out for her.

bluejetty:00185732:ios.name: Classic Minesweeper :)
bluejetty:00185732:ios.summary: Minesweeper :) is Minesweeper + Score System, Played, and Online Leaderboards. Discover the next evolution of Minesweeper with amazing graphics, animations, and ease of use. This is a Minesweeper like one you have never experienced before.
bluejetty:00185732:ios.description:
Minesweeper :) is Minesweeper + Score System, Played, and Online Leaderboards. Discover the next evolution of Minesweeper with amazing graphics, animations, and ease of use. This is a Minesweeper like one you have never experienced before.
 A smart Score system, wherein your score is based on the value of each number and found mines multiplied by a multiplier that decreases in time.
 Online Leaderboards count Time, Played and Score for each difficulties.
【 Feature 】 
⊲ 3 Classic and 1 Custom difficulties. 
⊲ 11 appearances include classic style. 
⊲ Fully configurable, board size & number of mines. 
⊲ Support Facebook, Twitter, SinaWeibo and GooglePlus. 
⊲ Support both Portrait and Landscape mode. 
⊲ Support Game Center, 18 Leaderboards and 45 Achievements. 
⊲ Support iOS6 and iPhone5 device 
⊲ Support Retina High resolution display. 
【 Control 】 
Normal mode: 
⊲ Tap on a closed tile to open it. 
⊲ Tap and hold on a closed tile to flag it. 
⊲ Tap and hold on a flagged tile to put question mark on it. 
⊲ Tap and hold on a question mark tile to clear it. 
Quick Flagging mode: 
⊲ Tap and hold on a closed tile to open it. 
⊲ Tap on a closed tile to flag it. 
⊲ Tap on a flagged tile to put question mark on it. 
⊲ Tap on a question mark tile to clear it. 
Quick switch: 
▻ Tap on an open-empty tile to switch control between Normal and Quick Flagging mode
Quick open: 
▻ Tap on an open-numbered square next to that enough flagged tile to clear the rest.
Any reviews and ratings are all appreciated, your comments are making this Minesweeper app become better!!

bluejetty:00175750:ios.name: Wrist Temperature Tracker
bluejetty:00175750:ios.summary: How has your wrist temperature changed over the past nights? Wrist Temperature Tracker shows your Apple Watch readings as history, comparisons and widgets. For people with a compatible Watch who want a clearer view of their overnight data i
bluejetty:00175750:ios.description:
How has your wrist temperature changed over the past nights? Wrist Temperature Tracker shows your Apple Watch readings as history, comparisons and widgets. For people with a compatible Watch who want a clearer view of their overnight data in Apple Health. The app does not take measurements and is not an on-demand thermometer.
Try the iPhone app for six days after installation. Continued access then requires a monthly subscription, annual subscription, or one-time purchase. You can restore an existing purchase.
Before you start
- You need an Apple Watch that supports wrist temperature sensing.
- Wear it while sleeping. Track Sleep with Apple Watch and Sleep Focus need to be active for at least 4 hours per night.
- After setup or pairing, establishing a baseline usually takes about 5 nights.
- Allow the app to read wrist temperature from Health. If Health has no samples, the app cannot show any values.
Features
- Measured night readings over 7, 30 or 90 days, or one year. Missing nights stay visible.
- A monthly calendar with colours relative to that month's median, not a medical temperature threshold.
- Compare cycles using recorded period starts from Apple Health or your own local entries. The app does not write cycle data to Health.
- Widgets and complications for quick access to recent data
- Get notified when a new reading arrives: all readings, or only values below or above your absolute temperature thresholds. No on-demand measurement or guaranteed daily notification.
- A diagnostics area for Health data, notifications, and purchases
Temperature patterns do not confirm ovulation. Not for contraception or diagnosis.
Terms and conditions: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00022056:ios.description:
◉ Protect yourself by checking biorhythm daily.
Stamina, judgment, emotion, etc.
If you are not feeling well about the following measures, how about checking your biorhythm?
If your biorhythm does not function appropriately, it is recommended to avoid unreasonable activities. Something might you don't want to happen.
Biorhythm can be referenced in all areas of your life such as learning, sports and sales.
◉ It will advise your future.
Suddenly, some of the celebrities faced traumas
The cases showed that their biorhythms weren't good. Was it a coincidence?
◉ What is biorhythm?
Biorhythm is the physiological cycle of a physical, emotional, and Intellectual. These three cycles are repeated in a uniform pattern based on your birthdays, and there is a difference in activity efficiency or ability depending on the combination of these patterns.
The four rhythm cycles and calculations are as follows.
d = number of days of living
Physical rhythm: sin (2π d / 23)
Emotional rhythm: sin (2π d / 28)
Intellectual rhythm: sin (2π d / 33)
Intuitive rhythm: sin (2π d / 38)
Each rhythm has a value from -100 to +100, and this value indicates the status.
Low stage: -100 to -1
High stage: +1 to +100
Dangerous Days: 0 (at the time of transition from + value to - value or from - value to + value)
◉ Explanation of Application function
[Biorhythm]
• Display the four rhythms of a user as values and graphs
• Change dates easily to view biorhythms on multiple dates
• Connect with analysis function
[User]
• Integrated management of multiple users' biorhythms
• Connect to the biorhythm graph screen
[Analysis]
• List biorhythms of 31 days
• Extracting dates for state classification
• Performance analysis by biorhythm
[Union]
• Calculate the average of two or more users' biorhythms
[Share]
• Send biorhythm using messages or email
[Information]
• Summary of usage
• Help
• Contact the developer
◉ It is not a simple graph.
• Accurate data using formal algorithms
• Sophisticated and easy-to-see graphs
• Send biorhythm using messages or email
• Biorhythm integration management of multiple people
• Additional features different from other biorhythm apps
• Easy to use at anywhere, at anytime
• Preview of future biorhythms
◉ Notification
• If you have any questions, please use the email function on the app.

Grocery shopping is easier than ever with the Save-On-Foods app!
Whether you’re shopping on your mobile device using the Save-On-Foods app or from home on SaveOnFoods.com, your account is seamlessly linked. Save your shopping lists for in-store trips, or shop from the palm of your hand and let our personal shoppers do the work for you. Shopping Highlights
· Order groceries online
· View the latest Save-On-Foods flyer
· Scan More Rewards card in-store
· Load My Offers to More Rewards card
· Browse past purchases and favourites
· Browse store departments
· Browse Shoppable Recipes
· Scan Product Barcodes
· Pharmacy Refill
· Find the nearest Save-On-Foods location
Please note that the Save-On-Foods app uses your SaveOnFoods.com login information, does not support the use of your MoreRewards.ca login information.

How fun is it to capture the most precious moments of the year with a wink of rhythms? Let’s MUSIC your soul with the beat of hit songs. 
With Magic Tiles 3, you can play various types of music: pop, rap, acappella, EDM, jazz, instrumental. A thousand of songs is waiting for you. Let's explore more to find the rainbow in your mind. 
Magic Tiles 3 key features:
1. Appealing, modern and diverse music genres to satisfy every music taste! We have over 1000 songs waiting for you to conquer.
2. Finely-built online mode – connect with countless players all around the world. You can also invite your friends/enemies into a room and battle each other.
3. Weekly tournament comes with irresistible rewards.
4. Band mode where you can play with additional instruments such as guitar, piano and so many more.
Game’s rules:
1. Tap the black tiles
2. Avoid the white tiles
3. Expect to speed up with each song level
Log in to your Facebook account and share data on multiple devices
So, get ready to try out the most challenging piano game for free! 
Besides, to improve the game’s performance and offer a customized user experience based on your location we do ask for permission to access to your storage and location.
Become a real pianist now!
VIP SUBSCRIPTION
- Access VIP Features now to get a lot exclusive benefits
1. No Ads. No Disturb.
2. Unlock 50000+ premium songs and upcoming songs
3. Free Revives. Nonstop playing
4. Create your playlist and play playlist non-stop
5. Download songs to play offline. No wifi needed
6. Create unlimited private battle room to play in Battle Mode
- The subscriptions are $3.49 weekly, $9.99 monthly and $39.99 annually.
- You'll be able to play all premium songs and enjoy all VIP benefits for the duration of your subscription*.
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period.
Note:
* Albums and their related contents are not included subscription privilege and may need separate purchases to unlock.
* Price is equal to the value that "Apple's App Store Matrix" determines is the equivalent of the subscription price in USD.
Terms of use: https://www.amanotes.com/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.amanotes.com/privacy-policy/
*Support:
Are you having any problems? Send the email to magictiles3.support@amanotes.com or contact us in the game by going to Settings > FAQ and Support.
Magic Tiles 3 is from Amanotes, the number one music games publisher in the world, with over one billion downloads. Music lovers can interact with thousand of songs through our different apps. Why just listen to music, if you can also play with it? At Amanotes, we believe that “everyone can music!".

bluejetty:00114471:ios.name: My Dog Town: Animal Sim Games
bluejetty:00114471:ios.summary:
Dreamland Park

bluejetty:00114471:ios.description:
Dreamland Park
Behind hydrangea bushes in Dog Town lies a starlight-nourished lake—wish ripples glow silver. Residents built it: rainbow track with sparkles, pink vine swing, fireflies as a galaxy. Rotating heart cable cars hide bows; carousel leaves star prints. Puppies run with balloons at noon, warm halos at dusk—a joy haven.
Fairy Tale Forest
A century-old abandoned mine becomes a forest. Black branches twist with color-shifting grass, leaves carved with glowing incantations. Dewy lotus boats drift with petals and paw prints. An evil queen curses a princess puppy to sleep in a black-rose crystal coffin. Brave puppies with badges rescue her.
Strawberry Dessert Workshop
At Cherry Blossom Lane’s end, a pink workshop has a tinkling strawberry wind chime. Star-dew strawberries bubble pink. Grandma Puppy makes soufflés, star tarts, jelly cups. Strays get fish biscuits—sweet warmth.
Sea Train
Built from shipwreck wood and coral, it runs on ocean tracks pulled by starlight, stirring pearl bubbles. An old captain navigates mists and sunsets. It carries longing; night brings waves’ lullaby.
Hot Spring Inn
In a coastal valley, Grandma Puppy’s inn uses hot spring stones. Star springs glow milky white, mixing cherry blossom scent. Pools have heart pillows; warm tea and buns await. A peaceful retreat.
Puppy Cottage
On a cherry-blossom plain, cottages have dandelion roofs and dewdrop windows. Wind chimes ring; interiors have mats and storybooks. Departing guests get guiding flower seeds—soft beds await.
Nursery
At cherry blossom-dandelion border, a nursery exudes warmth. Aunt Puppy has toys and chews. She teaches star-gazing; evening brings cookies, fireflies soothe babies.
Spirit Realm
Above clouds, marigolds and moonlight weave it. Golden light covers petals; a river carries memory boats. Deceased puppies become gentle skeletons. They visit loved ones as fireflies, wait for reunion.
Star Experience Hall
At Rainbow Street’s end, a hall by retired stars has paw spotlights. Puppies sing, walk catwalks, get star badges. No winners—just joy.
Paradise
Beyond clouds, puppy kindness forms Paradise. Cloud carpets have paw prints; star flowers sing. Endless treats and climbing frames. Angel puppies give collars—reunions and warmth.
Woof Hospital
In a pine forest, a hospital has hot spring wards. Star-dew syrup calms nerves. Nurses massage; squirrels bring medicine. Heals wounds, finds homes for strays.
-----Subscription Service Description-----
1.Theme scene subscription:
Monthly Pass: $3.99 per month, with automatic monthly renewal
Annual Pass: $29.99 per year, automatically renewed annually
Ads Monthly Pass: $0.99 per month, with automatic monthly renewal
Warm Christmas： $2.99 per week, Automatically renew weekly
Happy New Year： $2.99 per week, Automatically renew weekly
Rabbit's Nest： $1.99 per week, Automatically renew weekly
2. The membership service will be paid directly through the iTunes account.
3. 24 hours before the subscription service expires, the system will automatically renew the subscription and deduct the corresponding fee according to the subscription type.
4. If you need to close the subscription service, please do so in "Account Settings" at least 24 hours in advance.
5.Service Agreement and Privacy Policy :
User Agreement (EULA): https://hdwl.site/ios_user_agreement_builder_en.html 
Privacy Policy: https://hdwl.site/hnhd_privatet_en.html

bluejetty:00084698:ios.description:
Die digitale Kundenkarte von Rossmann.
Genieße alle Vorzüge einer Kundenkarte mit der ROSSMANN-App – bei uns aber in digitaler Form. Das heißt einmal Herunterladen und immer Sparen! Zahlreiche Coupons und die aktuellen Angebote stehen dir in der App jederzeit zur Verfügung. 
Die wichtigsten Funktionen auf einen Blick:
• Startschuss zum Sparen
Für die Nutzung der ROSSMANN-App bedarf es keiner Registrierung. Solltest du jedoch schon bei einem unserer verschiedenen Rossmann-Dienste (z. B. Rossmann Online-Shop, Rossmann Fotowelt oder Rossmann babywelt) angemeldet sein, kannst du dich mit dem gleichen Account auch in der App einloggen. 
Registrierte Nutzer können jedoch mehr Vorteile und Funktionen gegenüber anonymen Nutzern erhalten.
• Zahlreiche digitale Coupons
Die ROSSMANN-App enthält eine große Auswahl attraktiver digitaler Coupons. Du hast die Qual der Wahl - ob vor dem Einkauf oder schon in einer unserer Filialen.
Sparen leicht gemacht – alles mit der digitalen Kundenkarte:
1. Aktiviere die gewünschten Coupons 
2. Zeige deine digitale Kundenkarte an der Kasse vor, damit diese per Handscanner erfasst werden kann. 
3. Alle aktivierten und zum Einkauf passenden Coupons werden automatisch eingelöst.
4. Freue dich über die Ersparnis! 
Damit du auf deiner digitalen Kundenkarte alle Coupons zur Hand hast, kannst du auch jeden bei Rossmann gültigen Papiercoupon einscannen. Die Papiercoupons sind somit digitalisiert und du kannst diese für deinen nächsten Einkauf hinzufügen und einlösen.
• Personalisierte Startseite – Alles Wichtige auf einen Blick
Siehe direkt deine Top-Coupons und lass dich von weiteren tollen Aktionen inspirieren 
• Einkaufen und Sparen – jetzt auch bequem von Zuhause 
Verpasse keine Angebote und shoppe bequem von zu Hause! Viele deiner Coupons können auch beim Online-Shopping eingelöst werden. 
• Offline? Kein Problem!
Für die Coupon-Einlösung ist keine aktive Internetverbindung notwendig.
• Aktuelle Angebote
Informieren dich über unsere aktuellen Angebote - wann und wo du möchtest. Blättere durch unser Prospekt und füge die Artikel zu deiner Einkaufsliste hinzu.
• Deine virtuelle Brieftasche
Deine aktivierten Coupons kannst du auf deiner Kundenkarte zu jeder Zeit einsehen - alles vereint an einem Ort und griffbereit, wie im wahren Leben. Dadurch vergisst du nie wieder die Einlösung deiner Coupons.
• Deine Kundenkarte - nur ein Code
Die digitale Kundenkarte enthält alle deine aktivierten Coupons. Für die Einlösung deiner aktivierten Coupons musst du nur noch deine digitale Kundenkarte an der Kasse vorzeigen. Das Kassenpersonal scannt den Code von deinem Smartphone ab und alle hinzugefügten Coupons werden eingelöst. 
• Für Sparfüchse
Registrierte Nutzer können regionale Vorteile erhalten und werden bei besonderen Couponaktionen berücksichtigt, je nachdem welche persönlichen Angaben vorliegen. Trage einfach deine PLZ ein und deine bevorzugte Stammfiliale.
Du möchtest wissen, wie viele Coupons du schon eingelöst hast und wie viel du dadurch gespart hast? Diese Informationen finden registrierte Nutzer auf der Kundenkarte.
• Jeder Einkauf lohnt sich!
Als App Nutzer hast du die Möglichkeit an Aktionen teilnehmen. Werden die benötigten Produkte so oft wie vorgegeben gekauft, erfolgt die Ausspielung eines Bonus-Coupons. Sammeln und extra Sparen!
Deine Meinung ist uns wichtig!
Du vermisst ein Feature, hast Anregungen oder ein Problem bei der Benutzung der App? Dann melde dich einfach bei uns, damit wir deinen Einkauf bei Rossmann zu einem besseren Erlebnis machen können.
Nutze die Feedback-Möglichkeit innerhalb der App oder schreibe uns an ios@rossmann.de.

bluejetty:00019326:ios.description:
Pinochle Palace – Experience the traditional card game live and play for free against real players.
Pinochle, the trick-taking card game with lots of fun! Comparable to games like Whist, Spades, or Euchre, Pinochle requires brains and a good memory. You can now experience it online for free in one of the largest card game communities online.
Whether you are a hardcore fan or a casual player, with us, you will always find the right opponent for every level of play. The joy of playing cards is our priority. We invite you to our card tables.
LIVE CARD GAME EXPERIENCE
- Live Pinochle games against real opponents at any time
- Active player community
- Chatting with other card game fans
EASY TO PLAY
- Without registration, just start playing
- Automatic player search for direct Pinochle play
- card meld filter at the touch of a button
PINOCHLE, AS YOU KNOW IT
- Original Pinochle playing cards or house cards with optimized legibility
- Various card decks: American, Pinochle, French, …
- Supported custom rules: American, No Kitty, Calling, and many more 
- Your game, your preferences, your rules
FAIR-PLAY COMES FIRST
- Constant support by our customer service team
- Independently tested and reliable card shuffling
- Flexible privacy settings in the Pinochle Palace
HOBBY CARD GAME
- Leveling up with game experience
- Stress relief and memory training with Pinochle
- Automatic participation in the league – who will be on the top?
- Tournaments and long-lasting tables to boost your endurance
HOW TO PLAY PINOCHLE
Binocle combines skills such as mental arithmetic, strategy, and memory. A double deck consisting of 48 playing cards in four suits is in use. You play by trick-taking and melding. The latter means announcing card combinations, the melds, which are assigned specific scores. After dealing, there is an auction for the "Kitty" consisting of 4 cards. Players bid values equal to the scores they want to achieve by melding their cards and taking tricks in the course of the game. If you win the auction, it is on: Now you play and must reach your value!
Like Pinochle Palace on Facebook
https://www.facebook.com/pinochlepalace/
Learn more about us and our games:
https://www.palace-of-cards.com/
NOTE:
You can download this app for free. It is permanently completely free to play. However, you can purchase optional game enhancements such as game chips, premium membership, and special playing cards within the game.
The game requires an active internet connection.
By downloading the app, you agree to our terms and conditions and our privacy policy.
TERMS & CONDITIONS:
 https://www.pinochle-palace.com/terms-conditions/
PRIVACY POLICY:
https://www.pinochle-palace.com/privacy-policy-apps/
CUSTOMER SERVICE:
If you ever need help, feel free to contact our friendly customer service:
support@pinochle-palace.com
Pinochle is intended for an adult audience. According to German law, Pinochle is not a gambling game. In our app, there is no real money and no real prizes to win. Practice or success in casino games without real winnings ("Social Casino Games") does not imply future success in games for real money.
Pinochle Palace is a product by Spiele-Palast GmbH (Palace of Cards). Playing with family, friends, or dedicated groups is one of the favorite pastimes for many people! Our mission is to give this joy of playing a digital home at the Palace of Cards and build a lively community of players through high-quality implementations of online card games.
We wish you a good hand
Your Pinochle Palace Team

bluejetty:00063651:ios.name: Logic Master: Brain Puzzles
bluejetty:00063651:ios.summary:
Logic Master — the tricky brain teaser puzzle game with 260+ mind-bending levels
Looking for a logic game that is brilliant, creative and a little bit strange? Logic Master is a free brain-training puzzle game built around unusual, tricky q
bluejetty:00063651:ios.description:
Logic Master — the tricky brain teaser puzzle game with 260+ mind-bending levels
Looking for a logic game that is brilliant, creative and a little bit strange? Logic Master is a free brain-training puzzle game built around unusual, tricky questions that need a creative approach. If you love logic puzzles, riddles and lateral-thinking brain teasers, this is the puzzle game you've been searching for.
Most people get stuck — because the real trick is to think outside the box. Every level is a quick mind workout that challenges your attention, memory and problem-solving in a fun, surprising way. And when the answer finally clicks, you'll smile (and maybe groan a little).
Why millions of players love Logic Master
260+ unique tricky puzzles and brain teasers, with new levels added regularly
Play 100% offline — no wifi or internet needed, anytime, anywhere
Simple one-finger tap and drag controls that anyone can pick up
Cognitive score that tracks your memory, focus, logic and reaction
Global leaderboards, achievements and star boards to compete worldwide
Lovely hand-drawn graphics, fun music and relaxing sound effects
A real brain workout, disguised as a game
Logic Master is a brain training game designed to sharpen attention, mental flexibility, visual and spatial processing and working memory. The more riddles and puzzles you solve, the more you boost the cognitive skills behind quick thinking, creativity and everyday problem solving. It's like an IQ test and a puzzle box rolled into one — a daily brain game that actually makes you smarter.
Think you're a genius like Einstein? Take on the tricky tests, beat your friends' high scores and find out how sharp your brain really is. Some puzzles look impossible at first glance — until you change the way you think about them.
Tricky puzzles for everyone
Whether you want a relaxing offline brain game for your commute, a daily brain teaser to wake up your mind, or hard riddles to challenge your friends, Logic Master has a level for you. There are no timers forcing you and no pressure — just you versus the puzzle, at your own pace.
How to play
Read each question carefully. Some puzzles are simple; others are tricky and need a different, creative approach. Tap, drag, shake, combine — the solution is rarely where you expect it to be. Stuck on a brain teaser? Use a hint and keep your winning streak going.
Download Logic Master now and start your daily brain workout — one clever puzzle at a time. Can you solve them all and become the ultimate Logic Master?

bluejetty:00145988:ios.name: Menstrual Calendar FMC
bluejetty:00145988:ios.summary:
FMC is an easy to use calendar to record and predict accurately your periods and fertile days. 
Easy to use tracking:
 * Record your periods and flow
 * Track your moods
 * Weight 
 * Wellness data: Happiness, Energy and Stres
bluejetty:00145988:ios.description:
FMC is an easy to use calendar to record and predict accurately your periods and fertile days. 
Easy to use tracking:
 * Record your periods and flow
 * Track your moods
 * Weight 
 * Wellness data: Happiness, Energy and Stress
 * Store daily notes
 * Optionally record your intimate relations and other fertility signs including temperature, symptoms, meds and cervical fluid.
Immediate feedback and predictions:
 * Calculate your cycle length automatically based on your data or set it manually
 * View/Email a Cycle Stats Report
 * Display your cycles at a glance on an easy to read calendar. It is discreet.
 * View your weight and wellness graphs right inside the App.
 * Pregnancy Mode: View your pregnancy week, day and trimester right on FMC's calendar.
Privacy by design:
 * Discreet pinwheel icon says “FMC”
 * Optional passcode with email recovery
 * Support for Touch ID/Face ID
 * Offline operation: no internet, account or online service needed for operation.
Customizable, make it personal:
 * Customize your data entry. Track what matters to you! Add/Delete items! (for example, turn off/on fertility data if you wish or track more signs and symptoms- your own or ours)
 * Select your favorite App Theme, make it yours!
 * Choose what to display: opt out of fertile days prediction or body tidbits if you are not interested.
 * No Internet? No problem, the app works great offline.
Notifications and Reminders:
 * Set reminders for periods and ovulations
 * Add your next periods to your phone calendar with a discreet message.
Compatible with Fertility Friend, Advanced Fertility Tracker:
 * Read educational tips and information about your menstrual cycle and your fertility signs
 * Sync/Backup your data with your free FertilityFriend.com account
 * Use the advanced fertility analytics provided by the Fertility Friend App
Simply enter your last period and your cycle length to get started. The calendar will then display your predicted period start days as well as your expected ovulation and most fertile days in color.
Double tap any day on the calendar to enter data (i.e. your period, cycle data and/or daily notes). To start a new cycle simply enter your period data. Your cycle length is automatically calculated as you enter more data.
The calendar is a period tracker as well as a way to document your cycle history. You can use an optional privacy code to better protect your data.
Designed and maintained by FertilityFriend.com.
Bug Reports/Comments/Suggestions:
https://FertilityFriend.com/contact.html
IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: This calendar uses only approximate predictions and cannot be used to schedule procedures, avoid pregnancy or anything where more accuracy would be required. It is intended for educational use only. Use at your own risk. Please consult your healthcare provider for any health concern. For more accurate analysis of your cycle please visit FertilityFriend.com.

ExYu Radio brings the radio of the whole Balkan region to you, wherever you are. Listen live to more than 2,700 FM and online stations from Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Slovenia.
Choose your country and start listening: Naxi, Radio S, Play Radio, TDI, Hit FM, Radio Lola, Narodni radio, Otvoreni, HR1, HR2, Antena Zagreb, Radio Dalmacija, BiG Radio, Radio M, Antena M, Radio Aktual, Val 202 and hundreds more.
Made for Serbians, Croatians, Bosnians and everyone from the region in Chicago, New York, St. Louis, Phoenix, Los Angeles, Pittsburgh, Detroit and across the U.S.: open it, tap a station and hear home live in seconds.
YOUR COUNTRY'S TOP STATIONS
• Top stations on the home screen, based on what people are listening to
• Switch country with one tap: Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, North Macedonia or Slovenia
• Recent stations and favorites always one tap away
• Fast search by station name or city
SOMETHING FOR EVERYONE
• Folk, pop, rock, dance, Balkan hits, 80s and 90s classics
• News, sports and local radio
• Station logos, live song titles, light and dark design
NEWS, ALL DAY LONG
• News from Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia, Montenegro, North Macedonia and Slovenia from trusted local sources
• The region, World, Business, Sports, Tech, Science and Entertainment
• Updated throughout the day
PODCASTS
• Top podcasts in your country, with new episodes every day
• Browse by category and language
MORE THAN RADIO
• Alarm clock that wakes you up with your favorite station
• Sleep timer with countdown, +15 minutes and a gentle fade-out, plus AirPlay
• Car mode with big, easy controls
• Local weather, quote of the day, horoscope, currency converter, speed test, Sudoku and quiz
• Available in 36 languages
PREMIUM

• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase
• The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID Account Settings
• Any unused portion of a trial period is forfeited when you buy a subscription

bluejetty:00042469:ios.description:
Transfun: Find Fun with Pride - Your Safe Transgender Dating App for LGBTQ+ Connections
About Us
Transfun is a dedicated dating platform for transgender individuals, as well as their allies, committed to fostering authentic connections within the LGBTQ+ and queer communities. We are proud to support both exploration and meaningful relationships, focusing on transgender rights, inclusivity, safety, and respect. Our mission is to create a welcoming space where transgender people and those who support them can connect, share experiences, and explore authentic relationships.
Who Can Join?
Transfun is inclusive of a variety of individuals within the gender-diverse community, including:
Transgender individuals (trans men, trans women, non-binary people, and genderqueer individuals)
Same-sex and non-binary individuals
Cross-dressers, femboys
Gay, lesbian, bisexual, and pansexual individuals
Allies who are curious or supportive of gender diversity and transgender experiences
Note: Transfun is open to respectful adults aged 18+; fake profiles are promptly removed to maintain the integrity of our community.
Our Mission
Safe Space: Create a secure and judgment-free environment for transgender men and transgender women to connect and thrive.
Education: Promote understanding of transgender identity and the experiences of transgender individuals through open dialogue and shared learning.
Equality: Promote the dignity and respect of all members, ensuring that everyone is treated with kindness and fairness.
Community: Foster a sense of belonging, trust, and freedom in every interaction between transgender people and their admirers.
What We Offer
Real-Time Connections: Chat instantly with transgender individuals and local admirers in a safe and welcoming space.
Authentic Dating: Build relationships grounded in emotional connections, honesty, and mutual respect with transgender women and transgender men.
Local Networking: Discover local friends and transgender events in your community, connecting with others who share your experiences.
Interest-Based Matches: Spontaneously connect with like-minded individuals who share your interests, regardless of gender identity.
Private Random Chats: Enjoy secure, anonymous conversations with members of the transgender community without fear of judgment.
Our Core Belief
"Transgender people are beautiful." At Transfun, we empower our users—whether single, in a relationship, or exploring new connections—to embrace their true selves confidently in a safe, gender-affirming environment. We offer a space where fun and safety coexist, allowing transgender individuals and their admirers to freely explore love, dating, and relationships without fear of discrimination.

bluejetty:00015729:ios.name: SpaceStationAR
bluejetty:00015729:ios.summary: SpaceStationAR is an augmented reality (AR) application that simulates the visibility of satellites in the night sky. With SpaceStationAR, you can easily spot the brilliant International Space Station, spectacular Starlink Trains, and vario
bluejetty:00015729:ios.description:
SpaceStationAR is an augmented reality (AR) application that simulates the visibility of satellites in the night sky. With SpaceStationAR, you can easily spot the brilliant International Space Station, spectacular Starlink Trains, and various satellites at the forefront of space exploration with your own eyes!
As your iPhone or iPad camera captures the scenery around you, SpaceStationAR overlays passes of the International Space Station, the Starlink Train (a group of Starlink satellites), and the Chinese Space Station onto the actual scenery. You can also use the app to find bright stars, galaxies, spacecrafts like Voyager 1 and Voyager 2, and even see the direction of major cities beyond the ground. SpaceStationAR also indicates the positions of geostationary satellites, making it a valuable tool for antenna installation. It can even forecast potential atmospheric re-entries of satellites.
You can easily access satellite orbits on maps and celestial charts in addition to the AR views.
The "Calendar" tab displays events like upcoming satellite passes and rocket launches within the next two weeks. You can choose a pass from the list and simulate it in AR.
SpaceStationAR also comes with an Apple Watch app and a "Today" widget. If you have a compatible device, you can conveniently check a simplified satellite forecast list without needing to open the main app.
List of Features
* AR simulation of satellite passes overlaid on real landscapes
* Real-time tracking of passing satellites (Exclusive to the paid version)
* Display of stars, galaxies, black holes, planetary probes, satellites, and world cities in AR (Visibility can be customized by type)
* Visualization of satellite passes on maps and celestial charts (Celestial chart feature is available in the paid version)
* Presentation of satellite orbits and current locations on a global map
* Calendar listing satellite passes within the next two weeks
* Support for newly launched satellites
* Turn on "Night Observation Mode" to switch AR and the celestial chart to a red-and-black color scheme, helping your eyes stay adapted to the dark (Night Observation Mode is available in the paid version)
* Offline app usage
* Forecasts potential atmospheric re-entries of satellites (currently in beta)
* Satellite pass notifications: Set notification times from 15 minutes to 6 hours before the event for accurate alerts. (Please allow background location updates for precise notifications. Disabling this feature may lead to inaccurate notifications when traveling long distances with the app closed.)
The LITE version of the app restricts AR mode display to 30 minutes before satellite passes and does not provide real-time AR functionality. Additionally, advertisements will be displayed at the bottom of the screen.
http://itunes.apple.com/jp/app/torisat/id361194118?mt=8

bluejetty:00023291:ios.description:
Apple Maps is the best way to navigate and explore the world - all with your privacy protected.

• Local Lists uses intelligent insights from Apple Maps to surface locally relevant places for meeting friends, dining, and more.
• Enhanced Flyover combines aerial imagery with AI to enable you to view cities in stunning detail.
Get around with ease.
• Plan up to 15 stops with multi-stop routing, and sync routes from Mac to iPhone automatically.
• Follow easy voice and lane guidance to stay in the correct lane before your next turn.
• Avoid delays with real-time traffic incidents like accidents and road closures.
• View speed limits and get alerts for speed and red-light cameras along your route.
• Report and see incidents like accidents, hazards, and speed checks.

• Get AR walking directions that overlay step-by-step guidance onto the real world around you.

Explore and discover places
• Explore the world with an interactive 3D globe featuring enhanced terrain details.
• Navigate major cities worldwide with detailed 3D features like elevation, landmarks, and crosswalks.
• Experience immersive ground-level exploration with Look Around.
• Discover places to eat, shop, and explore with curated Guides by trusted publishers.
• Search using natural language queries like “pet-friendly restaurant with free wifi.”
• Make reservations, view menus, or order directly within Maps.
• Ask Siri to find places you'd like to go.
• Save places and add personal notes in Places Library.
• Revisit your history anytime with Visited Places.
• Rate and add photos to places you've visited.
• Find directions to your gate at the airport or your favorite store in a shopping mall with indoor maps.
Maps on CarPlay
• Access your favorite and frequent destinations with one tap.
• Report incidents such as accidents, hazards, speed checks, and more.
• Share your ETA with friends and family members with ease.

bluejetty:00027790:ios.description:
ProBikeGarage is your ultimate bike maintenance companion. Whether you're into mountain biking (MTB), gravel, or road cycling, ProBikeGarage is here to improve your cyclist experience.
Stop worrying about your bike's health and condition. ProBikeGarage seamlessly integrates with your Strava and sends you maintenance notifications to ensure your bicycles are always at their peak! Enhance the longevity of your beloved bikes and gear, and increase your performance.
* Maximize gear lifespan: Increase the durability of your bicycle and components with automatic maintenance reminders, ensuring they work optimally for longer while reducing your costs.
* Effortless Strava integration: ProBikeGarage automatically synchronizes your Strava activities for a streamlined cycling experience. Get bike service alerts as soon as you save your ride on Strava.
* Ready for all cyclists: Customize your bike for various ride types, like indoor trainers, commutes, or races, ensuring it's always ready for any cycling activity.
Join thousands of cyclists worldwide at ProBikeGarage now and redefine your daily cycling life. Achieve effortless bike maintenance, increase components and gear lifespan, and boost your cycling performance.
## Key features ##
1. Effortless maintenance alerts:
 * Receive timely notifications for component maintenance or replacement. For example, when your MTB suspension fork hits 120 hours of use, your road bike waxed chain clocks 400 km, or your gravel tires reach 5000 km.
 * Extend the lifespan of your bicycle and components, ensuring optimal performance and reduced costs.
2. Strava integration:
 * Sync all your bikes and rides seamlessly from your Strava account to start monitoring your bike and parts' status.
 * Get real-time updates after each ride for a hassle-free experience. Your cycling gear will always be ready for your next activity.
3. Component registration:
 * Easily register your components and assign them to your bikes to automatically count their activities and keep track of their distance, moving time, etc.
 * Record all changes and part upgrades, compare durability and performance, record completed services, log your visits to the local shop, compare spare prices on available online stores, etc.
4. Customized component installation:
 * Install gear tailored to different ride types, like in real life. Automatically switch between rear tires and cassettes for indoor/outdoor activities, use lighter wheels for races, and add a front light for your daily commute. ProBikeGarage adapts to your cycling style effortlessly.

bluejetty:00131084:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00131084:ios.description:
Streets is the best way to browse Street View panoramas on iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch.
CONVENIENT
Drop a pin, search for a city or address or find a person from your contacts to view a nearby 360° street panorama. Street View coverage is displayed in blue. Switch the map to satellite or terrain mode or tilt and rotate the high quality vector map with 3D buildings.
EASY TO USE
Walking through panoramas has never been easier using the interactive, expandable mini map that also displays your viewing angle and field of view. Switch between different floors or take a trip down memory lane with “Timeline”. Virtually traveling abroad is even more immersive and fun with Live Panorama mode: Look around in the panorama simply by rotating the device.
INTEGRATED WITH OTHER APPS 
Streets is the ideal companion to the Maps app. Launch Streets from “Maps” for any location and quickly watch the Street View panorama. On iPad, drag a pin location from the Maps app, a contact, or a textual address into the Streets app to find nearby panoramas. Even geotagged photos can be dropped in Streets to find 360° spherical images near the photo location.
If you’re already using our location finder app Where To?, you’ll also be able to take advantage of tight integration with Streets to view your location and snap right back when you’re done.
COMMUNICATIVE
Share Street View panoramas using drag-and-drop (on iPad) or the share sheet. Handoff and AirDrop let you easily transfer the currently viewed panorama between multiple devices. Mark panoramas as favorites that are automatically synced between devices. Rename favorites and organize them in folders.
2000+ GALLERY PLACES 
More than 2000 hand-picked “Gallery Places” show spectacular places such as museums, castles, national parks, ski slopes and even underwater attractions. Geysers in Yellowstone national park, old masterpieces in Amsterdam’s van Gogh museum or NASA’s rocket launch pad in Cape Kennedy are just a few of the breathtaking places waiting to be explored. Gallery places also include background information such as descriptions and links.
Apple Watch App
Streets is the only app capable of displaying 360° Street View panoramas on the Apple Watch. Turn your wrist to turn around in the panorama. The digital crown is utilized to zoom in and out. Streets for Apple Watch automatically syncs favorites and recent searches with your iPhone.
FEATURES
- Supports iPad Stage Manager, Split View and Slide Over
- Supports keyboard navigation (with Bluetooth or Smart Keyboard)
- Mark panoramas as favorites that are automatically synced between all your iOS devices
- Rename favorites and organize them in folders
- Share Panoramas via email, message, or social networks
- Spotlight search also finds Streets panoramas
- Handoff lets you easily transfer the currently viewed panorama from iPhone to iPad or vice versa
- Siri can create reminders with a link to the currently displayed panorama
- Create workflows to grab and process panoramas for specified contacts or other locations
WHAT OTHERS SAY
“I highly recommend Streets 3.“
- John Voorhees, MacStories
“it’s hard to imagine Cupertino doing it better than Streets 3”
4.5/5 mice
- J.R. Bookwalter, Macworld
“If you haven't migrated to Google Maps on iOS because you're OK with Apple Maps but you miss Google Street View, here's a pretty easy solution.“
- Mel Martin, Engadget
“Thankfully, with Streets, you can continue using Maps and still be able to quickly pull up Street View without ever feeling like you’ve left the app.“
- Jordan Khan, 9to5Mac
SOCIAL MEDIA
Get to know the latest updates and news from our development lab:
- Mastodon: https://urbanists.social/@streets
- Facebook: http://fb.com/streetviewapp
- X: @futuretap

- Rename favorites and organize them in folders
- Share Panoramas via email, message, or social networks
- Spotlight search also finds Streets panoramas
- Handoff lets you easily transfer the currently viewed panorama from iPhone to iPad or vice versa
- Siri can create reminders with a link to the currently displayed panorama
- Create workflows to grab and process panoramas for specified contacts or other locations


WHAT OTHERS SAY

bluejetty:00096161:ios.description:
Jigsaw Master: Picture Gallery is a relaxing and rewarding classic jigsaw puzzle game designed for iPhone and iPad. Browse a growing gallery, choose any picture you like, and solve it your way—from a quick 36-piece puzzle to a satisfying 400-piece challenge.
There are no forced levels and no waiting to unlock the next picture. Whether you are a beginner, an experienced puzzler, or a senior looking for a peaceful pastime, you can always find the right puzzle and play at your own pace.
Enjoying jigsaw puzzles is a calming way to keep your mind engaged, practice concentration, and take a break from the day. Complete beautiful pictures, earn coins, and use your rewards to unlock new themed collections that make your personal puzzle library even richer.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE JIGSAW MASTER
1. FREELY CHOOSE YOUR PUZZLES
Browse the gallery and select any available picture that catches your eye. Your next puzzle is always your choice.
2. BEAUTIFUL HD PICTURE GALLERY
Discover high-quality photos and artwork organized into a variety of categories and themed collections.
3. FLEXIBLE DIFFICULTY
Choose from 36, 64, 100, 144, 225, or 400 pieces. Start easy, find your favorite setting, or take on a detailed challenge.
4. MORE CHALLENGE, MORE COINS
Complete puzzles to earn coins. The harder the difficulty you choose, the more coins you can receive.
5. UNLOCK THEMED COLLECTIONS
Spend the coins you earn through gameplay to unlock new collections. Each collection contains a curated set of beautiful pictures, giving you more themes to explore and more puzzles to complete.
6. DAILY PUZZLE
Come back every day for a fresh Daily Puzzle. Make it part of your routine and enjoy a new challenge each day.
7. ZERO MISSING PIECES
Every puzzle includes all its pieces, creating a complete and frustration-free jigsaw experience.
8. HELPFUL PUZZLE TOOLS
Customize the background color, organize pieces with filtering tools, check the temporary reference image, and use helpful hints whenever you need assistance.
HOW TO PLAY
• Choose a picture from the gallery or open the Daily Puzzle.
• Select your preferred difficulty from 36 to 400 pieces.
• Personalize the puzzle board with a background color.
• Drag and place the pieces in their correct positions.
• Use filters, hints, or the reference image when you need help.
• Complete the picture and collect your coin reward—the harder the puzzle, the greater the reward.
• Use your coins to unlock new themed collections and expand your puzzle library.
Jigsaw puzzles have been enjoyed for generations because they offer the perfect balance of focus, relaxation, and accomplishment. Solve a quick puzzle during a break, unwind with a peaceful picture before bed, or settle in for a challenging 400-piece experience.
Choose the pictures you love, challenge yourself at your own pace, and watch your puzzle gallery grow with every completed image.
Download Jigsaw Master: Picture Gallery and begin your next puzzle today.
For questions or feedback, don’t hesitate to get in touch with us at support@smallant.games.

bluejetty:00061057:ios.description:
Matching paint color by eye is subjective. Job quality is not. That’s why you need the Datacolor ColorReader. It matches paint color with more than 90% accuracy. All at the push of a button. All in the brand of your choice. The ColorReader analyzes the color of a wall or object and matches it in less than a second to the closest paint color. For those who need to know paint color to do their jobs. No more matching by eye and searching through fan decks or color cards.
Paint confidently. Design confidently. DIY confidently. Be confident with color.
Highest Accuracy Across Popular Paint Brands
• Industry leading matching with more than 90% success rate
• Matches color to any uploaded fan deck
• Easy to use
• One-click analysis
• Ultra-portable
• Bluetooth®-connected
• OLED display for standalone device use (ColorReader Pro only)
Expanded capabilities through the mobile app:
• Build, save, and share color palettes
• Color measurement history
• Color scheme recommendations for harmonious color flow
• Get paint brand color name and number
• Get color values for measurements and color matches including RGB, Hex, CIELab, and more!
• QC functionality (ColorReader and ColorReader Pro only)
Backed by the Leading Precision Color Company
For more than 45 years, Datacolor’s passion for precision color has helped us meet the exacting needs of more than a million customers whose entire job depends on the accuracy of their colors.
What People Are Saying about ColorReader?
“This device is incredibly easy to use - and it’s dependable.”
John Metz - Haddon Painting
“I love it. It cut one hour of time off my desk.”
Debbie Deutsh – Interiors by Cornerstone
“In this industry, time is money. If I can’t get the exact color they want, I’m losing time and material costs. “
Jon Ipock – ProTastic Painting
“I have not stopped using it in matching colors to fabric and wall covering. It has saved me so much time in trying to match with paint chips.”
Vincent Wolf – Vincent Wolf Associates, Inc.
“There are many contenders in this field, but this in my opinion is the only one that provides the best balance between accuracy, ease-of-use and price. Whatever color you read with your ColorReader will be matched against those fan decks and the best matching returned. This is a much better alternative to purchasing multiple paint samples and trying them out, and is in my opinion the best bang for the buck.”
Amazon Customer
“Bought this (the lower cost one) because it seemed there had to be a better way than trying to match paint swatches to what is on the walls now. Setup was straight forward, and the app is fairly easy to use to take readings. The device accurately identified a swatch that I had, and it was straight forward to take multiple readings of the long ago painted walls in our old house.“
Amazon Customer

Privacy Policy: http://www.datacolor.com/legal-documents/colorreader/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00126096:ios.name: Speech Central – Voice Reader
bluejetty:00126096:ios.summary:
Speech Central has been built for focused, serious reading since 2014. It works across PDFs, web articles, books, and documents.
Designed for productivity and accessibility, it combines powerful controls, deep customization, and seamless i
bluejetty:00126096:ios.description:
Speech Central has been built for focused, serious reading since 2014. It works across PDFs, web articles, books, and documents.
Designed for productivity and accessibility, it combines powerful controls, deep customization, and seamless integration across Apple devices.
No subscription. A one-time upgrade unlocks unlimited use. Free access is available for blind users with VoiceOver and for schools deploying the app through Apple School Manager.
READING WITHOUT DISTRACTIONS
Optimized PDF & Web Reading
• Accurate reading order and navigation
• Optional cleanup to reduce distractions such as headers, footnotes, citations, and links
• RSS support and easy sharing from Safari and other apps
Broad Document Support
• PDF (including scanned PDFs with two-column layout)
• EPUB
• Word (.docx)
• PowerPoint (.pptx)
• OpenOffice formats
• HTML, TXT, RTF, Markdown, and more
VOICES: OFFLINE AND CLOUD AI
• Use high-quality Apple system voices offline
• Supports compatible system-wide voices from third-party apps, including offline neural voices from Piper - Neural TTS and ToBe SAID (Pocket TTS) apps
• Connect cloud AI voices (OpenAI-compatible APIs, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, xAI) using your own API keys
• Proprietary enhancement layer improves realism and streaming playback
• Optional AI summarization tools help you review content more efficiently
BUILT FOR THE APPLE ECOSYSTEM
• Sync reading position and playlists across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• CarPlay support for listening and control in your vehicle
• Independent Apple Watch app — listen without your iPhone nearby
• Optional Health integration to track mindful listening time
ACCESSIBILITY FIRST
• Dedicated profiles for ADHD, dyslexia, and low vision
• Interface and reading behavior adapt for reduced distraction and improved comprehension
• Fully accessible with VoiceOver
STUDY & KNOWLEDGE TOOLS
• Annotate while reading
• Export annotated text to .docx
• Export text to audio files for offline listening
PRIVACY BY DESIGN
• No ads
• No tracking
• No usage analytics
WHO USES SPEECH CENTRAL
• Students and researchers
• Professionals converting reading into listening time
• Users who rely on assistive reading tools
• Anyone who prefers distraction-reduced, hands-free reading
Notes:
- Free version limited by the number of daily articles; unlimited access available with Pro upgrade.
- Some features require the latest OS version.
- License is valid only on iOS/watchOS; separate licenses required for other platforms.
- DRM-protected books (e.g. Kindle) are incompatible.
- AI features may occasionally perform unexpectedly.

bluejetty:00166644:ios.summary:
