Do you w
bluejetty:00166644:ios.description:
The Idle Forces: Army Tycoon is incremental game. But it isn’t one of the traditional idle city builder games! You won't find here supermarket, restaurant, roller coaster and amusement park because it is an army simulator, rookie! 
Do you want to become an idle army commander and command the tycoon military units of a powerful state and execute peacekeeping campaigns? Do you want to raise a recruit to a military specialist? Bring Freedom, Law and Order even to the most remote corners of the planet!
On the orders of a top army commander, you will set up a military camp and take control of a military base in a hot spot. Your main priority is to train operatives from green recruits. Every recruit and sergeant need to defend army homebase with a gun. Periodically, professional soldiers attack the military base! It would be better if it were mafia or zombies … Zombies are easier to deal with!
An idle military base is a complex structure which need to build, upgrade and customize. Each building has its own purpose. 
Chefs cook in the kitchen. This is certainly not a restaurant, but they will give you a cookie and lemonade for dessert!
In the infirmary, the medics will put you in a hospital bed if you're sick, and you'll feel at home instead of in prison!
It's not a hotel empire for overnight stays, but a barracks with everything you need, including lemonade and cookies in the vending machine.
To be resilient, you need sports activities. Sergeants choose a training program for your idle recruits. Instead of a gym, the military camp has its own firing range and shooting range. This is not an idle golf game or a roller coaster, this is a an army simulator, rookie! 
Become the best special forces soldier and go on missions of transport forces by car! Make your own military business empire!
Earn money, replenish the bank and tap tap to invest in military tycoon base development!
- Distribute money between your bases
- Train and upgrade every soldier
- Monitor the progress of your recruits
- Create conditions for recruits in the clicker game
- Transfer troops between hot spots
- Create a training program for your men
- Dispatch operatives on dangerous missions
- Receive awards from the headquarters
- Unlock and customize new bases and make army business empire
- Adventure capitalist clicker game
~~~~~~
Rate us in the app store and join our Facebook page:
https://www.facebook.com/Military-Operations-Tycoon
Join our Discord community! We'll be happy to receive your feedback: https://discord.gg/9GTYjYhcfh

bluejetty:00127232:ios.description:
MIX is an easy-to-use, professional photo editing tool for photography lovers. Featuring powerful editing tools, cinema-grade color toning, and creative functions such as the one-touch Magic Sky edit and poster templates, it’s time to express yourself through your photos with MIX. 
【Custom Cropping】 
Supports image crop, flip, rotate, and more. You can also adjust the incline, stretch, etc. MIX is here to help you find the best size and perspective for your photos. 
【Powerful and Professional Photo Editing Tools 】 
From lighting adjustment to professional color adjustment, we have nearly 20 powerful tools, including HSL, curves, and split tone. Easily achieve desired results without compromising image quality. 
【Expertly Crafted Color Presets】 
Dozens of professional film effect presets—achieve realistic vintage + black and white film color effects. Plus plenty of presets specially designed for nature, portraits, street photography, gourmet food, night scenes, etc. 
【One-tap Magic Sky】 
Get a stunning sky with just one tap. With more than 200 Magic Sky presets—turn even the cloudiest day into a sunny one, easily recreating the scenes of your dream. 
【Partial Retouch】 
Supports Brush, Linear Gradient, and other partial retouch tools to help you adjust lighting with precision. Along with our Retouch and Restore tool, swiftly eliminate distractions to create the perfect image! 
【Beautiful Poster Designs】 
With one tap, you can apply a beautiful Poster Template to craft a tale with just your photos. Users will also gain access to a wide range of Graphic Materials, plus personalized, accurate layout functions. Creating beautiful posters is just a piece of cake. 
【Customize Presets/Posters】 
My Presets: Customize presets/posters according to your preferences and aesthetic. Access and use them any time.

bluejetty:00157793:ios.description:
Take control of your GLP-1 journey! Built by a doctor, built for real life.
Vivy is the #1 doctor-developed app made specifically for people on GLP-1 medications like Zepbound, Wegovy, Ozempic, and more. Whether you’re just getting started or deep into your routine, Vivy gives you the tools, structure, and support to feel your best, without feeling overwhelmed.
With Vivy, you’ll track the things that matter most, like protein, steps, side effects, and progress, so you can lose weight, stay strong, and feel more in control. And when questions or tough days come up, our one-of-a-kind GLP-1-specific community is here to help you stay consistent.
WHY CHOOSE VIVY?
 • Built by a doctor. Designed for those on GLP-1s.
 • Track your injections, side effects, weight, and body changes with ease.
 • Hit your protein goals and stay energized with photo-based food tracking.
 • Log your steps, energy, meals, and more. No need to overthink it!
 • Get gentle accountability from Vivy’s habit-based coaching system.
 • Stay motivated with simple check-ins and encouragement.
 • Ask questions and share wins in the only GLP-1-specific community.
 • Celebrate every kind of progress; not just the scale
YOUR JOURNEY, SUPPORTED
Vivy was created to help you build habits that actually last—without shame, stress, or confusion. Whether you’re navigating side effects, building new routines, or restarting after a tough week, Vivy’s here for every step of your journey.
Download Vivy today and feel the difference.
---
You need a subscription plan to access some of Vivy's features. If you subscribe to a subscription plan, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time by going to your settings in the App Store after purchase.
Available App Subscriptions
- Yearly
- Monthly
Privacy Policy: https://www.getvivy.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00026278:ios.description:
A completely free ringtone production software. Without connection to the computer, the ringtone can be produced via iPhone. Set the song collected by you as ringtone. 
The APP size is only about 20Mb after optimization (slight difference between different models). Your iPhone ringtone can be produced quickly after quick downloading. Based on the latest production method, the ringtone production can be completed within several seconds. 
[Service concept] 
Each iPhone user can successfully produce the ringtone. In case of any problem arising in the process of producing the ringtone, directly contact us as per the contact way in the app to get one-to-one help free of charge. 
[Advantage] 
-Many ringtones: The real-time update of popular ringtone, funny ringtone, the latest ringtone and SMS ringtone is realized. 
-Supports iOS26 one-click setting as ringtone, only takes 1 second.
-Many tutorials: Two methods for producing the ringtone (including GarageBand and iTunes) are provided. 
-Super detailed iPhone ringtone production image-text and video tutorial are detailed into each click with 100% successful setting. 
-Cover all iPhone models from iPhone4s to the latest iPhone17/Pro/Max. 
[Feature] 
-Choose the video from the album and automatically extract the audio from the video. 
-Import the audio via UTI(Uniform Type Identifier): Import the audio directly from other APPs (such as WeChat and QQ). 
-Upload the audios (such as mp3 and m4a) to iPhone from the computer via http service. 
-Accurate to 0.1s ringtone clipping. 
-Support the fade-in fade-out setting within 1-5s. 
-Support the video and audio converted to mp3 and m4r formats. 
-Support the splicing of many ringtone audio files. 
-Set the audio as charging tone. 
-Share the ringtone to your friends. 
[Contact us] 
Mail: contact@iuuapp.com
Your suggestions are very important for me. You can contact me via "Feedback" in the app.

bluejetty:00043607:ios.description:
Lignes d'Azur est l'application officielle du réseau de transport public de la Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur : bus, tramway et lignes à la carte.
Préparez et suivez vos déplacements sur l'ensemble du territoire, que vous soyez voyageur quotidien ou occasionnel.
SUIVEZ VOS BUS ET TRAMWAYS EN DIRECT
Visualisez la position des véhicules en temps réel sur la carte et consultez les prochains passages à chaque arrêt.
CALCULEZ VOTRE ITINÉRAIRE
Indiquez votre point de départ et votre destination : l'application vous propose les meilleures solutions, étape par étape, avec le détail du trajet sur la carte. Ajustez vos critères selon vos préférences : heure de départ ou d'arrivée, trajet le plus rapide, moins de correspondances, vitesse et temps de marche etc.
TOUTES LES MOBILITÉS DU TERRITOIRE
Retrouvez sur une même carte les parcs relais ParcAzur et leurs places disponibles en temps réel, les vélos en libre-service, le covoiturage courte distance, le transport à la demande, ainsi que les lignes régionales Zou.
RESTEZ INFORMÉ
Consultez l'info trafic en direct, ajoutez vos lignes et vos arrêts favoris, et choisissez les alertes que vous souhaitez recevoir.
HORAIRES ET PLANS
Consultez les horaires de toutes les lignes du réseau, téléchargeable au format PDF.
VOTRE COMPTE LIGNES D'AZUR
Un compte unique pour retrouver vos favoris et vos préférences, sur l'application comme sur lignesdazur.com.
VOS TITRES DE TRANSPORT
L'achat, le rechargement et la validation de vos titres s'effectuent dans l'application dédiée Lignes d'Azur Tickets, accessible directement depuis cette application.
Une question, une remarque ? Écrivez-nous depuis la rubrique Support de l'application.

bluejetty:00121798:ios.description:
Virtually connect with your crew in an exciting student simulator! Throw a house party, collect exclusive swag, style your look, or just chill with your besties. Next, change up your aesthetic with different clothing styles and apartment decorations. You can even send fun digital gifts, adopt a cute pet, and build an unforgettable squad of friends!
Enjoy social avatar games with unique looks? Choose from a massive variety of popular styles to fit your exact vibe!
DESIGNER DORM ROOMS
Customize your dream home. From chic VIP lounges and lux beach escapes to retro anime arcades, create your space then enter dorm design challenges for rewards!
GROW YOUR DORM TOWER
Rent out rooms and hire dormmates to level up your campus status! Upgrade their skills and challenge other squads to a dance fight.
1000+ AVATARS TO CHOOSE
Match your outfit to your room and style your look as a punk pop star, high fashion icon, whimsical princess, elite athlete, and more!
ZODIAC STYLES
Elevate your aesthetic with fantasy inspired trends and furniture themed around your sign. Showcase a rare collection to outshine the competition!
GROUP CHAT & TEXT GAMES
Make real-time community messaging safe and easy. Send emote stickers, play fun mini-games, share your latest makeover designs, and stay connected with your Club.
CHARACTERS AND STORIES
Encounter comedic classmates, mysterious personalities, and entertaining rivals to interact with as you rise to the top of the leaderboards.
ADOPT A VIRTUAL PET
Bring home a cute pug, a sleek Sphynx cat, or a magical unicorn! Dress them up in adorable outfits to perfectly match your avatar and show them off to your squad.
School is in session. Virtually meet new friends and make online memories together!
PLEASE NOTE:
This is an ONLINE casual MMO game. An active network or Wi-Fi connection is required in order to play.
Terms of Service: http://www.partyinmydorm.com/tos.html
Privacy Policy: http://www.partyinmydorm.com/privacy.html

bluejetty:00029369:ios.summary: Unicode Pad Pro is the ultimate Unicode character map app for the iPad. Offering an extensive database of over 155,000 characters, it supports the latest Unicode 16 standard. This powerful tool features customizable keyboards, which can be
bluejetty:00029369:ios.description:
Unicode Pad Pro is the ultimate Unicode character map app for the iPad. Offering an extensive database of over 155,000 characters, it supports the latest Unicode 16 standard. This powerful tool features customizable keyboards, which can be used across any iOS app, bundled fonts, and the ability to import custom fonts. Users can easily browse, search, and copy characters, access detailed character information, and enjoy seamless multitasking with other apps. Perfect for everything from scientific notation to creative writing,
Features:
• Custom keyboards can be used in any other iOS app
• Install bundled fonts for use in other apps
• Import and use any custom font into the app
• Support for Unicode 15.1 standard, which has many new symbols.
• Huge selection of symbols (thousands), in fact all that are available on your device. Database itself actually contains data for all characters (over 140000!).
• Copy characters to clipboard for use in other apps, like web, mail, chat, notes... any iOS app!
• Detailed information on each Unicode character, including encodings, extra info, similar characters and availability in fonts
• Extensive gesture support for smooth workflow!
• Drag and drop support for text, PNG and PDF graphics!
• Notepad with customizable keyboards, for your often-used characters and for copying several characters at once. Great for casual writing, too!
• HTML entity names for relevant characters
• UNIHAN english definitions for CJK ideograms for many characters
• Egyptian hieroglyph definitions
• Ideographic Description Sequences (IDS) for CJK ideograms
• Share your custom keyboards with your friends!
• Search for characters by name, hexadecimal codepoint or glyph! Find similar and related characters instantly!
• Great support for iPad multitasking - works great together with other apps
• Streamlined design, specifically optimized for each device. Support for all device orientations and Retina display. 
• Support for dark mode.
• Fully tested on latest iOS
• Support for Backspace, New line, Shift and Alternate special keys on custom keyboards.
• Custom keyboard sizes up to 6x16=96 keys.
• Flick left and right for next and previous characters in detail view
• View extended character descriptions on Wikipedia, unicode.org charts or Emojipedia right from inside the app!
• Copy glyphs as PDF graphics or PNG images
• Sections of favourite and recently copied characters
• One universal application works on iPhone, iPod and iPad!
• Reference booklet of characters available on modern computers! Paper Unicode maps are over 1000 pages long!
• Quick access to many groups of commonly used symbols!
• Great for scientific, mathematical and physics notation, handles many superscripts, subscripts and other symbols!
• Excellent for phonetic notation!
• Developers: see which characters are available on your iOS device and in which fonts.
• Perfect for writing Unicode poetry!
• Awesome for making interesting app names!

bluejetty:00016070:ios.summary: Street psychics. Their blinking neon signs are everywhere, promising love and wealth and happiness. They make a fortune preying on the gullible and milking them dry. So when these victims begin dying and leaving confused spirits behind, it
bluejetty:00016070:ios.description:
Street psychics. Their blinking neon signs are everywhere, promising love and wealth and happiness. They make a fortune preying on the gullible and milking them dry. So when these victims begin dying and leaving confused spirits behind, it can only take a genuine psychic (and her wayward spirit guide) to clean up the mess.
From seedy downtown nightclubs to penthouse apartments to a luxury yacht on the Hudson River, Rosa and Joey will unearth the truth about the underground world of street psychics - including some secrets that Joey would rather be left buried.
This is the fourth in the series begun by "Blackwell 1: Legacy," "Blackwell 2: Unbound," and "Blackwell 3: Convergence" (all available now). The story is concluded in "Blackwell 5: Epiphany" (coming soon).
Rock Paper Shotgun - "The Blackwell Deception is hands-down [Wadjet Eye's] best adventure yet, and one of my favourites in a very long time."
Adventure Gamers - "Perhaps the best game in the series to date, Blackwell Deception is an enjoyable retro title and a well-rounded effort that’s easy to get into and hard to put down." [3.5/5]
Alternative Magazine Online - "The Blackwell Deception is a welcome addition to one of the most enjoyable adventure game series ever made." [9/10]
Jay is games - "Packed full of mystery, character, charm and suspense, it's a delight from start to finish."

bluejetty:00127266:ios.name: White Noise Lite
bluejetty:00127266:ios.summary:
Do you have trouble going to sleep? Are you traveling on a plane and need a quick power nap? Does your newborn baby wake up in the middle of the night? There are numerous benefits to using White Noise:
• Helps you sleep by blocking distrac
bluejetty:00127266:ios.description:
Do you have trouble going to sleep? Are you traveling on a plane and need a quick power nap? Does your newborn baby wake up in the middle of the night? There are numerous benefits to using White Noise:
• Helps you sleep by blocking distractions
• Relaxes and reduces stress
• Pacifies fussy and crying babies
• Increases focus while enhancing privacy
• Soothes headaches and migraines
• Masks tinnitus (ringing of the ears)
Even when you’re asleep, your brain is constantly scanning and listening for sounds. If it’s too quiet, unwanted noises such as faucet drips or police sirens can interrupt your sleep. White Noise generates sounds over a wide range of frequencies, masking those noise interruptions, so you can not only fall asleep, but stay asleep.
SOUND CATALOG
Air Conditioner, Airplane Travel, Amazon Jungle, Beach Waves Crashing, Blowing Wind, Blue Noise, Boat Swaying in Water, Brown Noise, Camp Fire, Cars Driving, Cat Purring, Chimes Chiming, City Streets, Clothes Dryer, Crickets Chirping, Crowded Room, Dishwasher Rinsing, Extreme Rain Pouring, Frogs at Night, Grandfather Clock, Hair Dryer Blowing, Heartbeat, Heavy Rain Pouring, Light Rain Pouring, Ocean Waves Crashing, Oscillating Fan, Pink Noise, Rain on Car Roof, Rain Storm, Running Shower, Running Water, Stream Water Flowing, Thunder Storm, Tibetan Singing Bowl, Train Ride, Vacuum Cleaner, Violet Noise, Water Dripping, Water Sprinkler, White Noise
APPLICATION FEATURES
• 50+ perfectly looped sounds with additional free sound downloads from the White Noise Market app or website: https://whitenoisemarket.com/
• Background audio support so you can use other apps while listening.
• Record and professionally loop sounds without being an audio engineer!
• Revolutionary Mix Pad editor for creating new soundscapes like a DJ with support for adjusting sound position, sound variance, volume, and pitch of each individual sound in the mix
• Upload and Share your recordings and mixes with the White Noise Market app
• Full screen digital clock with multiple colors and brightness controls makes it the perfect companion for any nightstand
• All screen resolutions supported including iPhone X, iPhone 5-8+, and iPad
• Portrait and Landscape orientations supported.
• Advanced alarm and timer system that slowly fades audio in and out so you awake naturally feeling more refreshed
• On-screen media player and volume controls with swipe gesture support for navigating sound collection
• Heart favorite sounds and mixes in the sound catalog for quick access using the Favorites view
• Set Music alarms that slowly fade in so you wake refreshed
• AirPlay sounds to Bluetooth devices or Apple TV
• Remote media controls on lock screen and headphones
• Advanced controls for volume, balance, pitch, mixing with iPod music, looping the playlist, custom alarm snooze times, and more
• Upgrade to the full version to remove advertising.
UPGRADE
White Noise was created for the original iPhone in 2008 by TMSOFT and has been continuously updated with new features. Download the full version of White Noise to remove advertising and add additional features including Apple TV & Apple Watch support. Just tap the + button and "Upgrade" to learn more.
MORE INFO
Download new sounds at https://whitenoisemarket.com/
Like us on Facebook at https://www.facebook.com/WhiteNoiseApp
Follow us on twitter at https://twitter.com/whitenoiseapp
Support and FAQ info at https://www.tmsoft.com/white-noise/support/

bluejetty:00184677:ios.summary: Tap-to-Cook is an engaging burger maker & time management game that enables you to test your food serving skills in a fast-paced restaurant rush! Start the cook-off and serve all customers at your fast food truck without delays - It's burge
bluejetty:00184677:ios.description:
Tap-to-Cook is an engaging burger maker & time management game that enables you to test your food serving skills in a fast-paced restaurant rush! Start the cook-off and serve all customers at your fast food truck without delays - It's burger time! 
This fast food cooking game will try your limits, it becomes more and more challenging with each level. After 5 successful days in one cooking city, you are moving to another one. Conquer the world with your tasty burger!
Keep the burgers grilling and the hungry patrons smiling as you earn money to take your restaurant business nationwide! Enjoy this classic time management gameplay and fast-paced challenges featuring colourful characters and sizzling sounds. 
Main features of this fast food cooking game:
- Burger Maker - Make a tasty burger, watch out to not overcook it, it all counts! It`s burger time - Start the cook-off!
- Restaurant Rush - Unique time management game! Make food fast and serve it to customers on time - Your fast food truck will work with full power!
- Cooking City Challenge - Fast-paced action in six different cities and restaurant locations! How many perfect orders can you serve?
- Vivid Design and Sounds - Gorgeous imagery and realistic cooking sounds – you can almost smell the grease that comes off the burgers!
- Shop - Upgrade your food truck, its equipment, and food & drink offer. Collect gold and earn cash to upgrade and progress faster
- Leaderboard - Track your personal progress on the leaderboard. Compare yourself to friends and other players.
- Cooker Achievements - Earn achievements for your skills including Full House, Master Cook, Entrepreneur & Finger of Justice.
Tap your way through the kitchen, cooking and serving up delicious burger dishes to your customers in this incredibly fun and action-packed restaurant game.
How to play Tap-to-Cook?
- Drag food items to the grill, buns to the table, and beverage items to the box above.
- Wait until the food cooking is finished.
- Assemble your customer's order.
- Serve it.
- Collect the money.
- Do it again!
Download Tap-to-Cook, the addictive burger maker & fast food cooking game - Enjoy making food for your customers! Make tasty burgers and other delicious food and drinks. Get into your food truck and start the cook-off - It's burger time!

bluejetty:00116836:ios.description:
Gym Geek is the smart calorie counter that keeps your weight goal on track. For weight loss, maintenance or weight gain. Track calories by scanning barcodes, searching our food database or using Quick Track.
1) Set up your weight plan
Enter your age, gender, height and current weight to start your weight plan. Then choose how quickly you want to lose or gain weight, from 0.5 lb per week to 2 lb per week.
2) Phase in
If you choose to phase in while losing weight, you'll start by maintaining your current weight. Over the phase in period, your calorie goal will gradually decrease to your target rate of weight loss. 
Phase in over 1 or 2 weeks for the best results. Although you won't see results on day 1, you're more likely to stick to the plan.
Phasing in avoids sudden changes to your diet and dampens your feelings of hunger.
3) Track your calories
Track your calories by scanning barcodes, searching our 3.8 million item food database or using the Quick Track tool.
Don't worry about being 100% accurate. Gym Geek uses Smart Calorie Adjustments to update your calorie goal as you lose or gain weight.
The app automatically switches between Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner.
4) Smart Calorie Adjustments
Gym Geek uses Smart Calorie Adjustments to update your calorie goal as you lose or gain weight. Your calorie goal updates automatically to keep your weight loss or weight gain goal on track.
Track your weight often (at least weekly) for the best results.
*Important Information*
Not suitable if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, or if you have an eating disorder. Use of Gym Geek is subject to our disclaimer, which you can find in the Settings tab. See the Settings tab for our full methodology and important information before you start.

bluejetty:00088913:ios.description:
This app is specifically designed for iPhone and iPad, providing a powerful and easy-to-use file management and extraction solution. It supports a variety of common file extraction formats and offers features such as file preview, file management, photo and video compression, and more, helping users efficiently manage files on their devices. Whether for everyday use or work, it provides the best support and becomes a reliable assistant for handling your files.
FEATURES
File Extraction
- The app supports extracting various common file formats, including ZIP, RAR, TAR, GZ, 7Z, and more, allowing users to easily handle compressed files and quickly access their contents.
File Compression
- Users can compress photos and video files on their iPhone or iPad to save storage space while maintaining good quality.
Format Conversion
- For HEIC photos, the app allows quick conversion to the widely used JPG format, making it easier for users to view and share across different devices and platforms.
File Preview
- In addition to supporting the extraction of common file types, the app also supports previewing photos, videos, documents, spreadsheets, and more, so users can directly view content without needing additional apps.
File Manager
- The app provides simple and intuitive file management features, allowing users to easily browse, move, rename, delete, and organize files to ensure efficient and organized file handling.
File Printing
- Users can print files directly from the app, providing a quick and convenient way to print documents and photos for work or personal needs.
Dark Mode
- The app supports system-wide dark mode, offering a more comfortable visual experience, especially for long-term use.
This app is not just a simple file extraction tool; it also integrates file management, photo and video compression, file preview, printing, and other useful features. Whether it’s managing files in daily life or handling various work-related documents, it is an indispensable assistant.

bluejetty:00175464:ios.description:
Have you ever engaged in word association and word connection games with your friends? Now, get ready to experience the thrill of playing such word games right on your mobile device! Introducing Word Match: Connections Game; a premier word association and word connection game that offers a new and immersive way to enjoy word challenges with your friends and family. This word chain game combines crossword puzzles, word connect games, word searches, and word puzzles, which can inspire your passion for brain challenges. If you like fun games, funny games, cool games or good games then you will enjoy our unlimited connections game. This cool game is from the makers of Brain Test games!
Immerse yourself in the game by finding associated words from a vast selection and progress through the levels. While a connection game is easy to pick up and play, mastering it is a true test of your skills. Expand your language abilities as you explore the meanings of hundreds of words and connect them through associations. Enjoy word associations in this word chain game, suitable for players looking to play both memory games for adults and games for seniors. If you enjoy the free word connection puzzle, relaxing puzzles, fun word games, play this free word connect and addictive word search game.
HOW TO PLAY
● Tap on a word to start connecting associated words.
● Continue tapping until all associated words are selected.
● Complete levels by finishing all the words.
● Be mindful of avoiding extra words.
Enthusiasts of word puzzle games will discover a new haven in our connections word game, as we offer hundreds of levels with varying degrees of difficulty. From hard to antonym, our game provides a wide range of level modes for you to enjoy. Our word chain connections game breathes fresh life into the word association genre with innovative gameplay modes. Enjoy gaming without the internet, our offline games offer for non-stop entertainment.
Word Match: Connections Game serves as a relaxing word game that enhances your logical thinking, memory skills, intelligence, and vocabulary. This free casual word game brings joy to the whole family, offering safe themes and entertaining association groups for all family members to solve. This game provides free games for adults, offline brain games and opportunities to become a word master while making connections.
Our connections word game levels are meticulously designed to help you build logical word chains and enhance your spelling skills. The brain training challenges in this word chain game are unique to the expanding word games genre, and its mind-bending puzzles will keep you engaged and entertained. Challenge your mind with this offline word game, where you'll guess the word and make connections.
FEATURES
● Hundreds of levels with four different fun game modes
● One of the best free games. Brain games for adults, puzzle games and new games.
● Relaxing gameplay with no limitations or countdowns
● A fantastic way to expand your vocabulary
● Colorful visuals and engaging sound effects
● Tricky levels with mind-bending puzzles
● A good variety of boosters for assisted gameplay
● Play with one hand for added convenience
● Play offline anytime, anywhere, no internet needed
● Completely free to play
Canceling a trial or a subscription:
• If you want to cancel a subscription during its free trial, you have to cancel it through your account in the Store. This must be done at least 24 hours before the end of the free trial period to avoid being charged.
For more information, please visit https://support.apple.com/HT207865 for more information
If there is questions contact us support@unicostudio.co

bluejetty:00070188:ios.summary: Fotomaç Mobil uygulaması ile son dakika spor haberlerini anında öğrenebilir, maç özetlerine tüm ligler ile ilgili fikstür ve transfer bilgilerine cebinizden ücretsiz ulaşabilirsiniz. Fotomaç Canlı Skor mobil uygulamasıyla maçları canlı yayı
bluejetty:00070188:ios.description:
Fotomaç Mobil uygulaması ile son dakika spor haberlerini anında öğrenebilir, maç özetlerine tüm ligler ile ilgili fikstür ve transfer bilgilerine cebinizden ücretsiz ulaşabilirsiniz. Fotomaç Canlı Skor mobil uygulamasıyla maçları canlı yayın ekranından saniye saniye izleyebilirsiniz. 
Fotomaç Mobil uygulamasında neler var?
* Beşiktaş Haberleri, Galatasaray Haberleri, Fenerbahçe Haberleri, Trabzonspor Haberleri ile ilgili son dakika gelişmelerini takip edebilirsiniz.
* Takımlarınızla ilgili en doğru ve tarafsız gelişmeleri takip edebilir, puan durumu ve haftalık maçlar ile ilgili bilgi edinebilirsiniz.
* Hızlı ve kolay uygulamasıyla manşetler arasında tek bir parmak hareketiyle kolayca geçiş yapabilirsiniz. 
* Beşiktaş, Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray, Trabzonspor ve tüm diğer takımların maçlarını canlı anlatım ve canlı skor ile 90 dakika izleyebilirsiniz. Süper lig maçları yayınlanırken karşılaşmalar hakkında en özel son dakika haberleri Fotomaç Mobil uygulaması farkıyla takip edebilirsiniz.
* Spor Toto Süper lig, Premier lig, La liga, Bundesliga, Şampiyonlar ligi, UEFA Avrupa ligi ve diğer futbol ligleri ile ilgili haberleri, güncel gelişmeleri, maç istatistiklerini, takımlardan transfer gelişmelerini takip edebilirsiniz.
* Türkiye basketbol süper ligi, Euroleague ve diğer ligler ile ilgili haberleri, güncel gelişmeleri, maç istatistiklerini, takımlardan transfer gelişmelerini takip edebilirsiniz.
* Süper lig, TFF, A Milli Takım, Beşiktaş, Fenerbahçe, Galatasaray, Trabzonspor ve Anadolu kulüpleri hakkında anlık bilgileri Fotomaç farkıyla okuyabilirsiniz.
* Ziraat Türkiye Kupası (ZTK) resmi yayıncısı olan Turkuvaz Medya Grubu’nun ATV, A Spor ve A2’de yayınladığı tüm maçların özetine, gollerine ve haberlerine ZTK özel sayfasından ulaşabilirsiniz.
* Türkiye’nin en çok izlenen spor kanalı A Spor’u 7/24 canlı olarak Fotomaç mobil uygulamasından izleyebilir, TV'de bugün ile tüm televizyon kanallarında yer alacak spor etkinliklerine rahatça erişebilirsiniz. 
* Spor gündemine dair son dakika gelişmelerinin yanısıra, tüm ligler ve maçlar ile ilgili, canlı sonuçlar, gol bilgileri ve daha birçok detayda anlık bildirim alabilirsiniz.
* Spor gelişmelerine dair zengin galeri ve video içeriğini görüntülerken, beğendiğiniz haberleri sevdiklerinizle paylaşabilirsiniz.
* Transfer merkezi özel sayfasıyla transfer sezonundaki gelişmeleri tek bir sayfada bulabilirsiniz.
* Bugünkü Fotomaç sayfasıyla Türkiye’nin en çok satan spor gazetesi Fotomaç’ın içeriğini ve güçlü yazarlarını takip edebilirsiniz.
Ziraat Türkiye Kupası, Süper kupa, Dünya kupası, Avrupa kupası, Euroleague kupası gibi tüm kupa karşılaşmaları ile ilgili tüm gelişmeler anlık bildirimlerle Fotomaç’la cebinizde. Ayrıca süper lig dışında La liga, Premier lig, Bundesliga ve diğer liglerden gelişmeler ile, Şampiyonlar ligi, Uefa Avrupa ligi hakkında canlı skor, maç sonuçları, puan durumu, fikstür ile birlikte maç özetleri, transfer gelişmeleri, gol istatistikleri gibi bilgileri Fotomaç mobil uygulamasından takip edebilirsiniz.
Fotomac.com.tr
2000 yılında yayına giren Türkiye’nin bir numaralı spor haber sitesi fotomac.com.tr, futbol başta olmak üzere sporun tüm dallarında güncel ve tarafsız haberleri ile spor gündemine yön veriyor. Türkiye ve Avrupa liglerinden, dünya futbolundan, basketbol ve diğer spor dallarından verdiği haberlerle okuyucularına kaliteli ve doyurucu içerik sunuyor. Mobil uygulaması, sosyal medyadaki etkin gücü, multimedya içerikleri, canlı skoruyla dijital medyanın modern yüzünü okurlarıyla buluşturan fotomac.com.tr, zirvedeki yerini her geçen gün daha da güçlendiriyor.

bluejetty:00086779:ios.description:
Dental Cremer | Henry Schein: o app completo para Dentistas, Estudantes e Técnicos em Prótese Dentária.
Tenha acesso à maior loja odontológica do Brasil, agora no seu celular. O app da Dental Cremer | Henry Schein facilita a compra de materiais odontológicos, equipamentos, instrumentos e suprimentos com entrega rápida, segurança e preços exclusivos.
Feito para dentistas, estudantes de odontologia e TPDs (Técnicos em Prótese Dentária), o app reúne tudo para o seu consultório, laboratório ou formação acadêmica, em um só lugar.
Encontre facilmente produtos para todas as especialidades: endodontia, implantodontia, ortodontia, odontopediatria, estética, harmonização orofacial, prótese e mais.
- Dentistas encontram produtos odontológicos das maiores marcas, com promoções, cupons e condições diferenciadas.
- Estudantes têm acesso a listas acadêmicas com kits personalizados e descontos exclusivos.
- Técnicos em prótese podem repor insumos, resinas, acrílicos e brocas com agilidade e economia.
Você também pode buscar por categoria ou especialidade, comparar preços, favoritar itens, acessar o histórico e repetir compras com poucos toques. Acompanhe o status do pedido em tempo real, baixe boletos e notas fiscais diretamente no app.
Entre os itens disponíveis estão:
- Resinas Compostas
- Anestésicos
- Luvas
- Kits acadêmicos completos
- Fotopolimerizador
- Sugador Odontológico
- Broca Diamantada
- Autoclaves
- Ultrassom odontológico 
- Raio-x Odontológico
- Motor Endodôntico
- Cadeiras odontológicas
- Scanner intraoral
- Seladoras
- EPIs e produtos de biossegurança
O app Dental Cremer | Henry Schein oferece frete grátis em compras acima de R$ 200, parcelamento em até 8x no boleto ou 12x sem juros no cartão, programa de fidelidade App Lovers e atendimento especializado.
Ative as notificações ao instalar para receber promoções exclusivas, cupons de desconto e conteúdos do Blog Dental Cremer | Henry Schein com atualizações sobre odontologia.
Baixe agora o app Dental Cremer | Henry Schein e tenha tudo para o seu dia a dia odontológico na palma da mão.

bluejetty:00155729:ios.description:
Welcome to the Solar Insiders Club! Start earning points for exclusive rewards, discounts, and more. See your budtender for details.
Whether you’re at home, on the way to the store, or shopping with us in-store, our Solar Insiders Club mobile app brings the best of Solar Cannabis to your mobile device. 
With our app you can:
1. Earn Points - As a Solar rewards member, you will be able to earn and track points with every visit to Solar. Not a rewards member yet? You can easily sign up in our app!
2. Redeem rewards and personalized discounts - Use your earned points to redeem rewards, special perks, and discounts.
3. Rewards include: discounts on merchandise, products, accessories and more. 
4. Mobile Ordering - Forget the browser, now you can shop and place your order through our app!
5. Real-time updates - Enable push notifications to be the first to know about product launches, restocks, app-exclusive deals, and more.

7. Stay connected- Through our messaging center, you can keep track of all notifications and messages sent to you from Solar Cannabis.
Download the Solar app today and discover our line of products and deals.
About Solar Cannabis:
Based in Somerset, MA., Solar Cannabis Co. (Solar) is a 67,000 sq ft. vertically-integrated cannabis operator that cultivates and produces recreational marijuana/marijuana-infused products. To date, Solar is unlike any indoor cannabis manufacturing facility in America. With a commitment to sustainable and innovative practices, Solar’s flagship facility was designed to reshape the way cannabis is cultivated. Through the implementation of microgrid assets (solar arrays and high-efficiency, combined heat & power units), LED lighting and 90% water reclamation, Solar is able to produce premium cannabis while lowering its overall energy profile as well as generating over five megawatts (MW) of clean power on-site. Learn more at www.solarthera.com.

bluejetty:00016177:ios.description:
The hidden gem for musicians, from beginners to pros.
Chord ai is the perfect tool for playing and learning any song. With recent advancements in artificial intelligence, Chord ai provides highly accurate chord recognition, beat tracking, voicing and lyrics for any song instantly and reliably. Say goodbye to tedious web searches for chords and hello to easy access to your favorite songs on YouTube, SoundCloud, your audio files, or even by using your device's microphone. With Chord ai, improve your playing skills and train your ear with numerous features tailored to every level of musician.
** BROWSE ANY SONG **
- You can select any song by browsing your audio files, SoundCloud or YouTube. This is the preferred way and each song will be processed in a few seconds only
- Or you can use your device microphone to get the chords in real-time of any song playing around you or from your own playing
** CHORD & VOICING RECOGNITION **
- State-of-the-art chord recognition: Chord ai recognizes common chords such as major, minor, augmented, diminished, 7th, M7th, sus2 and sus4 chords. In the pro version, you also get advanced chords such as half-dim, dim7, 6/9/11/13, add9/11/13 and many more complex jazzy and other beautiful chords such as 69, 11b5, 13b9, 9sus4, min7add13 etc.
- Slash Chord Recognition: Chord ai tells you the bass/lowest note of each chord using the slash notation. [Pro version]
- Voicing & Position recognition: Chord ai is the world's first app capable of recognising not only chords, but also their specific voicing. This means that Chord ai can tell you more precisely which notes should be played, including their octaves, and which positions match best with the song [Pro version]
** LYRICS RECOGNITION **
- On-device lyrics recognition using the latest advances in the field of speech recognition. Nearly 100 languages supported including English, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese and many more! 
** BEAT TRACKING **
- Chord ai uses state-of-the-art beat tracking algorithms to display chords organised into bars and beats
** SEPARATION INTO MULTI TRACKS **
- Automatic music separation into 4 stems: Bass / Drums / Vocals / Other
** MIDIFY **
- State-of-the-art audio to midi conversion
- Export midified audio as a midi file
** ADVANCED REPLAY CONTROLS **
- Speed change: Slow down or speed up playback at your wish so that you can play easily along the song
- Pitch shift: Change the pitch of the song to play in your desired key
- Loop: the interface for setting loop start/end points is very simple and intuitive
** SAVE & SHARE **
- Saved songs and playlists are synchronised among all your iOS devices
- Export transcriptions as PDF files. You can control the number of bars per line as well as whether you want to display lyrics and/or positions
** PIANO / GUITAR / UKULELE / BASS / MANDOLIN / BANJO **
- Select your preferred instrument among always growing list of supported instruments
- Smart capo: you can also let Chord ai tell you preferred capo for either easiness of play of song matching [Pro version]
** LEARN NEW AND BEAUTIFUL CHORD POSITIONS **
- Find and learn chords from Chord ai's massive chord positions library (more than 100k guitar positions and more than 10k ukulele positions)
- Positions ranked from easiest and common to most difficult and rare
- Alternate tunings for guitar / ukulele / banjo / mandolin such as Drop D, DADGAD, Open D/G/A/C etc. [Pro version] 
Any feedback appreciated at contact@chordai.net
Privacy policy: https://chordai.net/privacy-policy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

With recent advancements in artificial intelligence, Chord ai provides highly accurate chord recognition, beat tracking, voicing and lyrics for any song instantly and reliably. Say goodbye to tedious web searches for chords and hello to easy access to your favorite songs on YouTube, SoundCloud, your audio files, or even by using your device's microphone. With Chord ai, improve your playing skills and train your ear with numerous features tailored to every level of musician.

** BROWSE ANY SONG **
- You can select any song by browsing your audio files, SoundCloud or YouTube. This is the preferred way and each song will be processed in a few seconds only
- Or you can use your device microphone to get the chords in real-time of any song playing around you or from your own playing

** CHORD & VOICING RECOGNITION **
- State-of-the-art chord recognition: Chord ai recognizes common chords such as major, minor, augmented, diminished, 7th, M7th, sus2 and sus4 chords. In the pro version, you also get advanced chords such as half-dim, dim7, 6/9/11/13, add9/11/13 and many more complex jazzy and other beautiful chords such as 69, 11b5, 13b9, 9sus4, min7add13 etc.
- Slash Chord Recognition: Chord ai tells you the bass/lowest note of each chord using the slash notation. [Pro version]
- Voicing & Position recognition: Chord ai is the world's first app capable of recognising not only chords, but also their specific voicing. This means that Chord ai can tell you more precisely which notes should be played, including their octaves, and which positions match best with the song [Pro version]

** LYRICS RECOGNITION **
- On-device lyrics recognition using the latest advances in the field of speech recognition. Nearly 100 languages supported including English, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese and many more! 

** BEAT TRACKING **
- Chord ai uses state-of-the-art beat tracking algorithms to display chords organised into bars and beats

** SEPARATION INTO MULTI TRACKS **
- Automatic music separation into 4 stems: Bass / Drums / Vocals / Other

** MIDIFY **
- State-of-the-art audio to midi conversion
- Export midified audio as a midi file

** ADVANCED REPLAY CONTROLS **
- Speed change: Slow down or speed up playback at your wish so that you can play easily along the song
- Pitch shift: Change the pitch of the song to play in your desired key
- Loop: the interface for setting loop start/end points is very simple and intuitive

** SAVE & SHARE **
- Saved songs and playlists are synchronised among all your iOS devices
- Export transcriptions as PDF files. You can control the number of bars per line as well as whether you want to display lyrics and/or positions

** PIANO / GUITAR / UKULELE / BASS / MANDOLIN / BANJO  **
- Select your preferred instrument among always growing list of supported instruments
- Smart capo: you can also let Chord ai tell you preferred capo for either easiness of play of song matching [Pro version]

** LEARN NEW AND BEAUTIFUL CHORD POSITIONS **
- Find and learn chords from Chord ai's massive chord positions library (more than 100k guitar positions and more than 10k ukulele positions)
- Positions ranked from easiest and common to most difficult and rare
- Alternate tunings for guitar / ukulele / banjo / mandolin such as Drop D, DADGAD, Open D/G/A/C etc. [Pro version] 

Any feedback appreciated at contact@chordai.net

bluejetty:00115980:ios.description:
Pirate Go: Bravo is a unique nautical adventure game that combines strategic maritime conquest with thrilling sea exploration and pirate battles. Embark on a festive voyage across frosty seas, conquer snow-dusted islands adorned with Christmas holiday lights and race to uncover Santa's lost treasure trove. Face rivals in tactical ship battles amidst winter storms, gather special seasonal resources, and expand your fleet to become the Christmas Pirate King! 
[Game Features]
●Navigate & Conquer: A New Adventure at Sea
Set sail on an exhilarating journey where your strategic decisions shape your destiny! Pirate Go: Bravo brings high-seas conquest to life, offering a thrilling mix of naval navigation, island exploration, and treasure hunting.
●Chart Your Course to Victory
Plot your course across treacherous waters - land on strategic islands, collect valuable bounties, and expand your pirate empire! Will you find safe harbor or face the perils of the deep?
●Collect Keys, Unlock Endless Treasures
Discover hidden chests scattered across the ocean! Collect keys as you travel, and open legendary treasures filled with gold, rare items, and powerful upgrades.
●Attack and Plunder, Become the Pirate King
Take on rival pirates, raid their bases, and claim their riches! Use powerful skills and strategies to dominate the seas and prove yourself as the ultimate pirate captain.
●Endless Seas, Endless Adventures
Explore mysterious islands, uncover secrets, and chart your own path. Every journey is unique, with surprises waiting at every port!
Set Sail Now! Join players from around the world in this exciting multiplayer adventure. Take command of your destiny, and carve your legend as the greatest pirate of all time!
Site: https://pgm.gamehollywood.com 
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/PirateGoBravoCommunity/
Discord: https://discord.gg/FeZSdcbuY5
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/@PirateGoBravoMobile

bluejetty:00035986:ios.description:
Welcome to Planet Donuts, your ultimate destination in Jordan for an extraordinary journey through a galaxy of sweetness and delight. Our mission at Planet Donuts is not just to serve you a treat but to transport you to a world where every bite is an adventure, every flavor tells a story, and every visit is a cherished memory.
At the heart of Planet Donuts lies our passion for crafting the perfect donut - soft, fluffy, and bursting with flavors that are out of this world. Our menu is a constellation of handcrafted donuts, each one a masterpiece of taste and artistry. From the classic sugared and glazed varieties to innovative creations that push the boundaries of culinary imagination, there's a donut for every palate and occasion.
But our journey through the cosmos of confectionery doesn't stop at donuts. Planet Donuts is a haven for all things sweet, offering an eclectic assortment of cakes, ice creams, and refreshing drinks. Whether you're in the mood for a decadent chocolate cake, a scoop of rich, creamy ice cream, or a refreshing cold beverage, our menu is designed to satisfy your cravings and uplift your spirit.
Understanding the diverse tastes of our cosmic adventurers, we take pride in offering options that cater to everyone. Our menu includes vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free options, ensuring that everyone can enjoy the delights of Planet Donuts, regardless of dietary restrictions or preferences.
At Planet Donuts, we believe in the power of community and the magic of sharing joy. Our cozy, welcoming spaces are designed to be your go-to spot for casual meet-ups, celebrations, or a quiet moment of indulgence. With free Wi-Fi, comfortable seating, and a friendly atmosphere, we invite you to make Planet Donuts your second home.
Sustainability and responsibility towards our planet are at the core of our operations. We are committed to eco-friendly practices, from sourcing ingredients locally to minimize our carbon footprint, to using biodegradable packaging, ensuring that our love for sweets goes hand in hand with love for the Earth.
For those on the go, our efficient online ordering system and delivery service ensure that you can enjoy the delights of Planet Donuts from the comfort of your home or office. Our easy-to-navigate website and mobile app make ordering a breeze, bringing the universe of flavors right to your doorstep.
Join us at Planet Donuts for a journey like no other. Indulge in the ultimate sweet experience, where every visit is a voyage across a delicious galaxy. Follow us on social media for the latest updates, special offers, and a peek into the exciting world of Planet Donuts. Your adventure awaits!

3D Multiplayer Cricket Sports Game
The world’s easiest cricket game to play
Win matches to get coins and build your dream team!

LEVEL UP YOUR SQUAD
Select your finest players, make tactical selections, smash sixes. You are the ultimate cricket megastar.
ACHIEVE ELITE CAREER STATUS
Collect Tournament badges, climb the weekly leagues, unlock iconic cricket stadiums!

bluejetty:00133694:ios.description:
Welcome basketball fans! Lazy Boy Developments is proud to present the sequel to Basketball Superstar!
Basketball Superstar focuses on character development rather than quick reflexes. Start the game as a talented 17 year old rookie and play until you retire. What happens in-between is up to you.
IMPROVE YOUR ABILITIES
Gain experience to upgrade abilities that suit your playing style. Perhaps you focus on offensive skills to become the leading scorer or maybe concentrate on defensive duties and become a defensive powerhouse?
BECOME A LEGEND
Work you way up through college basketball to the very top level. Can you make it to the professional game? Maybe even the All-Star MVP?
MANAGE RELATIONSHIPS
Manage relationships throughout your career. Build a rapport with your teammates, fans and coach. Look after your parents, perhaps get married and even have a kid!
CONTROL YOUR DESTINY
Throughout your career various decisions and events mould you as a person. Do you chase the money or focus on becoming the best you can be? How do you handle fame and fortune?
INCREASE YOUR WEALTH
Why not invest your hard-earned cash in a gym, restaurant or even buy a local basketball team? Make that money work for you!
LIVE THE LIFE
With success comes money and fame. Perhaps buy a Supercar or even a Yacht? Your lifestyle will make you more appealing to potential endorsement deals!
ARE YOU THE BEST?
As your reputation improves, you will gain the attention of bigger and better teams. Do you stay loyal or move to pastures new? Do you move for money or join your favourite team?
Can you become the Basketball Superstar you know you can be?
Prove it…

bluejetty:00015204:ios.summary: The EMD PSE App is the ultimate tool for every friend of chemistry – whether pupil or teacher, university student or professor, amateur or expert, hobbyist or technician. Our app is the must-have of digital periodic tables. Get informed wit
bluejetty:00015204:ios.description:
The EMD PSE App is the ultimate tool for every friend of chemistry – whether pupil or teacher, university student or professor, amateur or expert, hobbyist or technician. Our app is the must-have of digital periodic tables. Get informed with our mobile reference work, any time, with ease, offline and in detail, in the usual straightforward, user-friendly way.
Download now free of charge and start experimenting. 
New features in the latest version:
- Additional translations: Chinese (simplified), Portuguese, and Russian.
- Users can now change the language directly in the app
- New function for direct comparison of two elements
- A separate keypad for the molar mass calculator makes formulas easier to enter
- Headline and breadcrumbs added for improved orientation
- Filtering option and optimized usability for the ranking list of properties 
- Update of element master data
- Update to current operating system versions
- Improved touch support for diagrams
- Museum mode
All existing features:
- All important information about the elements: atomic number, valence electrons, oxidation state, electronegativity according to Allred-Rochow and Pauling, atomic mass, boiling point, melting point, atomic radius, density, history, discoverer, classification, crystalline structure type, electron configuration, ionization energy, isotopic composition, state of matter, hardness according to Mohs, basic state, oxidation numbers, percentage of mass in Earth’s crust, year of discovery, half-life, and much more.
- Visualized element properties: atomic radius, atomic radius graphic, electronegativity (according to Allred-Rochow and Pauling), ionization energy, relative atomic mass, state of matter, ranking list of properties, discovery, classifications.
- Molar mass calculator: simple entry field for chemical formulas. Calculate molar mass simply and quickly.
- Offline use. No Internet needed. All contents in one app. 
- Streamlined handling of access rights.
- Interactive operation: smart operating elements and numerous selection options.
- Variety of languages: German, English, French and Spanish.

bluejetty:00095062:ios.description:
Spot it : Find Hidden Objects – A Thrilling Search & Find Adventure
Dive into Spot it : Find Hidden Objects, where the excitement never stops! In this fun and challenging game, you’ll explore stunning locations filled with hidden objects, mysteries, and treasures. Whether you're in the mood for a relaxing puzzle or an adventure-filled hunt, this game offers a wide variety of hidden object challenges to keep you engaged.
Key Features:
- Hidden Object Search: Explore intricate scenes and find hidden objects skillfully placed within detailed maps. Your keen eyes will be your best tool as you uncover secrets in a range of exciting environments.
- Find the Difference: Compare two seemingly identical images and spot the differences. It's a fun twist that will test your attention to detail and quick thinking.
- Object Hunt Adventures: Participate in a thrilling Hidden Object game where you race against time to find a list of hidden objects. The deeper you go, the more treasures you’ll discover! Each map presents unique challenges, making the game both fun and rewarding.
- Treasure Hunt Challenges: Unlock hidden treasures by solving mysteries and discovering rare objects hidden in captivating locations. Each new map brings a fresh challenge, from ancient ruins to secret rooms in mysterious buildings.
- Brain-Boosting Fun: Spot it is more than just a game—it's a great way to exercise your mind. Improve your focus, memory, and observational skills with each level. It's an addictive find it game that will keep you coming back for more.
- Search & Find Games for All Ages: Suitable for all players, this game includes a variety of difficulty levels. Whether you're a beginner or an expert, you’ll find something to challenge and entertain you.
- Mystery and Adventure: Each level presents a new mystery to solve. From hidden object adventures to unsolved mysteries, there's always something new to discover in the world of Spot it : Find Hidden Objects.
- Endless Replay Value: With countless objects to find, maps to explore, and puzzles to solve, the game offers hours of fun. As you progress, the scenes become more complex, keeping the challenge fresh and exciting.
Game Modes:
- Find It Out Hidden Objects: Search for a variety of hidden items across different scenes. The deeper you search, the more treasures you uncover.
- Search and Find Games: Enjoy a variety of search and find games that offer different types of challenges, from object hunts to treasure quests.
- Hidden Object Mystery Games: Uncover hidden items and solve mysteries in detailed environments. Every map holds secrets waiting to be found.
Perfect for Puzzle Lovers: If you're a fan of hidden object games, mystery games, or treasure hunts, you'll love Spot it : Find Hidden Objects. It's an ideal way to pass the time, challenge your mind, and enjoy some brain-stimulating fun.
Start Your Hunt Today: Download Spot it : Find Hidden Objects now and get ready to uncover secrets, spot hidden objects, and solve mysteries in this fun-filled search and find adventure.

bluejetty:00035705:ios.description:
COLOROID
The darkroom, in your pocket.
Shoot digital, finish on film. Coloroid turns any photo into an authentic analog frame with a single tap. No endless scrolling, no fuss. Tap once for a fresh film look. Tap again for another. Stop when it feels right.
ONE TAP, INFINITE FILM
Every tap loads a new film-inspired look built from real film stocks, grain, and light. Your gallery stays full of frames you never knew you wanted.
REAL FILM STOCKS
Hand-tuned emulsions, from warm portrait tones to punchy saturated color and high-contrast black & white. Classic slide film, instant print, and pushed color negative vibes, and many more.
DIAL IT IN
Keep it simple or go deep. Exposure, contrast, saturation, white balance, tint, highlights, shadows, black point, grain and grain size, dust, vignette, and chromatic aberration. All live, all yours.
LIGHT LEAKS & TEXTURES
Layer real analog character onto any shot with a library of light leaks and film overlays.
LUT FILTER PACKS
Graded color looks organized into packs, for cinematic tones in a single tap.
SAVE YOUR RECIPES
Found a look you love? Save it as a custom film and reuse it forever. Tap the heart to keep the looks you like as you go.
BUILT-IN FILM CAMERA
Shoot straight into Coloroid with a fast, minimal camera, or import from your library.
STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
Your photos and film data never leave your phone. Export in JPEG, HEIC, or PNG with your metadata intact.
Tap. Develop. Share.
COLOROID PRO
Film looks, editing tools, and the camera require a Coloroid Pro subscription. Choose weekly, with a free trial for eligible new subscribers, or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

bluejetty:00180132:ios.description:
With this app, you can create sequences of random numbers by yourself. Great to use when you need to generate random numbers.
Basically, each ball is bouncing around, collide with other balls and walls along the way, and finally some of the balls will reach 'target points' and they will serve as your result balls.
There're a bunch of different physics-based ball machines in this app, they use accelerometer datas from your device to simulate real world movements and collisions. Each ball machine is well designed with the thought of adding real world random data into the system.
With all of these, they gives you ball combinations, that are high quality in terms of randomness.
Shake and rotate your phone, let those balls collide and mix, put the phone up-right and you will have sequence of random balls. Each ball machines are slightly different to operate.
# Each ball machine can generate up to 20 random balls in up to 100 balls.
# You can group as many as 10 ball machines together
# The final results are only for your references.

bluejetty:00186750:ios.name: Dinosaur Car games for kids
bluejetty:00186750:ios.summary: Come! Paint and create your unique car in these amazing car games for kids! Join us in exploring the islands. The little dinosaur will be your driver. He will guide you through the whole adventure in this enchanting world of car games for k
bluejetty:00186750:ios.description:
Come! Paint and create your unique car in these amazing car games for kids! Join us in exploring the islands. The little dinosaur will be your driver. He will guide you through the whole adventure in this enchanting world of car games for kids!
Dive into the festive spirit and unleash your creativity with our latest update in car games for kids! We're excited to introduce an array of new themed vehicles to fuel your imagination and adventure. Join us now and discover the magic of Christmas cars, engineering vehicles, superhero cars, and fantasy cars. Each addition is designed to inspire and provide endless fun for children.
With Christmas cars, kids can spread holiday cheer as they cruise through snow-covered landscapes, adorned with twinkling lights and festive decorations. Engineering vehicles allow young minds to explore and build, fostering a sense of curiosity and problem-solving. Superhero cars bring a dash of excitement, empowering kids to race to the rescue and embark on heroic adventures. And fantasy cars? They open the door to a world of imagination, where magic and wonder meet on the road.
Our car games for kids are not just about driving; they're about creating, customizing, and personalizing. With a wide selection of paintbrushes, car gadgets, and beautiful stickers, every child can design their dream car. Add your name to your creation and make it truly yours.
And let's not forget our "Race Mode"! Watch your customized car, driven by your faithful little dinosaur companion, compete against others on thrilling tracks. From winding mountain roads to bustling city streets, feel the adrenaline rush with realistic engine sounds and vibrant graphics.
Our update brings more than just new cars:
• 48 cars with unique styles for endless creativity
• 6 game scenes, each offering a different adventure
• More than 40 interactive animations to discover and enjoy
• Perfect for toddlers and preschoolers, ages 2-5, to develop their creativity and motor skills
• A safe playing environment with no third-party advertising
Ready to explore cities, islands, mountains, and more in a whole new way? Download our car games for kids now and let the festive, heroic, and fantastical journey begin!
About Yateland:
Yateland crafts apps with educational value, especially in car games for kids, inspiring preschoolers across the globe to learn through play! With each app we make, we are guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." Learn more about Yateland and our apps at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy:
Yateland is committed to protecting users' privacy. If you would like to know more about how we deal with these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

bluejetty:00143944:ios.description:
Джем Работа — подработка рядом с домом, гибкий график и быстрые выплаты.
Находите подработку рядом, выбирайте удобное время и получайте деньги на карту после завершения заказа. В приложении можно быстро найти временную работу, подработку без опыта, смены на несколько часов и задания с ежедневными выплатами по всей России.
Джем Работа помогает подобрать удобный способ дополнительного заработка для тех, кто хочет получать доход без лишних ожиданий и сложных шагов. Если нужны деньги быстро, можно выбрать подходящую подработку, выйти на заказ в удобное время и получить оплату в короткий срок — без оформления трудового договора и без лишних обязательств.
В приложении доступны тысячи вакансий и смен каждый день: работники торгового зала, грузчики, комплектовщики, сборщики заказов, курьеры, повара, мойщики, упаковщики, кассиры и другие варианты. Доступны заказы длительностью от 4 до 12 часов, а подрабатывать можно с 16 лет.
Преимущества Джем Работы:
— Быстрые выплаты на банковскую карту
— Подработка рядом с домом
— Гибкий график и удобное время
— Работа без опыта
— Тысячи вакансий и смен каждый день
— Возможность совмещать с основной работой или учебой
— Прозрачные условия и официальное партнерство
50 000 подработок каждый день
В приложении представлены заказы в крупных торговых сетях и брендах: «Пятёрочка», «Магнит», METRO, «Глобус», Fix Price, «Азбука вкуса», «Ашан», «Верный», «Перекрёсток», SPAR, «В1 — первый выбор», «Дикси», «Лента», «Ароматный мир», «Чижик», DNS, «Технопарк», Colin’s, Etam и другие.
Моментальные выплаты и удобный доход
Оплата поступает на карту после завершения заказа, а в некоторых случаях — в течение 12 часов. Это удобный способ получить деньги быстрее, когда нужен дополнительный доход на повседневные расходы, без долгого ожидания и лишней финансовой нагрузки.
Прозрачность и безопасность
Все отношения оформлены офертой. Джем Работа сотрудничает с ФНС России и зарегистрирована в реестре Роскомнадзора как оператор, осуществляющий обработку персональных данных.
Без трудоустройства
Для подработок не нужен трудовой договор. Достаточно пройти быструю регистрацию, получить статус самозанятого и подтвердить партнерство на сайте «Мой налог». 
Приглашайте друзей и зарабатывайте
Делитесь личным промокодом и получайте бонусы за приглашенных друзей.
Если возникли вопросы или документы долго находятся на проверке, обратитесь в чат в приложении «Джем Работы», на эл.почту: zabota@jamrabota.ru или позвоните по номеру: 88005507228 (звонок бесплатный)

bluejetty:00119752:ios.description:
If you’re looking to earn extra cash, WeGoLook can help. Simply use your phone and our app to complete Looks (easy tasks) on behalf of our customers. For example, we will pay you to take photos of a car listed on eBay to help an out-of-state buyer verify the current condition. Other Looks may include pick-up and delivery of a police report or taking video of a working pinball machine. Most Looks pay between $15-$25 and take less than an hour to complete. Even better… you can accept or deny Looks based on your schedule.
To become one of our Lookers, download the app and apply. We’ll guide you through the steps and notify you when you’re all set to start looking. To learn more, visit: https://wegolook.com/lookers

bluejetty:00021643:ios.description:
Download the Klook travel app to find deals for planning trips and booking hotel accommodation, local activities, car rentals, day tours and more best things to do anytime, anywhere.
A World of Possibilities
There are hundreds and thousands of activities across the world waiting for you on Klook. From sightseeing trips and hotel bookings to immersive cultural experiences, we’re here to guide you to your world of joy.
Trusted & Top-rated Activities
Explore handpicked experiences and get local insights for hundreds of destinations. Museums in Singapore? Tour packages in South Korea? Or some family attractions nearby? When you're on Klook, you're seeing the best of every place in your hands.
Experiences Made Easy
We make e-booking fast with instant confirmation and skip-the-line tickets on selected attractions. Whether it’s chasing waves on a Phuket vacation package, tasting wine in Melbourne or finding out what’s fun for the weekend in your area, you're just a few taps away from booking whatever makes you happy.
Unlock Platinum on Klook Rewards for Exclusive Perks
- Earn up to 5X more KlookCash 
- Get up to US$250 in coupons
- Skip the line for priority customer support 
- Unlock free eSIM and coupons for Travel Essentials
You can elevate your Klook experience to Platinum when you spend US$1,500 as a Klook Gold member.
And a Whole Lot More
- Budgeting when travelling? Use Klook-exclusive promo codes to save on the best deals
- Redeem your tickets and e-vouchers or download them for easy offline access
- Save your bucket-list holiday ideas to your wishlist and book later
- Choose from trains, buses, cars， and even ferries to get around
- Get movie and event ticket discounts and bundles
Find us and say hello!
- Official website: www.klook.com
- Facebook: @klookglobal
- Twitter: @klooktravel
- Instagram: @klooktravel
Got ideas for us? Let us know at appfeedback@klook.com. Thanks bestie.

bluejetty:00120903:ios.description:
Drive into an action-packed, surprise-filled world of off-road kart racing mayhem! Race against a field of rival drivers, each with unique personalities and special abilities. Build a collection of crazy powerups, like Dodgeball Frenzy, Fireball, and Oil Slick. Unlock and upgrade a variety of cars, from dune buggies to monster trucks. Test your skills in 6 different game modes on 15 imaginative 3D race tracks, against a pack of tropical-loving rivals with a serious case of road rage! 
Fast, furious, fun and FREE, Beach Buggy Racing is a kart-racing island adventure for all ages. 
• • GAME FEATURES
EXCITING KART-RACING ACTION
Utilize your driving skills and a collection of creative powerups to fight your way to the finish line. It’s not just a great looking 3D racing game, it’s an epic battle with spectacular physics-based gameplay!
COOL CARS TO CUSTOMIZE
Use your winnings to collect and upgrade a garage full of unique cars, from monster trucks to muscle cars to lunar rovers! 
OVER 25 AMAZING POWERUPS
Beach Buggy Racing crushes other kart racers with over 25 totally unique Powerups ... and more Powerups are coming!
15 SPECTACULAR RACE TRACKS
Explore dinosaur-infested jungles, lava-spewing volcanoes, beautiful beaches, and mysterious swamps. Each unique race track is packed with hidden shortcuts and surprises.
COLLECT A TEAM OF RACERS
Recruit a team of drivers to play with, each with a unique special power like teleportation, flaming fire tracks, and confusion spells. 
GAME CENTER & iCLOUD
Compete with your friends on Leaderboards, earn Achievements, back up your game and keep multiple devices in sync with your iCloud account.
PLAY THE WAY YOU WANT
Seamlessly switch between tilt steering, touch-screen, and MFi game controllers. Customize the 3D graphics settings to optimize your play experience.
OPTIMIZED FOR METAL
Full Metal optimization provides enhanced graphics, real time lighting and shadows, and super-smooth frame-rates on A7 and A8 devices (iOS 8+ only).
• • CUSTOMER SUPPORT
If you encounter a problem running the game, please email us at support@vectorunit.com. Be sure to include the device you're using, iOS version, and a detailed description of your problem. 
• • MORE INFORMATION • • 
Be the first to hear about updates, download custom images, and interact with the developers!
Like us on Facebook at www.facebook.com/VectorUnit
Follow us on Google+ at www.vectorunit.com/+
Follow us on Twitter @vectorunit
Visit our web page at www.vectorunit.com

Build a collection of crazy powerups, like Dodgeball Frenzy, Fireball, and Oil Slick.  Unlock and upgrade a variety of cars, from dune buggies to monster trucks.  Test your skills in 6 different game modes on 15 imaginative 3D race tracks, against a pack of tropical-loving rivals with a serious case of road rage!   

Fast, furious, fun and FREE, Beach Buggy Racing is a kart-racing island adventure for all ages.  


• • GAME FEATURES

EXCITING KART-RACING ACTION
Utilize your driving skills and a collection of creative powerups to fight your way to the finish line.  It’s not just a great looking 3D racing game, it’s an epic battle with spectacular physics-based gameplay!

COOL CARS TO CUSTOMIZE
Use your winnings to collect and upgrade a garage full of unique cars, from monster trucks to muscle cars to lunar rovers!  

OVER 25 AMAZING POWERUPS
Beach Buggy Racing crushes other kart racers with over 25 totally unique Powerups ... and more Powerups are coming!

15 SPECTACULAR RACE TRACKS
Explore dinosaur-infested jungles, lava-spewing volcanoes, beautiful beaches, and mysterious swamps.  Each unique race track is packed with hidden shortcuts and surprises.

COLLECT A TEAM OF RACERS
Recruit a team of drivers to play with, each with a unique special power like teleportation, flaming fire tracks, and confusion spells.  

GAME CENTER & iCLOUD
Compete with your friends on Leaderboards, earn Achievements, back up your game and keep multiple devices in sync with your iCloud account.

PLAY THE WAY YOU WANT
Seamlessly switch between tilt steering, touch-screen, and MFi game controllers.  Customize the 3D graphics settings to optimize your play experience.

OPTIMIZED FOR METAL
Full Metal optimization provides enhanced graphics, real time lighting and shadows, and super-smooth frame-rates on A7 and A8 devices (iOS 8+ only).


• • CUSTOMER SUPPORT

If you encounter a problem running the game, please email us at support@vectorunit.com.  Be sure to include the device you're using, iOS version, and a detailed description of your problem.  


• • MORE INFORMATION • • 

Be the first to hear about updates, download custom images, and interact with the developers!

Follow us on Google+ at www.vectorunit.com/+
Follow us on Twitter @vectorunit
Visit our web page at www.vectorunit.com

• "My 2 year old LOVES this app!
bluejetty:00186530:ios.description:
• Featured by Apple
Do your kid and toddler like puzzles? How about an educational puzzle game that is fun, packed with learning, and played by 8 million families around the world? Checkout Puzzingo today!
• "My 2 year old LOVES this app! It's the best free puzzle app."
• “I work with special needs preschool children and they always ask for “the Puzzy Game” 
• “Absolutely fabulous, the kids in my moms kindergarten class go crazy for it! It’s so hard to find educational games kids want to play...look no further!” 
Kids, toddlers, and babies love Puzzingo! Its many puzzles are full of interactivity, animations, and sounds for repeat learning and play. Unlike jigsaw puzzles, every Puzzingo puzzle piece is named, so preschool children, toddlers, and babies will build vocabulary while playing. Puzzingo supports learning in many languages, including English, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, and UK English. It is well suited for bilingual parents looking for tools to help kids reinforce a second language. 
In addition to vocabulary, your preschool child and toddler will build spatial recognition, fine motor, memory, and cognitive skills. This tactile game also appeals to children with autism and children with special needs. As for you parents, this game is designed to be playable by you and your young child together, so you can participate and bond with your child. 
Unlike many kid apps, Puzzingo is 100% professionally illustrated. We also use professional voice actors with clear accurate pronunciation rather than machine-generated speech to encourage learning. When your child finishes a puzzle, he will be rewarded to a variety of engaging mini-games. Visual and audio cues throughout the apps are specially designed to make the game accessible by younger and special needs children. 
Puzzingo comes free with hundreds of puzzle pieces in 10 terrific puzzles for your kid and toddler. It also has a Daily Free Preview of new and exciting puzzles every day. In addition, behind the parent gates are additional 100+ puzzles with over a thousand puzzle pieces available for purchase. The puzzles include core concepts such as shapes, colors, numbers, food, and ABC. They also cover children’s favorite topics – animal, car, princess, dinosaur, train, and more. New educational puzzles are added constantly.
• “Best free app that you can download for your kid… Constant updates makes sure that there is something new every time your kid plays it.”
• My kids STILL play with this app even after a few years! There is so much value in this app. 
• “My boys love this game. One with Autism and he is able to easily navigate while working on speech skills by repeating words in the game!!”
• "My 5 year with ASD & my 2 year Aspie are in love with this game! ... 100% recommend for the ASD community."
• "I got this app for my 18-month baby daughter and she loves it!"

bluejetty:00115328:android.description:
Get ready for an addictively fun puzzle adventure with Coin Stack!
Dive into a vibrant world where coins are constantly piling up, and it's your mission to master the mint! The rules are simple, but the challenge is endless: sort through the ever-growing pile and stack identical coins together.
With a satisfying clink, watch as your stacks magically merge into a single, more valuable coin! Turn your coppers into silvers, your silvers into golds, and beyond. How high can you go? The sky's the limit as you discover new and shinier denominations on your quest to become a legend!
But don't get too comfortable! A fresh stream of coins is always on its way, pushing you to think fast and stack faster. Strategize your moves to create awesome combos and keep the board clear. Your ultimate goal is to rise through the ranks and earn the coveted title of Coin Synthesis Master!
Are you up for the challenge? Download Coin Stack now and let the stacking, merging, and fun begin.
