bluejetty:00085624:ios.name: Book Parking Spaces - Parclick
bluejetty:00085624:ios.summary: Parclick lets you search for and find parking spots in over 250 cities in Europe. What are you waiting for? Download now and save up to 70% on your parking. With the Parclick app, parking your car, motorbike, or van in any location near you
bluejetty:00085624:ios.description:
Parclick lets you search for and find parking spots in over 250 cities in Europe. What are you waiting for? Download now and save up to 70% on your parking. With the Parclick app, parking your car, motorbike, or van in any location near you is cheap and easy.
Are you tired of arriving in a city and spending hours looking for a spot to park? With Parclick, you can find a parking lot wherever you want, tailored to your schedule and at the best price possible. Forget driving up and down in search of somewhere to park your car!
Parclick is simple and intuitive: locate yourself using the GPS finder or search for a destination using the app, choose between special offers on car parks in the area, and book your parking spot directly from the app. You only need your booking code to enter, and you can park your vehicle (car, motorcycle, van, minivan, etc.) for hours or for days.
WHAT CAN I DO WITH THE PARCLICK APP?
√ Choose the area you want to book and your parking dates
Let the app identify your location using the GPS finder, or search for a street, city, or point of interest, and select the hours or days you want to park your vehicle for. Just like that, you can select the best offers available on parking spots across the map. And if you're traveling by train, boat, or airplane, the app can help you find a dedicated zone for cars in airports, ports and stations.
√ Choose from a huge number of available cheap car parks
Parclick offers hundreds of parking spots to cater to your every need: 24-hour access, dedicated zones for all kinds of vehicles (cars, motorbikes, vans, etc.), surveillance systems, etc.
√ Select, book, and receive your free access code
Sign up, register your vehicle, and select your preferred payment method. Once you’ve chosen your parking lot, you’ll receive a booking number to present at your destination. The app lets you manage all your bookings, and uses the GPS finder to locate your chosen car park. Book as far in advance as you like!
√ Park in hundreds of cities across Europe
Parclick offers parking spaces in European countries like France, Spain, Germany, Portugal, Belgium, and many more. Don’t waste time searching for a place to park: easily book a parking spot in advance, and forget about driving round and round to find a car park. 
WHERE CAN I USE THE PARCLICK APP?
- Italy: Rome, Milan, Venice, Florence, Pisa, Naples, Bari...
- Spain: Barcelona, Madrid, Valencia, Seville, Bilbao...
- France: Paris, Lyon, Nice, Bordeaux, Reims, Metz...
- Portugal: Porto, Lisbon, Faro, Coimbra...
- Other European cities: Brussels, Amsterdam, Geneva, Basel, and many more.
Parclick is a free app that lets you save up to 70% at over 1400 parking lots across Europe. With Parclick, you can filter the results by price or by distance from your location. Parclick offers flexibility for any drivers who need a personalized zone to park their cars.
The app suggests special offers for local events, monthly subscriptions with discounts, and access to Multiparking passes, which let you park in different car parks in the same city. Find a parking lot near you and book your place in advance, whatever your vehicle (car, van, motorbike, minivan, etc.). Find Parclick in over 250 European cities, with over 1400 car parks available!
Forget the lost pennies under your couch cushions. Stop running desperately after parking meters, like Captain Ahab after Moby Dick.
At the start of the year, we gave you the possibility of paying parking meters in Barcelona. We also promised you that soon there would be more cities available. We like to keep our word so, here it is: now you can use our app to pay for the SER area of Boadilla del Monte! Stay tuned for more cities ;)
Still don't have Parclick on your phone? Download the app for free and discover a cheap and easy way to park!

bluejetty:00200156:ios.name: VU303
bluejetty:00200156:ios.summary: VU303 is the successor to VU202, the pocket sampler downloaded by more than 19,000 people on iOS. It is a phrase sampler and pattern sequencer built like the hardware samplers of the late '90s. Every key is labelled with what it does, every
bluejetty:00200156:ios.description:
VU303 is the successor to VU202, the pocket sampler downloaded by more than 19,000 people on iOS. It is a phrase sampler and pattern sequencer built like the hardware samplers of the late '90s. Every key is labelled with what it does, every knob turns, and everything you need to make a beat sits on one panel – on your iPhone, on your iPad, or on stage.
VU303 is AUv3 Effects Host but also works as AUv3 Instrument Plugin!
COMING FROM VU202
• Your VU202 projects open and sound as they did: their pads keep the VU202 engine, and you can move any pad to the new VU303 engine
• New in VU303: six views instead of one screen, a new sampling engine, patterns of up to 256 steps, a mixer with AUv3 inserts, LIVE XY effects and MIDI LEARN
SAMPLE ANYTHING
• Record from the microphone or an audio interface, resample the app's own output, or import audio files, whole folders and the sound of a video
• Nine built-in vintage drumkits with 785 samples
• Two engines per pad: the new VU303 engine (STANDARD 44.1 kHz, LONG 22.05 kHz, LO-FI 11.025 kHz) and the classic VU202 engine
32 PADS IN 4 BANKS
• Gate or one-shot, loop, reverse, and stereo / mono / left / right per pad
• Choke banks, pad copy, roll and hold
• Three CTRL knobs for volume, pan and pitch – or for the selected effect
TRIM, CHOP AND STRETCH
• Start, end, level, attack and decay; truncate, normalize, reverse and silence
• Chop a sample into 4, 8 or 16 slices across a bank
• Loop points with crossfade
• Time-stretch to the project tempo, with or without keeping the pitch
STEP SEQUENCER AND SONG
• 32 patterns of up to 256 steps (16 bars)
• Velocity, pan, key, nudge and gate for every step
• Live recording with quantize, swing from 50 to 75 %, count-in and tap tempo
• Chain patterns with repeat counts into a full song
MIXER AND EFFECTS
• Channels for banks A–D, the pads and the master, with fader, mute, solo and meters
• 26 DSP effects: filters, EQ, compressors, limiter, delay, tape delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, flanger, overdrive, distortion, lo-fi, vinyl sim, slicer, isolator, radio tuning and more
• Insert slots on every bank and the master – including your AUv3 effect plug-ins
LIVE FX
• Eight XY pads on the master output, each with one of 16 performance effects such as tape stop, filter, beat repeat, grain scatter, vinyl warp and crusher
• LATCH keeps an effect on after you lift your finger
MIDI
• Play the pads from any MIDI keyboard or pad controller
• MIDI LEARN: map knobs, keys, pads, faders, XY pads and TRIM markers to your controller, and save and share the mappings as templates
• MIDI channel filter and velocity curves
EXPORT AND PROJECTS
• Render a pattern or the whole song as a 24-bit WAV mix or as stems
• Autosave; projects are saved as .vu303 files
• Send projects to VU Studio
MADE FOR TOUCH
• Layouts for iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape
• Adjustable text sizes and hold-to-magnify for every label

LIVE FX
• Eight XY pads on the master output, each with one of 16 performance effects such as tape stop, filter, beat repeat, grain scatter, vinyl warp and crusher
• LATCH keeps an effect on after you lift your finger

MIDI
• Play the pads from any MIDI keyboard or pad controller
• MIDI LEARN: map knobs, keys, pads, faders, XY pads and TRIM markers to your controller, and save and share the mappings as templates
• MIDI channel filter and velocity curves

EXPORT AND PROJECTS
• Render a pattern or the whole song as a 24-bit WAV mix or as stems
• Autosave; projects are saved as .vu303 files
• Send projects to VU Studio

MADE FOR TOUCH
• Layouts for iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape
• Adjustable text sizes and hold-to-magnify for every label

bluejetty:00140240:ios.description:
Welcome Hex Warriors!
Hex Takeover is a turned-based strategy game played on different hexagonal boards. The objective is simple: conquer the most tiles to win.
How To Play:
During your turn tap on any of your tiles to chose your next move. Tiles can be cloned to adjacent spaces or they can jump to further spaces. Landing near opponent tiles will convert their tiles into yours! Cloning and Jumping have different implications on your strategy. Cloning a piece means that you get more tiles of your color on the board. Jumping sometimes could be beneficial if you spot enemy pieces further away but want to conquer them. The game ends when the board is filled up with tiles!
Seems easy right? Let's put your skills to the test!
Hex Takeover has simple game rules, yet the game can be quite a bit challenging! With different levels and varying difficulties, there are tons of different strategies to explore.
Through very satisfying and calming gameplay, explore the map and encounter new enemies and challenges!
Can you explore the entire map and unlock new characters to play as?

With the release of its all-new 5th generation Directed SmartStart app, connecting with and controlling your vehicle is easier than ever – including real time status via the updated dashboards, and control via your Apple watch!
- Add a Directed SmartStart GPS module to the Directed remote start or security system in your car so you can start, lock and unlock your car from virtually anywhere. You can also locate your car, share its location with your friends or family, and get safety notifications if your Directed SmartStart-protected car is speeding or goes where it's not supposed to go.
- For the ultimate connected car experience, install a complete Directed SmartStart Digital System and you’ll also get engine runtime and real time status on your choice of app dashboard. Get notified if your vehicle sets a diagnostic code, or check your fuel, battery, or odometer right in the app! 
- All 4G LTE GPS modules come with a free 30-day GPS trial so you can check out the cool features right away, and there’s even an option for a year of free Basic service. Step up to Secure service to get 2-way control confirmations or add GPS or Small Fleet & Family for the ultimate in car control and monitoring along with extended warranty and theft protection. 
The sleek, modern dashboards of Directed SmartStart 5.3 mobile app give you fingertip control over the following features of your installed Viper remote start or security/remote start system:
- Lock/arm
- Unlock/disarm
- Remote car starter
- Trunk release
- Panic
- Aux channels
Follow these three simple steps to get Directed SmartStart:
1) Download the free Directed SmartStart app
2) Get a SmartStart system installed in your vehicle
3) Set up your account, and start using your SmartStart system
Directed SmartStart also includes Directed Motor Club, providing convenient 24/7 access to our nationwide roadside assistance network. Just press a button in the app to get connected for towing due to breakdown or accidents, or assistance with a dead battery or flat tire. Member roadside assistance is free with Secure or higher level service plans and pre-registration. Even if you don’t sign up, you can use the guest program for the same great service at a fixed cost. 
Latest features:
- Real time status on your favorite dashboard! Check the remote start runtime or whether your doors are locked and more instantly just by opening the app! (digital systems only)
- Monitor the battery, odometer, and fuel level in the extended Status page (requires a digital system, some features may not be supported on all vehicles)
- Convenient widget for one-touch command execution without needing to open the app first
- Start, lock, unlock or locate your car using your Apple watch, or send other commands
- Receive alert notifications on your phone and Apple watch
- Four user-selectable dashboards and launch page settings – now you can customize the app for the way you use it
- Modern dashboard "swipe up to start" feature eliminates accidental remote start commands
- Map page integrates GPS and SmartPark features seamlessly – locate your vehicle, or track down where you parked
- Manage notifications: Each user can select how they want to receive alerts or other notifications. Choose from push alerts with custom sound effects, email, or SMS (SMS alerts may not be available outside North America)

bluejetty:00073916:ios.summary:
V1Driver is designed to add intelligence to your Radar Detector so you can enjoy your Drive.
V1Driver now supports the following Radar Detectors (you must have at least one)
Valentine One Gen 2
Valentine One Gen 1 (BLE Dongle Only)
Uniden
bluejetty:00073916:ios.description:
V1Driver is designed to add intelligence to your Radar Detector so you can enjoy your Drive.
V1Driver now supports the following Radar Detectors (you must have at least one)
Valentine One Gen 2
Valentine One Gen 1 (BLE Dongle Only)
Uniden R8,R4 (R9 coming soon)
Radenso DS1
It adds 3 forms of automatic muting (all selectable by Band):
1) By Speed (Savvy Emulation), if you are under the specified speed it will keep the Radar Detector muted.
2) By Time, it will AutoMute (or AutoSnooze) after a specified time. AutoSnooze tracks Blind Spot Monitor frequency
3) By GPS Location, by long term frequency tracking. This tracks hits of the same frequency in the same location spread over several days before considering it for lockout. If a signal later becomes absent it will remove the lock.
V1Driver takes the famous V1 "Arrows" to a new level by displaying the bogeys on a 2 dimensional map. So you can track relative position more accurately before waiting for the arrows to "flip" direction.
It has extensive audible options. Including Text-To-Speech of Band and Frequency. Audio can optionally use Hands Free Protocol (a phone call) on your car or motor cycle.
This app is compatible with all iPhones and iPads that support iOS 12.0 or greater that include GPS. It will work in any orientation. An active cellular connection is not required. For viewing the map or backing up to the iCloud you will need a Data connection, but that is not required for day to day operation.
iPads that do not have Cellular Chips have no GPS chip and will NOT work.
V1Driver will automatically connect to the Radar Detector in the background. This feature of watching for the Radar Detector when away from your car does not use the GPS, it uses very little battery and can be disabled if you wish.
There is no guarantee V1Driver won't lock out an undesired signal. But it should clean itself up over time if it does.
Other features include:
- Alert Notifications with "Mute", "Lock" or "Snooze" acknowledgment
- Alerts are Apple Watch compatible
- Manual Mute (with automatic unmute from other bands)
- Snooze feature (e.g. you are stuck near someones Blind Spot Monitor)
- Live Map showing learning and unlearning process as V1Driver does it's thing
- Live Alert status on the Map (strongest threat only, mirrors V1 display)
- Compatible with Hardware version of Savvy and still Band selectable
- Signal Strength meter with higher resolution than 8 fixed levels.
- Rate of Ramp Up on Main threat and each Bogey on the Bogey Map.
- iCloud Backup and Restore of your Database and Settings
- Two Level Savvy Speed Setting (Startup and Quick Override) with automatic Reset and integrated current Speed
- Extensive Data Filtering on the "Pin Map" to closer inspect what V1Driver is doing.
- Delete unwanted individual or groups of pins or any "filtered" view directly on the Map.
- View detailed information on any collected data point (Pin) from the Map
- Savvy Warmup feature to allow GPS to get good lock but keep detector quiet in false dense areas (e.g. Parking Garage)
- Integrated help on each control throughout the app.
- Savvy GPS Learning, it can learn what you set your Savvy Setting to and reapply it on your next trip to the same location.
- User Settable GPS Accuracy.
- Instant Replay that captures all events in real time all the time and can be played back at any time.
- Live Histogram of your signal strength also shown as color intensity on your route on the Map
- Support for Ku Band for European Users
- Demo mode that uses the "Instant Replay" feature that has Speed, Location, Direction and Alerts, etc. of a real encounter. It will even drop "New Pins" along the route.
- Support for "White Areas" these are designated areas like Police stations that you never want to lock out
Note: "Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life."

【免责声明】
薄荷健康App所提供的健康方案仅供参考，用户若患有疾病、长期服药或其他可能会影响健康方案执行的，应当根据自身的健康状况自行评估，必要时需在医生或其他医务人员的指导下进行。薄荷健康提供的任何方案，均不能代替医生和其他医务人员的诊断和建议。
薄荷健康App仅提供管理工具，体重管理的效果受多重因素影响，请理性看待和使用；薄荷健康App部分功能免费，部分功能仅限付费会员使用。
【访问授权】
薄荷健康App需要您授权访问以下权限，如果您没有授权相关权限，可能会影响部分功能使用。
（蓝牙、相机、位置、麦克风、相册、健康、剪切板）
【个人用户信息收集处理】
薄荷健康App 包含的核心功能（健康评测、饮食分析、食谱推荐、社区、商店等）可能会收集、保存和使用下列与您有关的个人信息。如果您不同意薄荷健康app收集和使用您的相关信息，您可能将无法享受我们提供的相关产品或服务；
具体个人信息收集请点击下方“用户协议、隐私政策”链接查看。
【HealthKit】
- 薄荷健康支持HealthKit，授权后您可以从健康中获取并同步数据到健康应用。
- 将三餐摘要添加到HealthKit。当您在薄荷记录每日饮食数据时，相应的饮食摘要数据将会同步到HealthKit中。
- 与HealthKit中的体重数据同步。当您在薄荷记录体重数据时，此数据将会同步到HealthKit中；同样，当您的HealthKit中增加了来自其它数据源的体重数据时，此数据也会自动与你薄荷账户下的体重数据同步。
- 与HealthKit中的运动数据同步。您可以将在薄荷记录的运动数据自动同步至HealthKit，同样，薄荷也可以获取来自HealthKit的运动数据。
有关您的隐私和HealthKit数据的重要说明：
由于您的健康和营养目标的隐私性非常重要，因此我们默认关闭了这些新工具。要启用HealthKit，请在薄荷应用中打开「我的薄荷」->「设置」页面，并点击「HealthKit分享」选项。然后，您需要向薄荷授予在出现的设置页面中读写基本营养和锻炼信息的权限。如查授予与HealthKit共享信息的权限，则可控制使用这些数据的应用程序。当然，您也可以随时更改薄荷与HealthKit共享或从HealthKit接收的信息。
- 隐私政策：https://api.boohee.com/open-interface/v1/string/market_page?title=boohee_privacy
- 用户协议：https://api.boohee.com/open-interface/v1/string/market_page?title=boohee_agreement

bluejetty:00030146:ios.description:
Drive Smarter enhances your driving experience when you are using select* connected Cobra and Escort devices.
Drive Smarter lets you use your smartphone as a companion to your DashCam. 
A streamlined onboarding process lets you quickly connect your Dash Cam and configure it as part of your dashboard. You can "add" a virtual vehicle to your account, then add compatible* Cobra and Escort branded devices to your vehicle. 
Users with mobile WiFi hotspots** can optionally connect their cameras directly to the Drive Smarter cloud, to avail of instant upload of videos and to share time-sensitive data and event information.
View recordings stored on your Dash Camera SD card; recordings are conveniently sorted by timeline which highlights events of importance; such as possible collisions or impact. Select files to download to your phone; trim video clips and share with your contacts using your favorite communications app.
Take advantage of streamlined reports generated for insurance claims processing.
Get help using the in-built Mayday services that are automatically triggered in severe collisions - send details regarding your current situation to a designed in-case-of-emergency contact.
Keep your devices' firmware up-to-date so you are enjoying all the latest features that your devices' have to offer.
Emergency videos stored in the Drive Smarter cloud. ***
Convenient Snapshot button lets you remotely take photos via connected cameras, with a tap on your smartphone screen.
currently the Drive Smarter app and service is compatible with the Cobra SC- series Dash Cameras. Check out drivesmarter.com for up-to-date information.
* should have upload / download speeds equal to or exceeding 4G / Cat 4 speeds
** See drivesmarter.com for latest storage / deletion policies for free user accounts on the Drive Smarter cloud.
Terms of service: https://drivesmarter.com/eula/
Privacy policy: https://drivesmarter.com/privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00083568:ios.name: Welling: AI Nutrition Coach
bluejetty:00083568:ios.summary: Consistency is the key to results. Welling is your personal AI for calorie tracking, managing your diet and mealplanning help. Welling helps you achieve weight loss and fitness goals by making sure you stay on track effortlessly. Just send
bluejetty:00083568:ios.description:
Consistency is the key to results. Welling is your personal AI for calorie tracking, managing your diet and mealplanning help. Welling helps you achieve weight loss and fitness goals by making sure you stay on track effortlessly. Just send a message or photo to Welling to track calories, protein and fiber.
- Welling uses a proprietary AI algorithm to calculate calories and macros from food descriptions
- More than 2 million meals processed by our AI
- Vast database of Asian and International foods
- Personal trainers at Anytime Fitness and other gyms use Welling with their clients to achieve weight loss
- Rated 4.8 globally on the App Store
WELLING'S FEATURES:
AI CALORIE TRACKING AND AI FOOD SCANNER - CHAT TO LOG
Simply describe what you’ve eaten, snap a photo or send a message using voice-to-text, and Welling will estimate the calories and macros. You can also use chat to log burned calories from activities and workouts, making tracking easy and fun. You can also scan the nutrition label or barcode. No more weighing out each item, or search a database, just take a picture and let Welling do the work.
GET AN INDIVIDUAL PLAN
Choose your goal: weight loss, muscle gain, or maintenance. Complete the intake form, and Welling will calculate your TDEE and set the appropriate daily calorie deficit, surplus, or maintenance calories. This AI personalized plan in combination with your set food preferences allows Welling to help you stay on track.
SET CUSTOM DIET PREFERENCES FOR FOOD TIPS, MEAL PLANS AND RECIPES
Share your dietary preferences and tell specific diets or issues you have to take into account regarding nutrition like FODMAP, PCOS, gastritis, anti-inflammatory foods and Welling can help provide food suggestions. Perfect for GLP-1 users that need nutrient dense meals. Whether you ask for suggestions related to high protein, low fat, low glycemic index foods, low carb, keto, intermittent fasting, vegetarian, or any type of diet, Welling uses its proprietary AI to tailor meal plans, recipes, and food recommendations just for you. 
GET PERSONALIZED GUIDANCE AND SEE PROGRESS
View daily and weekly summaries of your tracked calories and macros, your calorie deficits, burned calories from activities and weight. Discover insights that correlate with your weight loss progress and understand where you can improve. Welling provides guidance to help you reach your weight loss and fitness goals. Welling acts like your personal nutrition coach.
Here's to mindful eating! 
Frequently Asked Questions:
Q: How is Welling different from other AI calorie tracking apps? 
A: Welling is the easiest way to track calories and macros because of its unique chat interface that makes tracking as simple as texting a friend. At the same time Welling acts as a coach that provides guidance, helps analyze your diet and gives actionable insights to improve your diet.
Q: Does Welling recognize other languages?
A: Yes, you can text Welling in your preferred language. You can log foods in English, Spanish, Chinese, Korean, Arabic and more. Due to Welling's vast international database of foods and barcodes, it will be able to make calorie and macro estimations for a wide variety of foods around the world.
Q: Who is Welling for?
A: Welling is best for those that eat out a lot and for those that want to eat healthier but are busy throughout the day and want the most simplest way to adhere to their diet.
Available app subscriptions:
- Yearly
- 3 Months
- Monthly
You need a subscription plan to access Welling's features. If you subscribe to a subscription plan, payment will be charged to your Apple account, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Turn auto-renewal off in the App Store settings.
Powered by fatsecret nutrition API (www.fatsecret.com)
Privacy Policy: https://www.site.welling.ai/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00200075:ios.name: PANTHEON - Official
bluejetty:00200075:ios.summary:
Visit the Pantheon of Rome with the official app created in collaboration with the Chapter of Santa Maria ad Martyres: history, secrets, fun facts, events and useful information.
Download the Pantheon app and you will get:
useful informati
bluejetty:00200075:ios.description:
Visit the Pantheon of Rome with the official app created in collaboration with the Chapter of Santa Maria ad Martyres: history, secrets, fun facts, events and useful information.
Download the Pantheon app and you will get:
useful information for your visit (times, how to get there, contacts, etc.)
suggestions about experiences available in the Pantheon and surroundings, e.g. booking a guided visit
the “create a postcard” function for taking photos and sharing your experience, creating personalised postcards
notice-board for the liturgical activities of the basilica
2 videos: the interview with Monsignor Daniele Micheletti (in English), the Archpriest of the Basilica of Santa Maria ad Martyres, the Pantheon of Rome; and the video of the Rainfall of Petals at Pentecost, one of the most significant rites which take place inside the Pantheon. 
The audiotour includes:
-the tour of the Basilica with 14 listening points, for a total of 30 minutes of audio
-an interactive map
-contents in Italian, English, French, German, Spanish, Chinese, Portuguese and Russian
-access to the contents in offline mode, to save on internet traffic, or in streaming, to save space on your phone
-the choice of listening to the audio from your phone loudspeaker or with earphones
A bit of us 
D’Uva is a digital interpretation lab which offers multimedia contents for the description of the cultural heritage with audio guides, video guides, multimedia totems, mobile apps and web platforms. A laboratory where we have fun, we experiment, we discuss and we try to improve daily. Our aim? To set up deeper relations between museums and visitors.
Together we form a close-knit, multi-disciplinary group of developers, designers, creative talents, technology freaks, audio and video operators, architects, art historians, narrators and technicians, who love museums, churches, art towns and tourist attractions.
Our projects are based on the capacity of the digital media for involving people, and they are developed so as to transform interaction into experience and to add value and emotions to the audio- and video-guided itineraries.

bluejetty:00066487:ios.summary:

In War
bluejetty:00066487:ios.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus ™ is a turn-based tactical strategy game set in the eternal conflict of Games Workshop's Warhammer 40,000 Universe. Experience the intense battles of the Space Marine, Imperial, Chaos, and Xenos on the go!
In Warhammer 40,000: Tacticus ™, you bring some of the universe’s most powerful warriors to lightning-fast tactical skirmishes where you are in full control and only superior tactics can deliver victory. Expand your collection across multiple factions to find new tactical possibilities as you bring your troops to battle and sweep the galaxy clear of all resistance!
New players and grizzled fans of the Warhammer universe alike will find challenge in Tacticus, as they progress and compete in various game modes, including PvE Campaigns, PvP, live events, Guild Raids and much more.
CREATE THE ULTIMATE WARBAND
It’s your task as a collector to build your collection into an elite league of warriors capable of meeting any challenge. Equip your heroes with the ultimate gear, wrestled from the hands of your enemies, to enhance their attacks, armor, and abilities on the battlefield. Not every warrior is ideal for every task, however: Make key strategic choices in who to promote and pick teammates with complementary abilities to maximize your chances in battle!
ENGAGE IN TURN-BASED BATTLES
Strategic choice in how to build your squad is only the beginning. Once the enemy closes, you must take advantage of terrain and positioning, as well as deploying your troops’ weaponry, specific traits and specialist abilities, to prevail. Martial skill reigns supreme!
RISE TO THE TOP
Choose your alliances wisely! Collaborate within your guild in raids against some of the most dangerous beings of the galaxy. You must unleash your guild’s entire arsenal of heroes and tactical tricks to outsmart the relentless enemy and establish your guild's dominance on the top of the global leaderboards.
Learn more:

https://www.facebook.com/tacticusgame

bluejetty:00075131:ios.summary:
Stay informed and safe with the most trusted wildfire tracking app. Watch firefighting aircraft in real-time with 3D spheres and flight trails as emergency responders battle blazes. Used by first responders and millions worldwide.
REAL-TIM
bluejetty:00075131:ios.description:
Stay informed and safe with the most trusted wildfire tracking app. Watch firefighting aircraft in real-time with 3D spheres and flight trails as emergency responders battle blazes. Used by first responders and millions worldwide.
REAL-TIME WILDFIRE & EMERGENCY TRACKING
Live aircraft tracking with color-coded missions and flight paths. Advanced 3D globe powered by WhirlyGlobe technology trusted by air traffic controllers.
- Live wildfire locations, perimeters, containment status
- Aircraft tracking with trails (blue=helicopter water drops, orange=air tankers, green=tactical command)
- Smart push notifications for nearby incidents
- Weather alerts on emergency maps
- Real-time evacuation zones and emergency alerts
- Power outage tracking (California only)
- Offline maps ensure access without cell service
OFFICIAL DATA SOURCES FIREFIGHTERS TRUST
- InciWeb - National Incident Information System
- CAL FIRE - California Department of Forestry
- NIFC - National Interagency Fire Center
- NASA FIRMS - Satellite fire detection
- NOAA - Weather conditions and imagery
- National Weather Service - Red Flag Warnings
- International - NSW RFS, CFA, QFES, CFS (Australia)
COMPREHENSIVE SAFETY INTELLIGENCE
- Global thermal hotspots and satellite imagery
- Real-time wind conditions and fire weather
- Critical weather alerts on emergency maps
- Air quality monitoring and smoke predictions
- Interactive 3D globe with atmospheric rendering
- 80+ offline National Forest and BLM maps
- High-resolution wildfire photography
FIRES ATLAS - PROFESSIONAL GRADE MAPPING
Transform your device into a professional firefighting tool with comprehensive offline mapping. Complete coverage of California, Oregon, Washington, Alaska, Arizona, Nevada.
WHY CHOOSE FIRES?
- Most Comprehensive - Global wildfire coverage with local detail
- Fastest Alerts - Real-time push notifications save lives
- Most Reliable - Offline capability when networks fail
- Professional Grade - Same data sources used by firefighters
Perfect for homeowners in fire-prone areas, outdoor enthusiasts, emergency preparedness, and professional firefighters.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your iTunes account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Fires Pro Elite ($29.99/year)
Yearly access to the entire Fires Atlas, this includes unlimited access to all the Basemaps, BLM reference maps, and USFS reference maps.
- Access Incident Weather Conditions.
- Access Nearby Weather Conditions.
- Unlimited Global Weather Conditions using Waypoints.
Fires Pro ($14.99/year)
Yearly access to all the Basemaps along with yearly access to 4 BLM and USFS reference maps. Each reference map selection will last for 3 months at a time. After 3 months each reference map selection expires, then you can change that selection to any other reference map in the Fires Atlas.
- Access Incident Weather Conditions.
- 7 day free trial.

- TURN OFF auto-renewal via the main Settings app: http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098

Take back control of your sleep with Solitude™. High quality endless nature and ambient sounds to help you focus while working, relieve anxiety, help during your meditation or yoga classes, or just to relax while reading or before going to sleep.
Solitude™ Features
● Real HD Sounds:
Solitude ™ contains high definition real sounds recorded by professionals with professional equipments. These are NOT computer generated fake sound effects.
● Blends with Music or any other audio app: 
Probably this is the only app in App Store that is loud enough to blend with your music. By default app blends its sounds with other audio apps. You can also turn this feature ON or OFF.

apple-itunes:6775300302.name: Monthly: Custom Calendar
apple-itunes:6775300302.description:
Monthly is a custom monthly calendar for your days and your taste. Keep plans, notes and journal entries together in one month view, and change fonts, cell shapes, spacing and colors until it feels like yours. Not just a schedule — a record of your days.
Jot down appointments, to-dos, memos and repeating events in seconds, then place photos, emoji and stickers anywhere on the date. Little moments add up until the whole month looks like a diary you made yourself.
■ Built around the month view
See the whole month at a glance, with no screen switching. Add events, write notes and decorate — all from the same view.
■ Paste, write, decorate
Drop stickers, emoji and photos exactly where you want them. Curated sticker packs are built in, and you can turn stickers you make yourself into packs of your own.

Combine types, tags, accent colors, fonts and layout to build a calendar that fits how you live. Start simple, then go as detailed as you like.

■ Works with your existing calendars
See events from iOS Calendar, Google Calendar and other external calendars, plus public holidays, right inside Monthly. Keep your schedule where it is — just add the decoration.
■ iPhone, iPad and Mac
Jot things down on your phone, then decorate on the bigger screen of your iPad or Mac. Monthly runs on all three.
■ More
- Tags and colors to group and color-code your records
- Collections to view only work, personal, family or hobby entries
- Search to find past entries fast
- Export a finished month as a PDF
Monthly isn't about cramming in more events. It's built so you can look back and see what color your days were, what filled this month, and which moments you wanted to keep.
Don't let this month slip by. Record it, decorate it, and revisit it in Monthly.

apple-macos:6754930608.description:
Navigate Your Chronic Illness Journey with Confidence and Clarity
A chronic condition can make it hard to remember how pain, fatigue, and flare-ups changed. Use this chronic illness symptom tracker to keep a symptom diary you can discuss at appointments.
Living with a chronic illness means navigating unpredictable symptoms, where flare-ups can derail carefully made plans and the invisible nature of your condition often goes misunderstood. The persistent fatigue, fluctuating pain levels, and constant need to pace your energy can feel overwhelming and isolating. Chronic Illness Tracker provides a comprehensive approach to understanding and making your condition visible and manageable. It's not just an app; it's a supportive companion in your journey toward better symptom and flare management and improved daily living.
Empower Your Health Management Journey
Designed for ease of use on both good days and bearable ones, ensuring tracking is stress-free and simple.
Multi-Condition Support: Whether you manage fibromyalgia, lupus, ME/CFS, Lyme disease, IBS, thyroid conditions, arthritis, endometriosis, or any chronic disease, track all symptoms in one unified place with customizable treatment plans.
In-depth Insights: Gain insights into symptom patterns and flare-ups through intuitive charts and graphs, turning daily data into actionable insights that reveal flare triggers and trends.
Seamless Report Sharing: Generate detailed PDF and CSV reports as exports for your healthcare team, fostering better communication across multiple specialists.
Flare Management Tools: Document flare episodes with detailed logging of onset, severity, duration, and recovery time. Identify patterns that precede flares to develop proactive strategies.
Customizable Experience: Tailor the app to your specific condition, from tracking parameters to personalized reminders for medications, pacing activities, and self-care routines.
Privacy: Advanced encryption and optional Face ID or Touch ID protection keep your health data secure and private.
Designed with You in Mind
User-Friendly Interface: Intuitive and elegant design with accessibility features for users experiencing brain fog, fatigue, or reduced mobility.
Regular Updates: Continuous improvements based on the latest research and community feedback.
Responsive Support: Access our dedicated team for any queries, ensuring you're never alone in your health journey.
More Than Just Tracking
Energy & Spoon Management: Track daily energy reserves using spoon theory principles. Plan activities around available energy to reduce crash episodes.
Medication & Supplement Logging: Monitor medications, supplements, dosages, and side effects across multiple prescriptions with adherence reminders.
Weather Correlation: Track how weather changes, barometric pressure, and humidity affect symptoms to anticipate difficult days.
Sleep Quality Monitoring: Log sleep patterns and disturbances to understand the relationship between rest and symptom severity.
Educational Content: Discover resources about chronic illness and chronic disease management, symptom relief, pacing strategies, and flare prevention.
Community Engagement: Connect with a supportive community of chronic illness warriors to share experiences.
Begin Your Path to Better Health Management
Simple Setup: Get started easily and intuitively with just a few steps.
Subscription Flexibility: Choose a plan that aligns with your needs, manageable via the Apple Store.
Transparent Policies: Clear privacy policy and terms of use for your peace of mind.
Use this chronic illness app to bring your symptom record to an appointment. Download Chronic Illness Tracker free today and take the first step towards more confident health management.

flathub:me.proton.Authenticator.description:
Proton Authenticator is a free and open-source two-factor authentication (2FA) app from Proton,
 the company behind Proton Mail and Proton VPN.
 Features include:
 End-to-end encrypted 2FA code storage and sync across devices
 Automatic backup of your 2FA codes to your Proton account
 Supports TOTP (time-based one-time passwords)
 Works offline -- generates codes without an internet connection
 Import tokens from other authenticator apps
 Compatible with any website or service that supports 2FA
 A free Proton account is required to use the sync and backup features. The app can also be used
 as a standalone TOTP generator without an account.
